title: (Senior) Strategic Project Manager – European Mobility Data Space (m/f/d)
description:
(Senior) Strategic Project Manager – European Mobility Data Space (m/f/d)

(Reference number 49/2024)




acatech – the National Academy of Science and Engineering – provides policymakers and society with independent, evidence-based advice for the public good. Its work spans a wide range of topics, from digitalisation and artificial intelligence to the future of energy supply, mobility, sustainable resource use, education, and technology communication. Experts from science, business, and society collaborate to develop sound strategies and bring them into public and political discussions. Funded by the federal government and the Free State of Bavaria, acatech ensures that technology-related issues are addressed at the forefront of scientific and technological advancements, enabling sustainable and forward-looking decisions.

We are a dynamic, interdisciplinary team of over 200 professionals who coordinate acatech’s activities from our offices in Munich, Berlin, and Brussels. For the successful implementation of an EU-funded project with the objective of implementing a common European data space for mobility in 9 cities and regions across Europe, we are looking for a




(Senior) Strategic Project Manager (m/f/d)

(Reference number 49/2024)




at one of our two office locations in Germany (Munich or Berlin), ideally with experience working on urban mobility, data or IT projects at European level.




Your role and responsibilities

As a key member of the project team, you will help coordinate and implement a 3-year EU-funded project (November 2023 – October 2026) supporting the establishment of the European data space for mobility. The project aims to develop open-source digital infrastructure and data governance mechanisms across nine European cities and regions, addressing barriers to data access and sharing and supporting the implementation of local use cases related to multimodal mobility and urban traffic management. Your primary focus will be on leading efforts to shape the strategic direction of the project, alignment across diverse project activities, harmonisation and peer-learning, and fostering stakeholder engagement to ensure impactful and tangible results for the project.




Key responsibilities include:

 * Designing and facilitating activities with representatives of local pilots in the project to promote peer-learning, support harmonisation of technical standards, and advance common data governance practices.
 * Overseeing qualitative and quantitative assessments to evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) across cities and regions, monitor project progress, and ensure effective implementation (monitoring & evaluation).
 * Contributing to project deliverables and providing guidance to various project activities such as technical infrastructure and testing, data governance, legal analysis and tool development.
 * Leading and moderating strategic project meetings, workshops, and events (virtual and in-person) using innovative collaboration tools. This includes managing and optimising complex processes to define common approaches and achieve tangible results.
 * Building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including regular communication with the European Commission.
 * Conducting project-related analysis and representing the project at external events throughout Europe, with regular travel required.
 * Please note that project activities are diverse and tasks are somewhat flexible. Depending on your expertise and motivation to develop specific skills, you will have the opportunity to make meaningful contributions in various areas, such as common technical infrastructure, cross-border governance, standardisation processes, or legal support, etc.




Your qualifications

Key competencies required:

 * Degree (Master’s or comparable) or PhD in a related field, including political science, urban planning, computer science, information systems, (business) engineering or law.
 * Ideally at least 2-3 years of professional experience in a comparable position, e.g. project management, management consultancy, ideally for the public sector.
 * Knowledge of EU funding programmes (Digital Europe, Horizon Europe, etc.) and experience with managing EU projects is a plus.
 * Solid knowledge and interest in data and digital transformation, ideally in the context of smart and sustainable cities and/or smart mobility.
 * Strong interpersonal and communication skills as well as experience with handling complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
 * Critical thinking and strong analytical skills.
 * Strong attention to detail and quality management experience as well as a proactive and results-driven approach to project management.
 * Proficiency in English (C2) and German (C2).




What we offer

 * Competitive salary in accordance with qualifications and experience corresponding to the German public sector pay scale up to E 14 TVöD.
 * Opportunity to shape the future of mobility as part of Europe’s digital transformation.
 * An international, open-minded team with a hands-on mentality.
 * A dynamic work environment that balances independent responsibility with strong collaborative support, including guidance and sparring with experienced team members.
 * Flat hierarchies, flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely.
 * Opportunities to develop your career in a growing organisation.
 * Involvement in future EU project developments and skills development in EU project acquisition and management.
 * Access to a broad network of high-level stakeholders from policy, academia, and industry.




The selected candidates will start as soon as possible on a full-time basis (39h/week), based in one of our offices in Munich or Berlin, with a possibility to work remotely. The position is initially limited to the project period (until end of October 2026) with the possibility of renewal and involvement in follow-up activities.




We value diversity and welcome applications from highly motivated individuals regardless of their racial or ethnic origin, opinions or beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, health, or disabilities.

Please send us your application (CV, motivation letter and supporting documents) with the reference number 49/2024 by 6 January 2025, as a pdf document (max. 2 MB) to jobs@acatech.de. For questions regarding the position, please contact Lucie Kirstein (kirstein@acatech.de).

title: Senior Business Analyst*in
description:
Das sind wir




Als Liongate konzipieren, bauen und betreiben wir maßgeschneiderte und innovative Cloud-Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Wir heben das Potenzial der Digitalisierung und schaffen so den entscheidenden Mehrwert und Vorteil für unsere Kunden.

Dank offener Systemarchitekturen schneiden wir die benötigten Services exakt auf die technischen Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zu. Liongate schafft Lösungen, die in der Lage sind, unterschiedlichste Dienste und Kundenprozesse zu integrieren und zu steuern. Liongate bietet auch eigene Cloud-basierte Full-Managed-Services an: Der Kunde kümmert sich um den Kern seines Geschäfts, wir kümmern uns um den Rest.







Das bieten wir Dir




 * Interessante Aufgaben zu aktuellen Themen mit neuen Werkzeugen und Technologien. Methodisch und fachlich sind wir ganz vorne dabei und wollen diese Position gerne mit Dir ausbauen.
 * Relevante und vielfältige Großprojekte. Bei unseren renommierten und langjährigen Großkunden leistest Du in unseren interessanten Projekten einen wesentlichen Beitrag.
 * Unternehmenskultur und Teamgeist. Wir verstehen uns persönlich und fachlich.
 * Freiraum und flache Hierarchien. Wir fahren Speedboat und überholen oft mit einem Lächeln die etwas trägen, großen Tanker. Bei uns kommst Du schneller ans Lenkrad als Du Dir vielleicht vorstellen kannst.
 * Wir bieten Dir eine individuelle Karriere mit außergewöhnlichen unternehmerischen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Wir mögen keine Formulare und Genehmigungsprozesse.
 * Rahmenbedingungen einer 40-Stunden Woche und 30 Tage Urlaub sind bei uns Standard, sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice.
 * Sei mobil mit deinem Deutschlandticket! Wir übernehmen die Kosten.
 * Traumrad gesucht? Wir übernehmen Deine Leasingrate.
 * Mit Belonio erhältst du zahlreiche Vergünstigungen und Sonderangebote, egal ob shoppen, reisen oder Freizeit.
 * Die Option remote zu arbeiten oder unsere Büros in Essen (direkt am Essen Hbf) oder in München (Schwabing) zu nutzen.
 * Dich erwarten spannende Team-Events, darunter Sommerfeste, Weihnachtsfeiern, Get-Togethers und viele weitere Highlights.




Was Dich als Senior Business Analyst erwartet




 * In der Rolle des Senior Business Analyst*in in unserem Bereich Consulting übernimmst Du entscheidende Verantwortung in unseren (Groß-) Projekten. Du befähigst unsere Kunden durch Deine methodische Kompetenz und Deine Projektmanagement-Erfahrung zu nachhaltigem Erfolg.
 * Als unser Berater und Analyst wird Deine Leistung beim Kunden geschätzt, wie auch wir begeistern die Mitarbeiter unserer Kunden durch Wertschätzung und agieren auf Augenhöhe.
 * LionGate Business Consultants verantworten die vereinbarten Projektziele. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um deren Anforderungen genau zu verstehen und umzusetzen.
 * Du begleitest den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus – von der Idee über die Entwicklung bis hin zur Einführung. Dabei nutzt Du deine analytischen Fähigkeiten zur Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen.
 * In Abstimmung mit dem Kunden und den technischen Experten entwickelst Du Produktvisionen, die Vorhandenes verbessern und/oder Neues erschließen.
 * Basierend auf Deiner Erfahrung, dem analytischen Geschick, dem strukturierten Vorgehen und der klaren Kommunikation gelingt es Dir bei unseren Kunden die Potenziale der Digitalisierung zu erschließen.




Was Du mitbringst




 * Du hast Berufserfahrung in der Beratung, idealerweise im Bereich Telekommunikation, Banken oder einer vergleichbaren Branche
 * Du hast nachweislich mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung als Projektmanager oder als Business Analyst in agilen Projekten und hast bereits ein größeres Projektteam als (Teil-) Projektleiter geleitet.

 * Du hast erfolgreich und gut ein Studium der (Wirtschafts-) Informatik oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.
 * Natürlich verfügst Du über Kommunikationsstärke, hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Kundenorientierung, sicheres Auftreten und Belastbarkeit.
 * Deine Aufgaben erfüllst Du eigenverantwortlich, zuverlässig, engagiert und lösungsorientiert.
 * Du möchtest Dich ständig weiterbilden und Du bist bereit, dein Wissen partnerschaftlich mit uns abzugleichen.
 * Du hast wie wir Interesse an einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

title: Senior Construction Manager
description:
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.




Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.




Experienced Senior Construction manager




The Senior Construction manager, reporting to the Project Director, oversees all assigned construction activities in both the home office and project sites. This role ensures that construction standards are implemented effectively to deliver projects safely, on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with the requirements of Worley and its customers.




We are currently looking for a German-speaking Construction Manager to stear this project. The role will involve managing the H.O. construction team and the site execution team, ensuring the safe and efficient implementation of Worley’s construction standards to deliver the execution of the project on schedule within budget, and in full compliance with the requirements of both Worley and the client.




Working on a large European project within the sustainability space/ new energy space. This project is in line with Worley's overall sustainability strategy. This is an excellent opportunity to work on a credible large EPCM project within the new energy area for a top energy company.




Roles and Responsibilities

 * Prioritizes the safety, health, and wellbeing of ourselves and others. Chooses what is right over what is quick or easy.
 * Manage and deliver a large, complex, high risk multi-million Euro project. Remit will include the delivery of engineering and detailed design, procurement, project services and construction/commissioning related activities necessary for the successful delivery of the project.
 * The administering of the contract agreements between Worley and its subcontractors whereby Worley and Client interests are protected, and costs are managed.
 * Implementation of Company HSE Policy & Plan relating to the Project and in particular, Contractor compliance. Refer to Construction HSE Management plan.
 * To implement the principles of Advanced Work Packaging and drive the “right to left” delivery model, ensuring all design has sufficient input through Cross functional liaison with the Project Delivery team(s), Project Controls, Commercial and Supply Chain Management
 * Ensuring Execution plan gate criteria readiness and demonstration of mitigation to execution risks
 * Management of client relationship through maintaining close contact with respective Client throughout the project to ensure satisfactory reaction to Client’s needs or criticisms.
 * The monitoring and control of project performance against budget, schedule, and quality and safety requirements using appropriate control tools and reporting of same to Worley Management and Client.
 * Preparation of regular project progress and cost reports. Cost report to include the Earned Value Analysis with Forecast on completion.
 * The identification of changes in the scope of work and ensuring that appropriate change requests are current and adequate.
 * The promotion of quality and safety on the project in consultation with quality and safety representatives.
 * The issuing of directions for job close-out and the securing of the final project acceptance and contract release from client.




You'll do/have:

Essential:

 * Recognized discipline background with a several years in senior management within large projects in a relevant Industry to the project mentioned above.
 * Fluent in the German and English language.
 * Ability to communicate effectively with the Stakeholders involved in the Project both verbally & in writing. Methodical work ethic; ensuring consistency in output. Capable of working independently
 * Strong commercial acumen and experience in all commercial contracting models/risk profiles and project scopes/phases (FEL/EPC/EPCM/PMC & Lump Sum/Fixed Price/Target Price/Reimbursable, etc) and the ability to mitigate risks effectively through positive decision making.
 * Proven knowledge of Advanced Work Packaging methodology
 * Proven knowledge of managing subcontracts in the execution phase
 * Staff management experience (knowledge transfer)
 * Motivational communication style with very strong communication skills and the ability to develop high performance culture. Sophisticated internal consulting capability, including the ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders.
 * Attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
 * Analytical and problem-solving skills
 * Demonstrable experience in similar role or senior position in Construction Management
 * Extensive knowledge of the construction process, its implementation and management.
 * Delivery focused and committed to achievement of project/company goals.




Desirable:

 * Executed EPC(m) projects (even more desirable if in German language).
 * A strong communication, networking, collaboration, and well-developed team-working skills, especially in multi-discipline and multi-cultural teams
 * A full knowledge of project specific execution strategies, and the ability to develop them to meet challenging project objectives and deliverables.
 * An ‘Incident Free’ mind-set, and be a role model for their project team (Direct/Indirect hires)
 * A proven HSSE management in managing and delivering large complex onshore projects.
 * A full understanding of how all elements of the project scope integrate and interface with each other to successfully deliver the right project outcome - from construction, and through to commissioning and handover to operations.
 * Demonstrate excellent teamwork skills, being able to collaborate with the various sub-teams to resolve issues and reach decisions that are in the best interests of the integrated project team







Moving Forward:

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard. And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Product Compliance Manager (m/f/d)

What we offer…

• Professional development and growth opportunities




Are you interested?

title: Business Analyst

You'll translate business requirements into technical requirements, design solutions, services and new business models as well as identify opportunities for improvement and manage change in the team and with the customer. title: Business Development Manager (Germany)

WHY WORK FOR SOPRANO:

title: InPlanet Foundation Manager
description:
About InPlanet

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.

People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.

About The Role

At InPlanet, we are dedicated to supporting our communities in Brazil and beyond. That’s why we are excited to launch the InPlanet Foundation—a new initiative aimed at making a meaningful impact in the lives of those that most suffer from the adverse impacts of climate change. We are looking for a Foundation Manager who will lead the charge in creating and shaping this vital effort from the ground up. If you thrive on solving complex challenges and are passionate about making a real difference, we want to hear from you! Initiatives can range from supporting those impacted by natural disaster, social impact by enabling women in sustainable agriculture, DEI or education and innovation around climate change.

The Impact You Can Make

In this role, you will have a direct impact on the lives of individuals and communities affected by climate change. You’ll take this initiative from concept to reality, identifying the most effective ways to respond to crises, support rebuilding efforts, and prepare communities for the future. Your decisions will help us move closer to a more resilient world, as you develop strategic programs, oversee their implementation, and lead the Foundations fundraising efforts.

We are looking for a passionate leader with a strategic mindset, adaptability, and the ability to excel in a dynamic environment where innovative solutions are being developed.

Core Working Relationships

As the Foundation Manager, you will collaborate closely with InPlanet’s Founders and the wider leadership team to ensure that the foundation’s mission aligns with our broader organizational goals. You will also nurture relationships with local governments, NGOs, and community leaders to ensure our programs address the real needs of the affected communities. Additionally, you will partner with finance and operations teams to responsibly manage budgets and ensure transparency in resource allocation. Through these collaborative relationships, you will drive the foundation’s success and make a lasting impact.

Key Responsibilities

Core Skills & Experience

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

title: Business Analyst - Credit
description:

title: Senior Chartering Manager/Senior Project Chartering Manager
description:
Job Title: Senior Chartering Manager / Senior Project Chartering Manager

Location: Hamburg, Germany




Company

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, Italy, Australia, Brazil, Argentina, and continues to be a globally expanding group.

Global Dry Bulk Freight

Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation

Purpose

Independently handle project chartering or dry bulk charting process. Develop new clients and maintain good customer relationships to obtain industry project cargos or dry bulk cargos within your area of expertise. Be familiar with vessel types and have deep contacts with brokers and ship owners and effectively analyze the dynamics of the market to achieve profitable fixtures.

Possess the ability to charter multi-purpose vessels.

Capable of handling cargo bookings from the Atlantic to the Far East.

Maintain relationships with local OEM suppliers in Hamburg, while seeking charter quotations from shipowners or ship agents for vessel leasing services.

Provide advisory services for contract reviews and commercial planning, and source, negotiate, and contract dry bulk cargo opportunities. Proficient in executing COA (Contract of Affreightment) terms

Proficient in using FFA (Forward Freight Agreements) hedging tools to ensure voyage profitability

--Key Responsibilities of Senior Project Chartering Manager:

Possess the ability to charter multi-purpose vessels.

Capable of handling cargo bookings from the Atlantic to the Far East.

Maintain relationships with local OEM suppliers in Hamburg, while seeking charter quotations from shipowners or ship agents for vessel leasing services.

Develop project chartering business aligned with the company strategy

Drive the growth of new accounts and nurture existing relationships

Provide MPP chartering project solutions to clients with the help of internal engineering team

Provide competitive pricing solutions for various projects and cargoes

Oversee vessel space and availability to optimize operations

Other tasks assigned by Head of project chartering




Key Qualifications

Relevant working experience in shipping prefer multi-purpose vessels operator or commercial experience

Good international trade route experience, on cargo flow, on ship supply; Possesses extensive client resources in dry bulk and industrial project logistics and extensive broker contact resources

Good interpersonal skills that can quickly establishing relationships with clients, ship owners and brokers

Good communication and teamwork

High self-motivation and strong sense of responsibility

Fluent in English

Bachelor Degree & above

title: (Junior) Product Owner - Financial Services (d/f/m)
description:

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our IT team at BYD's Stuttgart office. title: Senior Business Development Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Business Development Manager (m/w/d) bei exporto ist es dein Ziel, innovative Geschäftsstrategien wie neue Märkte oder Produktbereiche zu entwickeln, zu bewerten und deren Umsetzung zu begleiten. Du arbeitest cross-funktional mit allen Teams des Unternehmens zusammen und bekommst so einen spannenden Überblick über alle Themenbereiche und Prozesse, was deine Rolle besonders abwechslungsreich gestaltet. Als zentrale Schlüsselfunktion ist deine Mission, das Ausrollen neuer Märkte oder Produkt-Features so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten.


 * Du betreibst Marktrecherche und analysierst Marktdaten sowie Kundendaten hinsichtlich Potentiale, regulatorischen Besonderheiten und Synergien mit unserem aktuellen Tagesgeschäft.
 * Das Sammeln von Anforderungen diverser Stakeholder und die Koordination derer im Projektverlauf sind Routine für dich.
 * Projektplanung und Steuerung einschl. Identifikation von Risiken und Bottlenecks mit möglichen Lösungsansätzen liegen in deinem Verantwortungsbereich.
 * Eintritte in neue Märkte werden von dir bis zum Go-Live des ersten Kunden vollumfänglich koordiniert und begleitet.
 * Deine saubere Dokumentation und Aufbereitung aller Requirements ermöglicht die Übergabe ins Daily Business über alle nachfolgenden Teams hinweg.
   
   

Dein Profil


 * Du bringst mind. 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Projekt Manager, idealerweise aus dem Bereich Business Development mit und hast bereits crossfunktionale, strategische Business Development-Projekte durchgeführt.
 * Deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch und Englisch ermöglicht dir das Moderieren von Workshops mit unterschiedlichsten Stakeholdern und die pünktliche Abgabe von Workpackages.
 * Deine starke Affinität zu modernster Technologie und innovativen Arbeitsweisen in einem dynamischen Scale-Up Umfeld zeichnet dich aus.
 * Kenntnisse und ein Netzwerk in der E-Commerce- oder Logistik-Branche sind von Vorteil.
 * Im Idealfalls hast du schon mit dem OKR-Framework gearbeitet.
 * Du dokumentierst Projektinhalte und Projektfortschritt mit entsprechenden Tools wie z. B. Notion oder Jira.
   
   

Deine Benefits Bei Exporto


 * Ein zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer der spannendsten Branchen.
 * Dynamische, innovative und ehrliche Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem großartigen Team.
 * New Work erleben: Bei uns genießt du maximale Freiheit, Flexibilität und Vertrauen.
 * Lernen von den besten Talenten und Experten der Branche.
 * Unterstützung auf deiner individuellen Reise zu beruflichem und persönlichem Wachstum.
 * Top ausgestattete Büros in Konstanz, München und Berlin ergänzt durch modernste Hard- & Software.
 * Benefits wie Jobrad, Fitnessabo in ganz Deutschland und vieles mehr – bei exporto setzen wir Maßstäbe, um dir ein inspirierendes und wertschätzendes Umfeld zu bieten.
   
   

Dein Bewerbungsprozess bei exporto


 * Online-Bewerbung: Beginne deine Journey, indem du dich direkt online auf eine unserer aktuellen Stellen bewirbst oder uns eine Initiativbewerbung zukommen lässt – wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!
 * Erstes Kennenlernen: Bei einem 30-minütigen Videocall mit Lea hast du die Möglichkeit, mehr über dich zu erzählen und erste Einblicke zu exporto und deiner möglichen Position zu erhalten.
 * Fachliches Interview: Lerne deine:n zukünftige:n Teamlead kennen, stelle Fragen zur Position, zu exporto und unserer Kultur - wir möchten sicherstellen, dass alles für dich klar ist.
 * Teamfit: Jetzt hast du die Möglichkeit, deine potenziellen Kolleg:innen und dein Team kennenzulernen, um herauszufinden, wie gut ihr zusammenpasst.
 * Founders Intro: Fast geschafft! Im letzten Schritt möchten unsere Gründer dich persönlich kennenlernen, mehr über deine Motivation erfahren und gerne deine letzten Fragen beantworten, bevor wir den Vertrag finalisieren.

We’re on a mission: Grenzen zwischen E-Commerce Unternehmen und europäischen Kunden verschwinden zu lassen. WAS WIR BIETEN


 * Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos.
 * Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt.

Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten!

Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren.

Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

title: SAP Test Manager
description:
Company Description

Swiss Delivery Excellence: Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced SAP Test Manager to lead and oversee testing activities within SAP implementation, upgrade, and transformation projects.

The ideal candidate will ensure that all testing processes are conducted effectively, meet quality standards, and align with project objectives. This role involves close collaboration with stakeholders, managing testing teams, and delivering end-to-end test solutions in SAP environments.


 * Test Strategy and Planning:
    * Develop and implement a comprehensive SAP test strategy and approach for projects.
    * Define testing scope, objectives, and deliverables based on project requirements.
    * Optimizing existing testing procedures

 * Test Management:
    * Oversee the preparation and execution of test plans, test scripts, and test cases for SAP modules.
    * Manage the entire testing lifecycle, including Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
    * Monitor progress, manage risks, and resolve issues related to testing activities.

 * Stakeholder Collaboration:
    * Liaise with project managers, SAP functional and technical teams, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on testing goals and timelines.
    * Facilitate defect triage meetings and coordinate resolutions with relevant teams.

 * Team Leadership:
    * Manage testing teams, assign tasks, and ensure timely delivery of testing milestones.
    * Provide mentoring and guidance to junior testers and coordinate cross-functional test efforts.

 * Quality Assurance:
    * Establish and enforce testing standards, methodologies, and best practices.
    * Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements for testing.

 * Test Reporting:
    * Provide detailed test reports, metrics, and dashboards to stakeholders.
    * Ensure documentation of test results, issues, and lessons learned for continuous improvement.

 * Tool Management:
    * Implement and manage test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., HP ALM, Tosca).
    * Ensure integration of test tools with SAP environments.
      

Qualifications


 * Professional Experience:
    * Extensive experience in software testing
    * Proven experience as a Test Manager in SAP projects, including large-scale implementations or upgrades.

 * Technical Skills:
    * Hands-on experience with SAP testing tools (e.g., HP ALM, Tricentis Tosca).
    * Familiarity with test automation frameworks and methodologies.

 * Soft Skills:
    * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for stakeholder management.
    * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    * Ability to lead and inspire teams in dynamic project environments.

 * Certifications (Preferred):
    * ISTQB Certified Tester or equivalent.
    * SAP-related certifications in relevant modules or SAP testing.

 * Other Requirements:
    * Experience with Agile and Waterfall project methodologies.
    * Willingness to travel for project needs, if required.

title: Manager (m/f/d) Warehouse & Network designing
description:
METRO is a leading international wholesale company with food and non-food assortments that specializes in serving the needs of hotels, restaurants and caterers (HoReCa) as well as independent traders. Around the world, METRO has some 16 million customers who can choose whether to shop in one of the large-format stores, order online and collect their purchases at the store or have them delivered. METRO also supports the competitiveness of entrepreneurs and independent businesses with digital solutions and thereby contributes to cultural diversity in retail and hospitality.



The purpose of the role is to facilitate the implementation of METRO’s Multichannel Network Transformation on a global scale and manage the process of the evolution of METROs multichannel network assets, including design, approval, and execution, across Corporate and Country stakeholders and towards the strategic objectives as defined by the Group Strategy.





Job Description


 * Provide accurate and continuously up-to-date information at any time on METRO’s global network plan at global, country, and single location level on current status, and asset transformation investment proposals, approvals and implementation (historic, currently pending and planned in the future)
 * Ensure build-to-suit of network transformation projects during design phase optimizing sizing and infrastructure in-line with capacity needs
 * Implement standard capacity calculation approach (ADT tool) across countries and projects and continuously improve and enrich simulation model based on implemented sites and real-life feedback
 * Review network nodes’ performance and capacity utilization after go-live, identify best practices and share with global network transformation community
 * Determine and track saturation levels of global multichannel network, anticipating potential bottlenecks and avoiding capacity constraints potentially limiting targeted FSD growth ambitions
 * Design and continuously enhance technological tools for network design as well as the associated elaboration of scenario analyses, capacity parametrization and operational process modeling (including eg. WMS systems, warehouse automation opportunities, etc.)
 * Support and safeguard the countries in the execution of the Network Transformation and ensure the training of the relevant key stakeholders in the country
 * Define and algin KPI’s along the network evolution path to specifically trigger the right changes to the network at the right time considering Service Level, CAPEX and OPEX requirements
 * Ensure multilateral stakeholder management, as the implications of this role are broad so are the stakeholders that are involved
   
   

Qualifications


 * University degree in supply chain management or economics or engineering
 * Broad understanding of FMCG wholesale business requirements and dynamics, specifically supply chain- and fulfillment operations while and understanding of store operations can beneficial
 * Solid experience in warehouse design, calculation and optimization. Relevant experience in a consultancy environment can be a plus
 * Experience as project manager or process manager will be an advantage
 * Reliable and responsible way of working in a multicultural setting
 * Strategic conceptual skills, able to manage complexity and strive for simplification
 * Analytical and problem-solving oriented thinking
 * Fluent in English (spoken and written); third language welcome
   
   

Additional Information



What we offer:



 * Work-life balance: trust-based working hours, 30 days' holiday, and up to 3 days home office per week
 * Training: a comprehensive training offer via our own training center or externally, as well as your own annual training budget.
 * Well-being: health programs, free gym on our campus, regular employee events.
 * Comfort: very good transport connections and free parking spaces including charging facilities for e-mobility. Canteen with very reasonably priced meals as well as discounts in our stores and at many partner companies.
 * Company pension plan: you will receive an allowance from us to provide for your pension.

title: Product Owner (w/m/d)
description:
To accelerate the growth of German Mittelstand!






vent.io GmbH entwickelt als Unternehmen der Deutsche Leasing AG und Teil der Sparkasse Finanzgruppe digitale Geschäftsmodelle, Produkte und Services.






Wir suchen DICH als Product Owner (w/m/d) für eine Elternzeitvertretung - befristet auf ein Jahr - im Bereich Product Experience:






DAS ERWARTET DICH

Als Product Owner (w/m/d) im Team Product Experience (ProductX) bist Du der Antrieb hinter der Entwicklung verschiedener digitaler Produkte bei vent.io.




 * Du entwickelst passend zur Strategie der Deutsche Leasing Gruppe geeignete digitale Produkte und definierst in enger Absprache mit dem Managing Director und dem CTO die Umsetzungs-Roadmap für die einzelnen Produkte
 * Du bist in alle Produktentwicklungsphasen involviert – von der Anforderungsdefinition über die Analyse und das Design bis hin zur Implementierung, dem Test und der Einführung, mit dem Ziel, die beste User Experience zu gestalten

 * Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Engineering-Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Produktentwicklung gemäß den definierten Anforderungen und Zeitplänen erfolgt
 * Du förderst die experimentelle Natur unserer Engineering-Teams und unterstützt den Innovationsauftrag
 * Du betreibst aktives Stakeholder-Management und kommunizierst fortlaufend, sowohl mit unseren Kunden als auch mit unseren Engineering-Teams und bist daher das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen Business, Methodik und Technologie sowie auch die Schnittstelle zwischen Product Management, UX/UI Designer und Engineering Teams




DAS BRINGST DU MIT

 * Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Mediendesign mit Schwerpunkt auf digitalem Design

 * Du bereitest Deine Ergebnisse stets verständlich, strukturiert und zuverlässig auf und kommunizierst zielgruppengerecht

DAS ZEICHNET DICH AUS

 * Du bist gut darin Dich selbst zu organisieren, arbeitest gern eigenständig und bist in der Lage mehrere Produkte gleichzeitig voranzubringen

title: Junior Product Owner (d/f/m)
description:
About

Bei RISK IDENT ist es unser Ziel, unseren Kunden die beste Entscheidungsgrundlage geben zu können, ob es sich bei ihren Transaktionen um vertrauenswürdige oder betrügerische handelt. Zu diesem Zweck haben wir FRIDA entwickelt. Eine Software, die alle relevanten Daten zusammenfasst, Verbindungen erkennt und mit Hilfe von regelbasierten und ML Modellen das Risiko von Transaktionen bewertet.

Dieser Aufgabe stellen wir uns mit zwei crossfunktionalen, internen Entwicklungsteams, die in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Projektverantwortlichen, Betrugsexpert*innen und Data Scientists dafür kämpfen, den Betrüger*innen immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein. Dabei stehen die FRIDA Teams vor der Herausforderung, Anforderungen aus vielen verschiedenen Quellen zu filtern und zu vereinen, um den Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu maximieren. Das machen wir, indem wir komplexe Sachverhalte schnell und verständlich aufbereiten und die Nutzer*innen unserer Software befähigen, schnell und gezielt reagieren zu können.

Tasks


 * Analyse und Erhebung von Anforderungen im engen Austausch mit Kunden, Product Ownern, Fachabteilungen und Entwicklungsteams
 * Strukturierte Dokumentation und detaillierte Spezifizierung der Anforderungen in Form von Epics, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien
 * Unterstützung bei der Planung und Priorisierung von Produkt-Backlogs in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Product Owner
 * Sicherstellung der Nachvollziehbarkeit und Testbarkeit von Anforderungen
 * Durchführung von Workshops und Anforderungsanalysen mit internen und externen Stakeholdern
 * Dokumentation und Übersetzungen der entwickelten Funktionalitäten in Form von User Manuals
 * Erstellen von Mock Ups zur Visualisierung der Anforderungen für die Entwicklungsteams
   
   

Requirements


 * Du hast Erfahrung als Refinement Engineer, Projekt Manager oder Product Owner, idealerweise im Bereich E-Commerce, Payment oder Credit Risk / Fraud Prevention
 * Du bist motiviert, dich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten
 * Du bringst Erfahrung in der Erhebung und Analyse und Dokumentation von Anforderungen in agilen Projekten mit
 * Du verfügst über fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 * Du hast eine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ein hohes Maß an Kundenorientierung
 * Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse in Software zur Anforderungsverwaltung (z.B. JIRA, Confluence), sowie basic UX Fähigkeiten
   
   

We Offer The Following Benefits


 * Großzügige Richtlinie zum mobilen Arbeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf Abstimmung im Team
 * Zuschuss zum Mittagessen in Höhe von 30,- € pro Monat
 * Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket (mit dem du alle öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel in ganz Deutschland nutzen kannst) in Höhe von 19,-€ pro Monat
 * Fahrrad-Leasingprogramm über JobRad mit Versicherungszuschuss
 * Interne Coaching und Trainingsangebote (unsere internen Coaches können auch für nicht-Arbeitsthemen in Anspruch genommen werden)
 * Innovation Days zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
 * Zugang zu zwei digitalen Lernplattformen (Udemy und Masterplan) und Budget für externe Konferenzen, Trainings, etc.
 * Bezahlte Social Days für ehrenamtliche Arbeit an deinem Herzensprojekt
 * Mental Health Initiativen
 * Freie Wahl zwischen Windows, Linux oder MacOS auf einer leistungsstarken mobilen Hardware und alles weitere, was du zum effizienten Arbeiten benötigst
 * Übernahme der Reisekosten zu Firmenevents bis zu 4x im Jahr für Riskies von außerhalb Hamburgs
 * Attraktive Rabatte bei verschiedenen Partnern und Fitnessstudios, z.B. 15% Rabatt auf www.otto.de oder 10% Rabatt bei Fitness First
 * Zugang zur Plattform "Corporate Benefits" der Otto Group, die Rabatte bei verschiedensten Partner gewährt (Deko, Reisen, Autovermietung, etc.)
 * Im Office in Hamburg: kostenlose Getränke aller Art und Bio-Obst, das zweimal pro Woche geliefert wird
 * Dusche im Büro, sodass du z.B. aktive Mittagspausen oder einen Arbeitsweg mit dem Fahrrad problemlos in deinen Arbeitstag integrieren kannst
 * Möglichkeit, nach 3 Jahren Beschäftigung ein Sabbatical zu nehmen
   
   

Wenn du dich bewerben möchtest, nutze bitte den unten stehenden Bewerber-Button. Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen sollten Folgendes enthalten:


 * Deinen Lebenslauf (im PDF Format)
 * Ein Motivationsschreiben (im PDF Format) das deutlich macht, warum du gern bei RISK IDENT arbeiten möchtest und welcher der oben genannten Bereiche dich interessiert
 * Deine Gehaltsvorstellung
   
   

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Jana Gilb (Director People & Culture).

About Us

RISK IDENT is a dynamic software development company based in Hamburg, Germany. Founded in 2012, our team became one of the market leaders within fraud prevention in the German speaking market in a very short period of time. Today, as an independent company within the OTTO Group RISK IDENT has a strong customer base, the majority of our customers coming from e-commerce, telecommunications, mobility and financial services. We secure more than 80 billion euros of annual turnover against fraud for our customers. We have an innovative SaaS business model with an excellent market position. Our team consists of around 80 people from all over the world with every single one of them loving what they do. We are always on the lookout for new challenges and for smart people to accompany us along the way!

title: Product Owner

title: Product Owner
description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Product Owner at Xsolla. You will be responsible for driving the development, enhancement, and delivery of scalable solutions to optimize game sales for our partners. The ideal candidate will combine technical acumen with business expertise, ensuring the product’s success in a fast-paced, international environment and should be someone who is well versed in game peculiarities of the markets of various regions (USA, Asia, EU).

Solid experience in successfully launching and managing sales of digital products on gaming platforms, deep understanding of game monetization mechanisms and in-game goods and having professional contacts in the industry and understanding of its ecosystem as well as having worked in a game producing capacity will be key to your success in this role.

If you are passionate about supporting developers in bringing their games to market, data driven and able to make decisions based on available data, selling digital products and in-game goods, then we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities


 * Identify the needs of new users and work with current users of the product
 * Continuously monitor trends and changes in the gaming market, responding in a timely manner and adjusting sales strategies for the solution accordingly
 * Gather insights about customer segment expectations through market research and feedback from partners
 * Educate internal Business Development and Account Management teams on the Game Sales solution
 * Align on strategy and tactics with customer segment expectations
 * Provide guidance to the teams in aligning their decisions with customer expectations
 * Track the development of the market and offer options for product development
 * Form and maintain a product development roadmap
 * Keep up to date and prioritize tasks in the product backlog
 * Communicate the product development strategy to the team
 * Be part of a product development team and participate in building a product culture
 * Identify and minimize product development risks, discuss risks with the team and Stakeholders
 * Initialize and directly participate in interviews with the target audience
 * Work on product metrics improvement
 * Data-driven / experiment-driven backlog management experience
   
   
   

Team Management:


 * Create a team from scratch (onboarding, retaining)
 * Support the professional growth of employees through the accumulation of knowledge and experience.
 * Work with the strengths and weaknesses of team members.
 * Build a culture of collective responsibility for commitment.
   
   
   

Requirements


 * Experience as a Product Owner / Product Manager / Game Producer 5+ years.
 * 5+ years experience in the video game development industry.
 * Excellent understanding of the management and approach to monetization in F2P and B2P games.
 * Deep understanding of PC publishing (F2P/B2P games) and passionate about the video game industry.
 * Experience with digital distribution platforms such as Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store and others, including setting up and managing sales on these platforms.
 * Knowledge of various marketing approaches and distribution channels to attract and retain users.
 * Experience of interaction with Business Development specialists.
 * Knowledge and understanding of the processes of selling digital products and in-game goods.
 * Excellent analytical skills, ability to work with data and make decisions based on it
 * Product presale experience.
 * Pitching experience.
 * Significant experience in developing financial models.
 * Stakeholder management experience.
 * Experience with product marketing.
 * Leadership and ability to lead a team.
 * Upper-intermediate level of English or higher.
 * Understand and apply agile product management methodologies like Scrum and Agile.
 * Ability to work and be flexible in a fast pace environment.
   
   
   

Nice to haves:


 * You are well versed in the game peculiarities of the markets of various regions (USA, Asia, Europe).
 * Experience in successfully launching and managing sales of digital products on gaming platforms.
 * Deep understanding of game monetization mechanisms and in-game goods.
 * Having professional contacts in the industry and understanding of its ecosystem.
 * Worked in Game Producer position.
 * Experience in E-commerce.
 * Understanding of ethics regarding monetization and advertising in games, including issues of addiction and manipulation.
 * Experience of work with Salesforce.
   
   
   

Don’t meet every requirement listed? Studies show that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet every requirement. At Xsolla, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive community, so if you think you could be amazing in this role, even without all the listed qualifications, please apply! You may be exactly who we didn’t even know we needed.

At Xsolla, we are passionate about providing a conducive environment for our team to thrive personally and professionally. Our Benefits Program caters to the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our full-time employees.

Understanding the detrimental effects of burnout, we offer unlimited Flexible Time Off and 28 paid holidays each year. Personal and professional development is a cornerstone of our ethos at Xsolla. Each employee has a personalized career roadmap, developed in partnership with their manager, aligning individual and company goals. We support this growth through in-house training, independent study, conference attendance, and higher education opportunities.

About Us

At Xsolla, we believe that great games begin as ideas, driven by the curiosity, dedication, and grit of creators around the world. Our mission is to empower these visionaries by providing the support and resources they need to bring their games to life. We are committed to leveling the playing field, ensuring that every creator has the opportunity to share their passion with the world. Headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Berlin, Seoul, and beyond, we partner with industry leaders like Valve, Twitch, and Ubisoft to clear the paths for innovation in gaming. Our global reach spans over 200 geographies, offering more than 700 payment methods in 130+ currencies.

Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, with offices in Berlin, Seoul, Beijing, Kuala Lumpur, and cities around the world, Xsolla supports major gaming titles like Valve, Twitch, Roblox, Ubisoft, Epic Games, KRAFTON, Nexters, NetEase, Playstudios, Playrix, miHoYo, Pearl Abyss, NCSoft, and more.

We process your data in accordance with this Xsolla Privacy Notice for Job Applicants . Please direct any inquiries regarding GDPR or CCPA to careers@xsolla.com

This is a newly established team who will support the Finance Executive Leadership Team to support the global Finance Transformation and will work on optimising and developing the finance technology infrastructure going forward. title: SaaS Product Owner (m/w/d)
description:
ilert helps companies to respond faster to incidents and increase the availability of digital services. Our mission is to keep the world always on. Customers from all industries worldwide rely on ilert for alerting, on-call management, and incident communication. We address a fundamental need of companies that offer 24/7 services.

We are seeking a dedicated Product Owner to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with our CEO - who currently leads product strategy - to translate the product vision into actionable tasks for our engineering team. Your primary focus will be on managing the product backlog, creating detailed user stories, and ensuring that our development efforts align with customer needs and business objectives.

Tasks

Backlog Management


 * Own and prioritize the product backlog based on the product roadmap and strategic goals.
 * Ensure transparency of the backlog items to all stakeholders.
   
   
   

User Story Development


 * Write clear, concise user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria.
 * Break down complex features into manageable tasks for the engineering team.
   
   
   

Sprint Planning and Execution


 * Collaborate with the engineering team during sprint planning to define goals and deliverables.
 * Take ownership of our sprint planning meeting
   
   
   

Stakeholder Communication


 * Act as the primary liaison between the CEO (product strategy) and the engineering team.
 * Provide regular updates on development progress and gather feedback.
   
   
   

Quality Assurance


 * Validate completed work against acceptance criteria and ensure it meets the product’s quality standards.
 * Facilitate user acceptance testing and incorporate feedback into future sprints.
   
   
   

Process Improvement


 * Continuously evaluate and improve product development processes.
 * Implement best practices in our development process
   
   
   

Requirements


 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
 * Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Product Owner or similar role in a SaaS environment.
 * Proven track record of managing software products from conception to launch.
   
   
   

Skills


 * Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and their core principles
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 * Ability to translate high-level product ideas into detailed technical requirements.
 * Proficiency with product management tools
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
   
   
   

Attributes:


 * Highly organized with excellent time management abilities.
 * Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally.
 * Customer-focused attitude with a keen eye for detail.
   
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Experience in a B2B SaaS company, especially in the DevOps sector.
 * Familiarity with incident response, alerting systems, or related technologies.
 * Technical background or experience working closely with software development teams.
   
   
   

Benefits


 * Product-centric culture: Be part of a team that's 100% committed to solving a critical issue for businesses that offer round-the-clock services.
 * Hybrid Work Environment: Enjoy the best of both worlds with in-person collaboration and remote work flexibility.
 * No Meetings #hackfwd: Maximize productivity by keeping meetings to a minimum and focusing on your core responsibilities.
 * Lean and Scrappy By Design: Join a close-knit community that values open communication, mutual support, and shared goals.
 * Managers of One & Autonomy: Embrace a flat organizational structure and take full ownership of your work, driving your success.
 * Founder-led startup
 * 28 days of paid vacation
 * Regular team events
 * A beautiful office in the heart of Cologne at the Harbour "Rheinauhafen"

title: Technical Product Owner Fulfillment
description:
Job Summary:




Teveo is seeking a dedicated and experienced Technical Product Owner for our fulfillment systems. In this role, you will be responsible for managing, maintaining, and enhancing key applications that are critical to our organization’s operations. You will act as a bridge between business departments and IT, ensuring that application functionalities align with business needs and that any issues are swiftly resolved. Your technical expertise, combined with strong communication and problem-solving skills, will be essential in collaborating with software vendors and internal teams to implement and manage interfaces and integrations. If you have a strong background in IT projects, particularly within eCommerce environments, and are passionate about driving solutions, we invite you to join our team.




Key Responsibilities:




 * Application Ownership: Manage and take full responsibility for all applications related to the entire fulfillment process, encompassing areas from warehouse management to customer service. Understand how these applications are used, the problems they solve, and their functionality.
 * Requirements Alignment: Collaborate with business departments to align application requirements and ensure they meet business needs.
 * Vendor Collaboration: Work closely with software vendors to implement new requirements and enhancements.
 * Integration Management: Partner with IT teams to realize and maintain interfaces between fulfillment applications and other systems.
 * Problem Solving: Address and resolve any issues related to the applications, ensuring smooth operation and minimal downtime.
 * Documentation and Training: Maintain thorough documentation of application configurations and processes. Provide training and support to end-users as needed.




Qualifications:




 * Experience: Several years of experience in IT projects, ideally within an eCommerce environment, including both organizational and practical involvement (e.g., through configuration) in projects or application maintenance.
 * Technical Skills: Willingness to get hands-on with software configuration; Nice to have: Proficient in ETL processes and APIs and ability of writing small REST/SOAP queries for a proof of concept.
 * Basic Logistics Knowledge: Understanding of logistics processes and concepts.
 * Work Ethic: Demonstrates an independent, solution-oriented, and team-oriented work style, with a proven track record in managing large software projects.
 * Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, enjoying the coordination of multiple internal and external stakeholders.
 * Language Proficiency: Fluent in both German and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.




What We Offer:




 * Competitive salary and benefits package.
 * Remote work options*.
 * Opportunities for professional growth and development.
 * A dynamic and inclusive work environment within a young team.
 * Regular employee events.
 * Employee discounts in our shops.




*Given the location-specific nature of our fulfillment systems, a willingness to be present on-site as required is essential in order to analyze, understand, and resolve any issues that may arise.




If you are passionate about managing critical applications within an organization and thrive in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and cover letter including your salary expectations and possible starting date.




Please note in making your application that we are looking for someone in remote who can be on site at our headquarter about two days a month.

title: Freelance - Pimcore Product Owner [w/m/x] - remote
description:
Aufgaben: Entsprechen unserer permanent Besetzung zur vorübergehenden Überbrückung und/oder Übernahme einzelner interner Projekte:

Ownership, also die Fähigkeit, ein Produkt an sich zu nehmen, es “zu ownen” und damit die Verantwortung für den Business Value zu übernehmen, ihn zu schärfen, stetig zu verbessern und immer wieder zu hinterfragen, ist eine großartige Herausforderung. Wir haben Lust auf Ownership! Du auch?

Manche da draußen verwechseln Agilität mit Flexibilität und haben keine Ahnung, dass ein agiler Softwareentwicklungsprozess jede Menge Disziplin erfordert. Manche sagen Scrum und machen chaotischen Wasserfall. Wir nicht.

Wir sind selbst Techies, über 50 % unseres Teams sind Entwickler:innen. Wir brauchen POs auf technischer Augenhöhe. Du entwickelst mit deinem Team inhouse und nah am Code.

Unsere Projekte könnten unterschiedlicher nicht sein: ein Omnichannel-B2B-E-Commerce-Projekt in Scrum für einen großen Online-Retailer, eine hochkomplexe Multi-Datenbank-Applikation für ein führendes deutsches Verlagshaus im Customer-Success-Team oder eine komplette Digital-Experience-Plattform für einen Weltmarktführer im Braugewerbe. Genau diese Abwechslung macht uns Spaß, lässt uns über den Tellerrand schauen und bringt dabei spannende neue Dinge hervor, die wir dann in den unterschiedlichsten Branchen und Projekten einsetzen.

Das geht nur mit Transparenz, Vertrauen und Leidenschaft. Eben mit Ownership!

Aufgaben

Deine Mission und dein Team

Für die technische Umsetzung der Anforderungen unserer langjährigen Kunden, aber auch für neuere Projekte suchen wir ab sofort und in Vollzeit mehrere (Senior) Technical Product Owner [w/m/x]. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team aus interdisziplinären Expert:innen und Entwickler:innen sorgst du dafür, dass das Projekt erfolgreich implementiert wird, fungierst als Ansprechpartner:in für alle Stakeholder, bist tief im Backlog und maximierst den Wert und die Qualität des Produktes innerhalb des Scopes und der Timebox.


 * Du fungierst als technische:r Sparringspartner:in für alle Stakeholder und bist die Schnittstelle (PPO) zwischen Kunden und Entwickler:innen-Team.
 * Du arbeitest dich in die technischen Voraussetzungen des Projekts ein, identifizierst die Anforderungen und Zielsetzungen des Kunden an das Projekt und unterstützt das Team dabei, die Anforderungen umzusetzen.
 * Übernahme aller Aufgaben eines Product Owners nach Scrum: wie beispielsweise das Stakeholder-Management, Anforderungs-Management, Backlog-Arbeit, Durchführung von Reviews, Refinements und Retros in Zusammenarbeit mit deinem Scrum-Team
 * Du verantwortest das Projekt-Controlling und dokumentierst deinen Projektverlauf.
 * Du bist für den Erfolg des Projektes zuständig und planst die Team-Ressourcen und -Kapazitäten, um den reibungslosen Ablauf sicherzustellen.
   
   

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit (je nach deiner Seniorität)


 * Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner im Bereich der agilen Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise auch in der technischen Umsetzung von Datenbankprojekten und technischen Applikationen (PIM-/DAM- und MDM-Systeme).
 * Expert:innen-Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von User Stories sowie im Aufbau und in der Priorisierung und Pflege des Backlogs
 * Du verfügst über Kommunikationsstärke, um unsere Kunden erfolgreich durch das Projekt zu führen
 * Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie eine gültige EU-Arbeitserlaubnis
 * Du hast einen Abschluss in bspw. Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Informatik oder Ingenieurwissenschaften
 * Du verfügst über eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht an die Stakeholder zu vermitteln.
   
   

Benefits


 * Echtes Scrum, kein Bullshit
 * Ein Team von interdisziplinären Expert:innen, die Lust auf Ownership haben
 * Technische Challenges und Sparringspartner
 * Flexible Arbeitszeiten, auch kompatibel für Kids und Family
 * Arbeite 100 % remote, wenn Du magst − bei 0 % Distanz, versprochen
 * Lust auf Workation? Do it!
 * Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, um an Trainings, Workshops und Events teilzunehmen
 * Du bist Basilicom. Gestalte dein Arbeitsumfeld und deine Agentur mit
 * Finde bei uns deine neuen Arbeitsfreund:innen
 * Regelmäßige hauseigene Events, Meet-ups und viele Teamausflüge ins Grüne
 * Moderne Hard- und Software zum Arbeiten
 * Kulinarische Leckerbissen im Dienstags-Lunch, Basics jederzeit aus dem Kühlschrank
 * Wir lieben unsere Büros, komm vorbei und besuch uns
 * Verbieg dich nicht, come as you are!
   
   

Bitte beachten: Wir freuen uns über direkte Bewerbungen von Kandidaten. Personaldienstleister bitten wir höflich, von telefonischen Kontaktaufnahmen abzusehen.

Wir sind Basilicom. Als Digitalagentur unterstützen wir Unternehmen strategisch und technisch bei der Umsetzung ihrer Digitalprojekte. Wir schaffen Plattformen für PIM, E-Commerce und Customer Experience. Wir sind Pimcore Agentur Nr. 1 in Deutschland.

Interesse an weiteren Informationen zu unserer Mission, unseren Werten und unseren Projekten? Bewirb dich jetzt unkompliziert bei uns oder melde Dich gerne direkt bei Kolja, unserem Recruiting Manager, unter +49 30 / 69 5660 7346.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

 * DISCOUNTS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte
 * THE PLACE TO BE: Freu dich auf ein wunderschönes, helles Büro mit allem, was das Herz begehrt wie Tischtennisplatte & Kicker. Lass dich außerdem von wöchentlichen Frühstücks- und Mittagsessensangeboten verwöhnen
 * OFFICE DOGS: Hunde im Büro sind bei uns herzlich willkommen
   
   

Die Rolle – Deine Leidenschaft


 * Du unterstützt die Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelösungen und Produkte, indem du eigene Ideen aktiv einbringst
 * Gemeinsam mit dem Scrum-Team analysierst du Produktanforderungen und übersetzt diese in präzise User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien
 * Du arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen und agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen den Fachbereichen und dem Entwicklungsteam
 * Du begleitest den Produktentwicklungsprozess, unterstützt bei der Priorisierung und hilfst, den Fortschritt bis zum Go-Live sicherzustellen
 * Du arbeitest an der Pflege und Priorisierung des Product Backlogs basierend auf Unternehmenszielen und Nutzerfeedbacks
 * Du beobachtest technologische Trends und hilfst dabei, neue Ideen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Software zu identifizieren
   
   

Was du mitbringen solltest, um die Welle mit uns zu reiten


 * Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Produktentwicklung, idealerweise mit mobilen Apps, gesammelt und kannst zur nutzerzentrierten Weiterentwicklung beitragen
 * Du hast Grundkenntnisse in A/B-Tests, Nutzerforschung und App-Analysen und möchtest diese weiter vertiefen
 * Du hast Erfahrung mit agiler Softwareentwicklung (Scrum) und gängigen Tools wie Jira und Confluence
 * Du bringst ein Gespür für nutzerfreundliche Designs und klar strukturierte Benutzeroberflächen mit
 * Du bist kommunikationsstark in Englisch
 * Du hast ein technisches Grundverständnis und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte in einfache Sprache übersetzen
   
   

Wir freuen uns sehr auf deine Bewerbung! Wenn du eine Frage hast, dann wende dich gerne an unseren Recruiter Luca unter: team@roadsurfer.com.

ABOUT #ROADSURFER

As a #roadsurfer you are part of an open, fast-growing team with ambitious goals and a great team spirit. We stick together and combine a brutal hands-on mentality with fun at work! It means shaping the future of outdoor travel and building an ecosystem for sustainable outdoor travel. We are more than Europe's largest campervan rental company. In 2021 we launched our platform roadsurfer spots in addition to our other products rent, abo and sales – a platform where you can discover and book unique camping spots. But that’s only the beginning. We are growing fast, so hop on board and join us on our journey. We’re looking for motivated and passionate people whose hearts beat for campers. Wanna spread the roadsurfer spirit across the globe with us?

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Technical Product Owner – Fulfillment Systems




Job Summary:

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a skilled and driven Technical Product Owner to manage and enhance fulfillment systems within a fast-paced and dynamic organization. This role is integral to ensuring the seamless operation of critical applications across the fulfillment process, from warehouse management to customer service. Acting as a bridge between business departments and IT, you’ll align application functionalities with business needs, collaborate with software vendors, and oversee system integrations.

If you have a strong IT background, particularly in eCommerce, and are passionate about solving problems, Implementing solutions, and ensuring operational excellence, we’d love to hear from you!




Key Responsibilities:

 * Application Ownership: Manage and maintain applications critical to the fulfillment process, ensuring they meet organizational needs and resolve operational challenges.
 * Requirements Alignment: Work with business teams to ensure application requirements align with business goals.
 * Vendor Collaboration: Collaborate with software vendors to implement and enhance application features.
 * Integration Management: Partner with IT teams to establish and maintain interfaces between fulfillment applications and other systems.
 * Problem Solving: Proactively address and resolve application issues to ensure smooth operations.
 * Documentation and Training: Maintain comprehensive documentation of processes and provide end-user training when needed.




Qualifications:

 * Experience: Several years in IT projects, ideally in an eCommerce environment, with hands-on experience in application maintenance or configuration.
 * Technical Skills: Comfortable with software configuration; knowledge of ETL processes, and APIs, and the ability to write REST/SOAP queries for proofs of concept is a plus.
 * Logistics Knowledge: Basic understanding of logistics processes.
 * Work Ethic: Independent, solution-oriented, and team-focused work style with a track record of managing large software projects.
 * Communication Skills: Strong coordination and communication skills, with experience working with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
 * Language Proficiency: Fluency in both German and English, with excellent written and verbal skills.




What We Offer:

 * Competitive salary and benefits.
 * Remote work options (with some on-site presence required for system-specific needs).
 * Opportunities for professional growth.
 * A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture.
 * Regular team events and employee perks, including discounts.




If you’re ready to take ownership of critical applications in a fulfilling environment and drive impactful solutions, apply now! Please submit your resume, cover letter, salary expectations, and your earliest possible start date.

title: Product Owner (m/f/x)
description:
Who You Will Work For:

Makersite is an award-winning data software company that empowers teams to manage product sustainability, cost, and compliance; simultaneously, from a web browser. Our mission is to help manufacturing companies make better decisions and create safer, more sustainable products through data-driven analysis. We believe that technology can help corporations to have a more positive impact on their environment. That is why we developed a platform that uses cutting-edge technology, big data, and breakthrough algorithms to deliver product intelligence, unlike anything on the market.

For manufacturing companies with complex supply chains that want to accelerate product development, build resilience or reduce costs, Makersite is a disruptive digital twin platform that uses AI to connect and enrich cross-departmental data into live models for analysis, collaboration and decision support. Digital twins can be used to understand how externalities like regulations, supply shortages etc. affect a business and help teams evaluate scenarios considering multiple criteria like costs, environment, compliance etc. at the same time.

Who We Are Looking For:

We are seeking a Product Owner to join our team and bring clarity, guidance, and expertise to our product development efforts. If you're passionate about solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teams, and driving impactful results, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do:

Define and Communicate Product Goals: Establish and maintain clear product objectives aligned with business strategy and ensure they are communicated effectively to all stakeholders.

Own the Product Backlog: Develop, prioritize, and communicate the product backlog to ensure it reflects the needs of the business and users.

Provide Contextual Guidance: Leverage your domain expertise to provide the development team with contextual guidance, ensuring they understand what they are building and why.

Collaborate with Key Stakeholders: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and business stakeholders, to ensure alignment and transparency.

Navigate Uncertainty: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of uncertainty, balancing competing priorities and making decisions with incomplete information.

Drive Transparency: Establish processes to keep all stakeholders informed of progress, priorities, and trade-offs.

Your Impact:

You will address critical gaps in capacity within our teams and provide the domain-specific expertise needed to guide our product development. Your leadership will ensure the clarity and focus needed to drive product success in a fast-moving and complex environment.

Top Challenges:

Managing high levels of uncertainty in a fast-paced and ever-evolving landscape.

Developing a deep understanding of complex domains (sustainability, supply chain, and B2B SaaS) in a short time frame.

Balancing priorities and making strategic sacrifices to achieve long-term goals.

Differentiating the role of Product Ownership from project management and staying focused on delivering value.


 * 2+ years of consultancy experience, demonstrating strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
 * Expertise in B2B SaaS software, with a proven track record of delivering impactful products.
 * Educational background or work experience in supply chain or sustainability domains.
 * Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and prioritize competing demands.
 * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to articulate complex ideas clearly.
   
   

What You Can Expect From Us:


 * Belonging - Be part of the sustainability megatrend
 * Development – a steep learning-curve, both personally and professionally
 * Pride - Do amazing work with an international, vibrant and passionate top-class team.
 * Passion - International customers that love what we do and share our vision.
 * Remote Working - Work 100% remote if you like (in the EU)
 * Values-driven culture - we're proud of our culture.
 * Time-Off - 30 days of paid time off per year.
 * Technology – State-of-the-art equipment.
 * Competitive salary
   
   

What To Expect When You Apply

If this sounds like something that excites you, we want to hear from you! We look forward to receiving your detailed CV together with a cover letter. If it’s a match, we’ll invite you to a series of interviews.

We try to keep the process short and sweet, to welcome you at Makersite as soon as possible!

Support – If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to beat at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed

So, What Does It Really Mean to Work at Makersite?

At Makersite, we come together with a shared purpose to help companies around the world improve their products, so they are more successful while being mindful of their customers and the environment. Therefore, we believe everyone deserves to work in a collaborative, open-minded and inspiring environment. We work hard to make sure everyone has the support they need to thrive. Our 3 core values are diversity, purpose and collaboration:

We believe that good ideas come from anywhere. We embrace diversity and look for team members who have different skills but similar values.

We want to make a significant impact on the take, make, waste economy of today. We believe that technology can provide solutions that enable this and work hard to make our ideas a reality.

No politics, no drama, no slacking. We believe in technology-enabled collaboration. Whether you are working remotely or in our offices, you will always find someone to help you.

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Makersite, we're committed to cultivating an environment that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging. We believe that diverse teams are the best teams and we're proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage, pregnancy, maternity, race or nationality, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation (and any other status protected by applicable law).

All applications will be treated in strictest confidence

description:

Serrala is a global player in the financial software industry with nearly four decades of experience in empowering businesses to optimize their financial operations. Our core strength lies in our solutions that are designed to make financial processes easier, more efficient, and smarter.

With a substantial client base of over 2,500 clients in over 70 countries worldwide, we have earned the trust of a diverse global community that trusts our innovation.
