title: System Optimization Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Company Description

100% Fossil-free: We don't just dream of a sustainable and livable world - we shape it together and with passion! For over 20 years, we have been a driving force in the expansion of renewable energies. We generate, store and deliver green energy around the globe - with wind, solar, biogas and hydrogen. Around 1,000 employees at various locations worldwide share our mission: to generate renewable energy sustainably for a livable earth.  

Become a part of the ENERTRAG team at our location in Berlin as System Optimization Engineer (m/f/d) and let's advance the energy transition together.

Job Description


 * You work with the System Planning team to perform techno-economic optimisation of Power-to-X projects, guided by specific project assumptions from the project developers.
 * You develop and maintain software tools that support the optimisation efforts of ENERTRAG's System Planning team, ensuring they are effective and up to date.
 * You ensure code versioning, collaboration, and management using Git, following best practices for branching, merging, and pull requests.
 * You adhere to clean coding principles and participate in code reviews to maintain high software quality and consistency.
 * You identify performance bottlenecks and optimize code to improve efficiency and scalability.
 * You help to develop and extend new optimisation models, implementing them in a suitable programming language (e.g., Python).
 * You prepare and present results in a clear and comprehensible manner, using visualisation techniques to enhance understanding.
 * You write reports for internal reviews and decision-making, and conduct site inspections as needed.
   
   

Qualifications


 * You have completed a degree in engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related field, with a specialization in applied mathematics (optimisation, operations research) or energy being a strong advantage.
 * You have at least 4 years of hands-on experience in software development, with advanced proficiency in Python and Git.
 * You have an understanding of energy economics and expertise in numerical optimisation (linear/non-linear programming).
 * You have relevant professional experience in energy system modelling (capacity expansion and production-cost modelling), or have gained experience in energy system modelling and energy economics during post-graduate studies.
 * You demonstrate a structured approach to work, strong teamwork abilities, and a high level of determination.
 * Experience with open energy modelling tools for electricity generation and transmission expansion planning, such as PyPSA, Balmorel, or Calliope, is a plus.
 * You are fluent in English and German a plus.
   
   

Additional Information

#kids: Your children are the most important thing to you? For us, too. That's why you receive a daycare allowance from us.

#jobrad: Would you like to have some innovative wind around your ears? Then use our job bike - also privately.

#vacation: You need new energy and are already in a mood for departure? We offer 30 days of vacation.

#retirementprovision: We are not only thinking about tomorrow for the sake of the environment, but also for you. That's why we offer you access to the Allianz private pension plan. You will also receive an allowance from ENERTRAG SE in the amount of the social security contributions saved.

#mobilework: You want to stay flexible? Depending on the job, we decide together whether you prefer to come to the office or work from home.

#worklifebalance: You know best at what time of the day the drive is strongest for you. Therefore, you also decide at which working hours you want to use your power around the core working hours.

#training: Do you want new impulses to expand your potential? With us you have the opportunity for individual development with a generous training budget.

#health: Your well-being is close to our hearts. So that you don't lose your vitality, we offer you company health management and accident insurance.

#language: Do you speak English? No? Then simply learn it together with us.

#drinksforfree: Water, coffee and tea - if you like, you can also have a juice or fresh fruit.

#teamevents: To let work be work, we invite you once a year to our big summer party and to other team events in between.

#fossilfree: This should not remain just a dream! Take advantage of the great creative leeway to shape a sustainable and livable world.

Do you have any questions in advance? Then please get in touch with your contact person Karo. You can reach her at: [email protected]


 * What counts for us are your skills and your motivation to advance renewable energies with us - not age, gender, skin color, handicap, origin, sexual orientation or religion.

We are a 100% distributed company. Our team members work from wherever they choose to live and we regularly get together in nice locations all over Europe for fun and a bit of work. title: Mechanical System Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Company Description

Here at Volocopter, we are the pioneers of electric air taxis (electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft - eVTOLs). We have pledged to bring sustainable urban air mobility to life by getting electric air taxis off the ground in a way that complements existing transportation options in megacities across the globe. In 2011 we carried out the first-ever crewed flight of a fully electric multicopter and have since conducted more than 2,000 public and private test flights across the world (www.volocopter.com).

Job Description

Your crew during this flight:

As a systems engineer for mechanical systems, you will be part of a dynamic and driven team responsible for defining requirements, devising verification strategies, and conducting corresponding test campaigns. Your role will also involve ensuring that all equipment sourced from suppliers align with the specific needs and requirements of Volocopter.

Your mission during this flight:

The role of a system engineer involves overseeing the development, verification, and testing of the internally and externally developed mechanical elements of the aircraft, to ensure it meets all product and certification requirements. You will work closely with your team to optimize the system definition, requirements, and verification, taking into account key factors such as usability, maintenance, costs, and timelines.

You will be responsible for defining testing requirements for both development and verification phases. Ultimately, your efforts will play a vital role in ensuring that the mechanical elements meet stakeholders' expectations and perform to the highest aerospace standards.

You will work autonomously and provide guidance to the rest of the system engineering team as well as other interfaces that depend on the systems engineering process. You will define development and verification strategies, and have a high influence on the development of our mechanical systems.

Your responsibilities will be:


 * Generation and optimization of system engineering processes required to develop structures and mechanical components.
 * Definition, specification, and development assurance for mechanical elements.
 * Verification strategy definition - develop a plan for meeting the requirements, including certification plans and exchanges with the certification authority (e.g. EASA)
 * Structural testing definition and supervision: oversee the testing process to ensure compliance, and address any deviations or non-compliances.
 * Lifecycle management of supplier systems.
   
   

Qualifications

Check in your professional skills:


 * Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering degree (M.Sc., Ph.D.)
 * Minimum 5+ years of professional experience as a systems engineer in mechanical systems in aerospace industry.
 * Proven experience in aircraft development on lightweight composite structures and rotors.
 * Experience with supplier selection, evaluation, and management.
 * Experience with mechanical systems and/or structures certification.
 * Experience in certification according to aerospace standards.
 * A structured way of working and a high sense of accountability.
 * Experience with prototyping and testing.
 * Excellent communication skills with internal and external stakeholders.
   
   

Preferred skills:


 * 7+ years of experience as a systems engineer in mechanical systems in aerospace industry.
 * Hand-on, creative, pragmatic and solution-oriented way of working in cross functional teams.
 * Open-minded and willing to think outside the box.
 * Good understanding light structures and aircraft mechanical systems and certification process.
 * Technical project management experience.
 * Experience with aerospace standards: CS23, CS25, CS27, CS29, SC-VTOL.
   
   

Additional Information

OurVolocopterflight includes:


 * Fast-growing high-tech company with a superb network of investors and partners 
 * Chance to shape the future of aviation
 * Help us to create groundbreaking new projects - from scratch! 
 * Personal accountability, as well as growth and learning opportunities, based on your personal strengths
 * An inspiring workplace with modern workspaces, flexible hours, quick decision-making, a flat hierarchy, positive leadership, great team spirit
 * Attractive compensation package
   
   

Diversity atVolocopter:

Our differences are what make us great.Here at Volocopter, we value equal opportunities and trust. As air mobility industry innovators, we believe that changing the world starts on team level.We are committed to fosteringanenvironment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empoweredtoreach their full potential.

    * System hardening

We are an international team of space enthusiasts, following one great vision. We value trust, open communication and collaboration.  * A completed engineering or technical degree (at least Bachelor’s) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.

 * A permanent position awaits you at our business where new technologies meet a modern workplace culture.

 * Our flexible working hours allow you to combine work and private life.
 * Enjoy our phenomenal outstanding discounts on selected Viessmann products and services.
 * In our staff restaurant, we offer you a selection of balanced and inexpensive meals prepared from regional foods.

We cover all applications: heating, cooling, ventilation, water and air quality, energy generation, and energy storage for the residential and commercial sector.

title: 3GPP Senior Architect
description:
Who we are

Welcome to one of Europe’s most exciting New Space companies, creating the world's first fully connected mesh network in the sky. We are an international team of experts and engineers who have spent their careers expanding the boundaries and potential of space, now united in pursuit of a single vision. We value trust, open communication and collaboration to achieve the best results together.

Now we are looking for the best talents for our locations in Munich and Berlin to help us make our vision come true.

Your mission

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior 3GPP Architect with specialized expertise in protocol customization to join our dynamic team. As a Senior 3GPP Architect, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and optimizing telecommunications systems and protocols according to the latest 3GPP standards. Your primary responsibility will be to customize and tailor protocol specifications to meet the requirements of Rivada Space Systems Outernet.

This Includes


 * Leading the architecture and design of telecommunications systems based on 3GPP standards, ensuring compliance and interoperability
 * Customizing and extending existing protocol specifications to address specific project needs, incorporating new features and functionalities
 * Collaborating with cross-functional teams including software engineers, system architects, and product managers to define and implement protocol customization requirements
 * Conducting thorough analysis and evaluation of protocol performance, identifying areas for optimization and improvement
 * Staying updated on the latest advancements in 3GPP standards and telecommunications technologies, integrating relevant developments into our projects and solutions
 * Driving innovation and contributing to the development of new protocols, algorithms, and techniques to enhance the performance and capabilities of our telecommunications systems
   
   

What you bring on the table


 * Successfully completed a degree in Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
 * Extensive experience in telecommunications, with a focus on 3GPP standards and protocols :
    * Physical and MAC layer procedures
    * Channel structure: physical, transport and logical channels mapping
    * Signaling procedures: Random access, RRC connection setup, signaling radio bearers, system information block, master information block
    * Downlink and uplink transmission schemes
    * Registration management and access control
    * UE Identities: IMSI, IMEI, SUPI / SUCI, TMSI, RNTI

 * Proven expertise in protocol customization, including hands-on experience with modifying and extending protocol specifications
 * Strong understanding of wireless communication principles, including radio access networks (RAN), core network (CN), and protocols such as LTE, NR, and 5G
 * Familiar with software-defined networking (SDN) and network function virtualization (NFV) concepts
 * Proficiency in programming languages such as C/C++ and scripting languages like Python for protocol customization and implementatio
 * Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and optimize protocol performance
 * Effective communication skills and demonstrated leadership experience
 * Experienced in waterfall and agile methodologies
 * Strong vendor and suppliers management
 * Familiar with software-defined networking (SDN) and network function virtualization (NFV) concepts
 * Excellent written and spoken English
   

Why you should join us

We are an international team of space enthusiasts, following one great vision. We value equality in our work environment where different opinions, backgrounds and experiences are not only welcomed but also necessary to achieve the best result collaboratively.

This permanent position was created recently and thus offers a lot of creative freedom. Our approach is to create a modern work environment with hybrid working model. We offer an attractive salary depending on your experience.

Rivada Space Networks is an equal opportunity employer with the approach to create a diverse and inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, disability, or other individual characteristics.

About Us

 * Avionics System Design: Lead the design and development of avionics equipment, including but not limited to flight control systems, communication systems and other mission-critical avionics components.
 * Requirements Analysis: Collaborate with system architects and stakeholders to understand and translate system requirements into detailed avionics equipment specifications.
 * Simulation and Modelling: Utilise simulation tools to model and simulate avionics systems, ensuring that they meet performance and safety requirements. Optimise designs for efficiency and reliability.
 * Prototyping and Testing: Develop prototypes of avionics equipment in collaboration with our electronics design engineers for testing and validation. Conduct rigorous testing to verify functionality, performance, and reliability at board level and equipment level. Identify and address any issues through iterative testing.
 * Documentation: Prepare comprehensive design documentation, including Interface Control Document (ICD), bills of materials (BOM), Assembly Procedures, design verification plans, and test reports. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of design changes.
 * Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical engineers, software developers, Reliability Availability Maintainability Safety (RAMS) Expert and integration teams, to ensure seamless integration of avionics equipment into overall spacecraft systems.
 * Continuous Learning: Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in avionics design. Continuously enhance knowledge and skills through professional development activities.
   
   

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Avionics Equipment Design Engineer ideally, you will have the following:


 * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.
 * Proven experience in avionics equipment design, with a focus on aerospace applications.
 * Proficiency in avionics design tools and software
 * Understanding of space relevant standards (like ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK) and regulations.
 * Knowledge of safety-critical design principles
 * Familiarity with Reliability, Availability, Maintainability & Safety (RAMS) aspects : Failure Mode, Effects & Criticality Analysis (FMECA), Fault/Failure Detection, Isolation, and Recovery (FDIR), etc…
 * Familiarity with environmental and reliability considerations in avionics design
 * VHDL / Verilog basic knowledge
 * Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
 * Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams
 * Meticulous attention to detail in design, analysis, and documentation.
 * Hands on mentality at testing and problem debugging
   
   

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:


 * We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind
 * We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

title: Integration Architect Cloud Integration (CPI) (w/m/d)
description:
PROCLANE ist ein führendes Systemhaus für eCommerce, Data Integration und Beratung für digitale Prozesse. Im Geschäftsbereich PROCLANE Integration sind wir spezialisiert auf die Anbindung verschiedenster Unternehmens-Anwendungen. Du möchtest Teil unseres motivierten Entwickler-Teams in Hamburg oder Halle / Saale werden? Du suchst nach abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Projekte zu übernehmen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung als Integration Architect SAP Cloud Integration (CPI) (w/m/d) in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Wie arbeiten unsere Integration Architects CPI?

Unsere Integration Architects kümmern sich bei PROCLANE Integration um das Herzstück unserer Arbeit: die Anbindung verschiedenster Systeme. Das heißt, sie konzipieren und realisieren Prozesse, die unterschiedlichste Anwendungen unserer Kunden miteinander verbinden. Wie in einem Puzzle. Eines der Puzzleteile ist häufig ein Kunden-ERP-System, welches mit weiteren Teilen (beispielsweise Onlineshop, PIM-, CRM- oder Payment-System) verbunden wird.

Vor der technischen Umsetzung werden sogenannte Mappings erstellt, aus denen die Übertragung der Datenfelder vom Quell- an das Zielsystem inklusive etwaiger Funktionen oder Konfigurationen ersichtlich wird. Während der Systemintegration sind unsere Integration Architects via VPN auf die jeweiligen Kundensysteme geschaltet, das heißt, sie arbeiten remote von unserem Büro aus oder auch im Homeoffice. Die technische Umsetzung findet in der Cloudumgebung von SAP statt.

Aber sie müssen auch immer neue Lösungen für die Anforderungen unserer Kunden finden, die mit Integrationsprojekten ihre Digitalisierungsstrategie vorantreiben. Deshalb brauchen sie ein gutes Verständnis von Prozessen und Programmierung. Und sie dürfen sich nicht scheuen, mit unseren Kunden zu sprechen, die unter Umständen auch auf Englisch. Weil wir eng an deren Systemen arbeiten, ist die direkte Abstimmung oft der einfachste Weg, um Fragen zu klären.

Deine Aufgabe

Du betreust eigenständig deine meist deutschsprachigen und manchmal auch internationalen Integrations-projekte und bist dabei für die Konzeption, die Kommunikation sowie die technische Umsetzung der Integrationsprozesse zuständig. Ob ein ERP-System an einen Onlineshop oder ein CRM-System angebunden wird oder eine PIM-Integration auf der Wunschliste der Kunden steht: Du kümmerst dich bis zum Live-Gang und darüber hinaus.

Dein Profil

Das Arbeiten auf Cloud-Plattformen ist für Dich nichts Neues, idealerweise kennst Du Dich auch bereits mit der SAP Business Technology Platform und SAP Cloud Integration (CPI) aus. Du bist firm in XSLT und XPath und hast ein grundlegenes Verständnis von Web-Protokollen und -schnittstellen (HTTP, REST, SOAP). SQL, Datenbanken, XML und JSON sind für Dich keine Fremd-wörter? Perfekt! Wenn Dir dann auch noch die Arbeit im Team liegt, Du eine kunden- und ergebnisorienterte Denkweise hast und Dich Heraus-forderungen und Verantwortung reizen, bist Du bei uns absolut richtig!

Warum PROCLANE?

Wir glauben, dass Mitarbeiter nur in flachen Hierarchien und einem offenen Miteinander ihr Potenzial voll ausschöpfen können. Zu uns passt, wer sich stetig weiterentwickeln möchte und gern über den Tellerrand schaut. Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, gute Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, abwechslungsreiche Projekte, einen stets gefüllten Obstkorb und erfrischende Getränke. Und außerdem jede Menge Spaß bei unseren Team-Events.

Wann geht's los?

Wir suchen DICH zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt. Wenn du jetzt oder in näherer Zukunft bereit für eine neue Herausforderung bist,

dann sende uns gerne deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und Gehaltsvorstellung per E-Mail. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Das bringst du mit


 * einen Hochschulabschluss im Bereich (Wirtschafts-) Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
 * Erste Erfahrungen mit Cloud-Plattformen, optimalerweise mit der SAP Business Technology Platform und der SAP Cloud Integration (CPI)
 * Kenntnisse in XSLT und XPath
 * Verständnis von Web-Protokollen und -Schnittstellen (HTTP, REST, SOAP) und idealerweise Kenntnisse in einer objektorientierten Programmiersprache
 * Wissen in SQL, Datenbanken, XML und JSON
 * Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
   
   

Wir bieten dir


 * einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in der schönsten Stadt der Welt

Our Mission

We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation computing platforms. Position: Server High Performance Compute Microarchitecture Lead

We are seeking experienced CPU Subsystem Leads to join our team. If you possess a deep understanding of CPU system design and have a passion for architecting and designing complex, high performance and low power designs at advanced process nodes, we would be pleased to hear from you. This critical role involves microarchitecture of the next-generation CPU system by collaborating with other CPU and SoC architects to optimize overall Power, Performance, Area (PPA) efficiency.

The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of CPU and SoC architecture for datacenter SoCs, including experience in microarchitecture and design of coherent CPU subsystems. CPU subsystem microarchitecture involves design and deployment of data, control and debug features using interconnects, power management, RAS, and debug and trace blocks. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills are essential for excelling in this position.

Minimum Qualifications

 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
 * Over 10 years of experience in designing a high-performance compute subsystem for CPU, GPU, NPU, etc.
 * Experience in micro-architecture and/or design of one or more functional blocks of a CPU/SoC like L2/L3, directory, interconnects, etc.
 * Strong expertise in power management of a high-performance system including management of active power, idle low power and silicon/system limits
 * Strong expertise in defining and developing debug features associated with high performance designs
 * Strong technical documentation skills, along with excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

 * Master's in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
 * 15+ years in CPU and/or SoC Design.
 * Expertise in the design of multi-GHz processors with focus on critical path optimization
 * Experience with ARM ISA and AMBA protocols including CHI
 * Experience in design of coherent interconnects is a plus
 * Proven track record in hyperscale data center solutions.
 * Strong understanding DFx technologies like DFT, DFY, DFM
 * Expertise with developing RAS features

Key Responsibilities

 * Take on a leadership role in developing the micro-architecture and design of high-performance CPU subsytem
 * Develop High-Level Architecture and Micro-Architecture specifications that can translate to RTL design.
 * Deliver successful RTL design in collaboration with Design Verification and Physical Design teams.
 * Prepare and present clear and comprehensive technical documentation to meet the needs of stakeholders, including engineering teams, senior management and internal partners.

title: Safety Engineering Lead
description:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: ONLY APPLY WHEN YOU HAVE A VALID EU WORKING PERMIT. OTHERWISE, WE CANNOT CONSIDER YOUR APPLICATION.




Job Location: Munich, Lyon or Strasbourg




At Futurail, we're revolutionizing the rail industry by developing autonomous train technology. We're a passionate and experienced team of engineers and business experts who are driven to make a positive impact on the future of rail transportation.




Job Description:

As a Safety Engineering Lead based in our Munich, Lyon or Strasbourg office, you will be responsible for developing the safety case for our autonomous train technology, including safe obstacle detection. With no existing commercial rail-certified obstacle detection systems in the market, you must tackle this challenge with a highly creative and forward-thinking mindset. This role requires you to revisit the core principles of safety, extract valuable insights from other industries, and seamlessly integrate them while navigating the unique constraints of the rail environment.




Job Tasks:

 * Conduct standard safety steps of Risk Analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis, potentially with the help of externals
 * Elaborate a safety argumentation for an obstacle detection system using advanced perception sensors like camera, lidar and radar with classical and AI algorithms running on CPU and GPU computes
 * Collaborate with engineers and architects to ensure that all failure modes are handled properly and that our software and hardware architecture meets our safety goals
 * Implement processes, methods and tools needed to develop SIL 2 software
 * Write a railway safety file that will be accepted by Independent Safety Assessors and approval bodies like ERA, EPSF, EBA, and others
 * Promote a safety culture to all parts of our company




Requirements:

 * A minimum of 5 years of proven work experience with safety
 * Successful completion of homologation process of a commercial product
 * Understanding of different perception sensors such as LiDAR, camera, and radar, along with knowledge of computer specifications
 * Good communication skills to explain the argumentation of the safety case to assessors
 * Experience in the rail environment and with CENELEC norms is a big plus
 * Fluent in English and at least one of French or German
 * Openness to learn, pragmatism, ambition and fun to work with




Why Join Us:

At Futurail, we offer a dynamic and supportive work environment where you'll have the opportunity to make a real difference. You'll be surrounded by talented colleagues who are passionate about their work. We also offer competitive salaries and stock options.

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.

Department Description

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team’s expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform. The Global AI Practice is a CoE within Salesforce Professional Services, focused on helping organizations adopt our latest AI capabilities

Overview Of The Role

Engagement Senior Manager/Directors play a critical role in setting customers up for success by prescriptively shaping and then leading the execution of large and transformational engagements at our most strategic customers. Our Engagement Directors serve as a trusted advisor to Salesforce customers, providing guidance to Sales & Professional Services teams, ensuring alignments across each customer’s projects, and ensuring the highest levels of customer satisfaction. They are Salesforce platform experts who are accountable for ensuring customer success, business value and leading the Salesforce Services team assigned to their account(s). They drive delivery of the expected outcomes for each engagement and are internally and externally recognized as a business contributor, industry and product specialist.

Partnered With An Account Partner (Services Salesperson), The Engagement Senior Manager/Director Leads Both Pre And Post-sales Activities. They Are The Delivery Expert Across The Portfolio Of Products, Responsible For Developing And Articulating Comprehensive Implementation Proposals. They Will Then Maintain The Executive Relationships And Act As a Main Contact Within These Engagements In a Billable Capacity, Ensuring Tight Alignment, Offering Proactive And Prescriptive Advice Resulting In Outstanding Customer Success. This May Include The Following:


 * Pre-Sales alignment
 * Project kickoff
 * Bringing industry expertise and perspective
 * Drive better outcomes through extensive platform expertise
 * Deep understanding of Salesforce platform and solutions
 * Engagement planning and alignment to customer objectives
 * Regular customer sponsor check ins
 * Executive Relationship building
   
   

Are you passionate about Customer Success and would you like to work at the forefront of AI Innovation at one of the most exciting CRM companies?

Your Impact


 * Align closely with Account and Services Sales team by leading pre-sales activities such as the development of client-specific proposals, SOWs, staffing plans, engaging with SMEs across the organization to gain consensus on an acceptable proposal
 * Provide the Professional Services team with Subject Matter Expertise related to the proposed solution and client needs in order to ensure successful project delivery for AI, Automation & Data Strategy
 * Where appropriate and required for Customer Success, providing direct oversight to the project team during the full lifecycle of the engagement, acting as the point of contact for both the customer and Salesforce delivery teams
 * Successfully manage multiple strategic clients simultaneously
 * Recognized as a valuable and trusted advisor by our customers and other members of Salesforce and continue to build a reputation for excellence in professional services
 * Inspire people to do the best work of their careers, being a multiplier, amplifying the knowledge and capability of the people around you while continuing to provide an inclusive workplace as one of Best Places to Work.
 * Show continued professional growth and development
 * Act as an advisor on complex issues and engagements, exercising discretion and latitude in reaching critical goals.
 * Lead cross-functional teams and mentors others
 * Partner with the Go-to-Market Team (Services Sellers) to drive continued growth of services
 * Proactively mitigate and manage critical issues and at-risk accounts; communicate effectively and appropriately with internal and external leaders and executives
   
   

Required Qualifications


 * 7+ years of direct experience delivering and/or overseeing solutions on the Salesforce Platform.
 * 10+ years’ experience delivering consulting services, including team leadership and active involvement in selling professional services, including Advisory engagements
 * Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
 * Ability to travel; up to 50%
   
   

Preferred Requirements


 * 7+ years’ operating in a pre-sales environment, shaping and scoping large and complex implementation projects
 * 7+ years of enterprise-level project or program management experience
 * Salesforce Application and/or System Architect certifications
 * Demonstrated technical and/or functional proficiency, and ability to engage with architects or SMEs into pre-sales activities.
 * Extremely strong written and verbal communication skills, executive level presence and experience in working in a client advisory role
 * Demonstrated ability to influence a group audience, facilitate solutioning and lead discussions such as implementation methodology, Road mapping, Enterprise Transformation strategy, and executive-level requirement gathering sessions
 * Excellent analytical & problem solving skills
 * Proven ability to build strong working relationships across multiple functions/levels; adept at mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue
 * Understands cloud-based technologies; translates customer/business requirements into business solutions (and successfully positions with customers)
   
   

Note: By applying to the Engagement Senior Manager/Director posting, recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring for this role will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.

BENEFITS & PERKS


 * Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!
 * World-class enablement and on-demand training with Trailhead.com
 * Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1:1 coaching with leadership
 * Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1:1:1 model for giving back to the community
 * For more details, visit https://www.salesforcebenefits.com/
   
   

Accommodations

title: Project Manager (Remote)
description:
Job Description

Project Managers are the primary point of contact for our clients from project initiation through to closeout. The Project Manager is responsible for ensuring that projects are carried out to the best possible standards, within relevant timelines, at an acceptable cost and in line with overall company objectives, while meeting client requirements for deliverables. They are responsible for setting and meeting client expectations and communicating project progress to all the stakeholders in the project – the client, sales, and the operations team.

Remote, work from home opportunity. Monday through Friday, regular business hours.

Responsibilities


 * Provide exceptional service.
 * Work with sales to help plan projects and ensure they are scoped in a cost-effective manner.
 * Attend transition/kick-off calls.
 * Oversee status calls with clients and internal resources.
 * Take responsibility for all aspects of an individual project once the contract is agreed.
 * Deliver projects on time and to budget, and to client satisfaction.
 * Provide pricing input related to any project requirements.
 * Provide project specific reporting as required by the client and internal stakeholders.
 * Develop relationships with appropriate client representatives.
 * Work with the Project Office Team to ensure that project documentation is maintained.
 * Ensure that project knowledge is shared with other members of the team.
 * Ensure all project financials are appropriately managed, forecasted, and invoiced.
   
   
   

Further Role Duties


 * Essential Function: Successfully manage complex concurrent projects from project win to completion.
 * Desired Result: Deliver projects which meet or exceed client expectations.
 * Essential Function: Provide complete and timely communications to KLDiscovery clients ensuring that at all levels of the client organisation, the project status is understood.
 * Desired Result: Client expectations are understood by KLDiscovery and the client has an appropriate understanding of project status and futures.
 * Essential Function: Provide appropriate work direction to all internal KLDiscovery personnel assigned to execute the project.
 * Desired Result: KLDiscovery staff can deliver projects which meet or exceed client expectations.
 * Essential Function: Act as a liaison between internal KLDiscovery personnel and KLDiscovery’s client to facilitate successful project completion.
 * Desired Result: Information is accurately communicated in a manner that each party can understand.
 * Essential Function: Facilitate project meetings and internal communication between KLDiscovery staff to ensure projects are completed correctly and on time.
 * Desired Result: Takes ownership and ensures timely completion of action items to maintain project schedule.
 * Essential Function: Carry out all appropriate processes and procedures to ensure correct forecasting of revenue and invoicing of client project.
 * Desired Result: Correct financial forecast and invoices are made to the appropriate stakeholders.
   
   
   

Experience


 * Degree or equivalent qualification preferred.
 * Fluency in English and German are required.
 * Legal/industry knowledge or experience is essential.
 * Hands on experience with an e-Discovery review platform, such as Relativity
 * Significant project management experience within Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM) where this has involved extension and ongoing liaison (face to face, phone, and email) with external clients.
 * Proven ability to lead multiple projects and multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
 * Must have previous experience of facilitating meetings and following complex/detailed processes.
 * High degree of interpersonal sensitivity to allow building of relationships with experienced, qualified staff and clients.
 * Solid written and verbal communication skills – ability to communicate with individuals at all levels.
 * Strong ability to work autonomously; identifies and presents solutions; confident decision-making ability.
 * Strong attention to detail.
 * Technical aptitude and financial appreciation.
 * Ability to work effectively within a team environment.
   
   
   

What We Offer

At KLD we invest in employees and their families by placing their wellbeing first. We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is 60,000 to 80,000 EUR.


 * This position is 100% remote and we offer a high-performance laptop computer, options for wireless headset or external speaker, up to two 24" 2K monitors and a mobile phone for business use.
 * A friendly and welcoming team-oriented environment
 * Opportunities for career advancement and growth
 * Paid benefits
   
   
   

Our Cultural Values

Entrepreneurs At Heart, We Are a Customer First Team Sharing One Goal And One Vision. We Seek Team Members Who Are


 * Humble - No one is above another; we all work together to meet our clients’ needs and we acknowledge our own weaknesses
 * Hungry - We all are driven internally to be successful and to continually expand our contribution and impact
 * Smart - We use emotional intelligence when working with one another and with clients
   
   
   

Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

Who We Are

KLDiscovery provides technology-enabled services and software to help law firms, corporations, government agencies and consumers solve complex data challenges. The company, with offices in 26 locations across 17 countries, is a global leader in delivering best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance and data recovery solutions to support the litigation, regulatory compliance, internal investigation and data recovery and management needs of our clients.

Serving clients for over 30 years, KLDiscovery offers data collection and forensic investigation, early case assessment, electronic discovery and data processing, application software and data hosting for web-based document reviews, and managed document review services. In addition, through its global Ontrack Data Recovery business, KLDiscovery delivers world-class data recovery, email extraction and restoration, data destruction and tape management.

KLDiscovery has been recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in North America by both Inc. Magazine (Inc. 5000) and Deloitte (Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500) and CEO Chris Weiler has been honored as a past Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year™. Additionally, KLDiscovery is an Orange-level Relativity Best in Service Partner, a Relativity Premium Hosting Partner and maintains ISO/IEC 27001 Certified data centers.

KLDiscovery is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

For more information about the Legal Technologies business at KLDiscovery in Europe please visit www.kldiscovery.com

The successful candidate must be fluent in German, both written and verbal is essential!

INPLAN has been developing standard software solutions for ports, port terminals, and logistics service providers for 30 years. Our customers include renowned names such as the Port of Aqaba, BASF, Bayernhafen Group, Port of Beirut, and many more. We digitize operational processes at over 50 locations, making us the market leader in port and terminal management solutions.

Here is a little window into our company: INPLAN was acquired by Valsoft and now operates under the Aspire Software portfolio. Aspire Software, the operational arm of Valsoft Corp, operates and manages Valsoft's global portfolio of wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Aspire delivers a time-sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

Our motto is "Be Humble, Stay Hungry."

The successful candidate will work in a hybrid work model anywhere within commutable distance of our office in Mülheim an der Ruhr!

What Your Day Will Look Like


 * Project Management: Leading and structuring customer projects, including project planning, communication, coordination, and control
 * Sales: Supporting the sales team and independently handling sales activities, especially for modules and change requests of existing customers
 * Customer Presentations: Conducting presentations, workshops, and user interviews
 * Team Leadership: Leading interdisciplinary project teams
 * Process Analysis: Analyzing and structuring the business processes of our customers, creating technical specifications and concepts
 * Product Development: Contributing your own ideas and concepts for product development
   
   

About You


 * Education: Degree or vocational training in IT project management, industrial engineering, computer science, mathematics, business administration, or equivalent qualifications
 * Experience: Professional experience in process analysis, design, and digitalization. Ideally, experience in project management
 * Skills: High degree of independence, strong focus on teamwork and customer service, flexibility, and passion for new topics
 * Abilities: Structured and goal-oriented work approach, enjoyment of different project aspects (business-related, organizational, analytical-conceptual, communicative)
 * Software Proficiency: Proficiency in relevant software tools and methods
 * Languages: Fluent in German (written and verbal), good command of English
 * Mobility: Driver's license and willingness to travel to customers domestically and internationally
 * Fluent in German, both written and verbal, is essential
 * At least a professional level of English
 * Legally authorized to work in Germany
   
   

What We Offer


 * An interesting and varied job with the opportunity to contribute your own ideas
 * Entry into one of the most exciting growth industries

 * Open work environment
   
   

For information about INPLAN, please visit our website at www.inplan.de

title: Senior Project Planner
description:
Senior Project Planner - HVDC Projects - Berlin, Germany




Are you ready to shape the future of power transmission and lead groundbreaking grid upgrade projects? We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Project Planner to oversee major HVDC project in Northern Europe. This role involves managing project execution, coordinating with clients, and conducting site visits. Flexibility for travel is required, with potential for future projects in the wider region.




The Company

You would be working for a leading global technology company with a strong focus on providing innovative and sustainable energy solutions. Renowned for its rich heritage and unwavering commitment to excellence, the company specialises in delivering advanced power transmission and distribution systems, renewable energy solutions, and smart grid technologies. Its diverse portfolio prioritises energy efficiency and environmental responsibility, shaping a brighter, sustainable future for communities worldwide.




Role & Responsibilities:

 * Key contributor to the project team, responsible for providing schedule updates to the Project Manager and Lead Project Planner.
 * Develops and maintains the project schedule by integrating inputs from all functions, units, and third parties involved.
 * Communicates schedule status to the Lead Planner, Project Manager, suppliers, and third parties.
 * Conducts schedule analyses to identify risks and opportunities, collaborating with the team to implement mitigation strategies.
 * Delivers look-ahead reports, backlog updates, and future late reports with prioritization to address risks and support project priorities.
 * Provides regular status reports, including forecasts and analytics, to the project team.
 * Prepares contractually required customer reports and liaises with customers on scheduling matters.
 * Performs critical path analyses, addressing multiple critical and near-critical paths.
 * Develops and evaluates "what-if" scenarios to optimize project execution in collaboration with the team.
 * Aligns schedule with cost control functions to ensure synchronization of cost and schedule for accurate project execution.
 * Supports change order analysis with scheduling insights and forecasts.
 * Manages resource loading and allocation within the project schedule.




Requirements:

 * Graduate in Engineering or Economics with several years of experience in planning management as part of project teams.
 * Proficient in applying planning control principles, including WBS, critical path analysis, progress tracking, and resource loading.
 * Skilled in using Primavera P6.
 * Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in German would be advantageous.
 * Strong team collaboration skills with the ability to actively contribute to decision-making.
 * Demonstrates critical analysis of data, with rigour, transparency, and attention to detail.
 * Proactive, solution-oriented, with strong anticipation and problem-solving abilities.
 * Experience in organisational and strategic planning processes is highly valued.
 * Knowledge of planning integration principles and methods.
 * Competent in contract management, including preparing EOT claims and supporting negotiations.
 * Familiarity with risk management, critical path analysis (CPA), and EOT/delay analysis.
 * Experience in substation projects is an asset.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
About Us

Korn Ferry is a global organizational consulting firm. We help clients synchronize strategy and talent to drive superior performance. We work with organizations to design their structures, roles, and responsibilities. We help them hire the right people to bring their strategy to life. And we advise them on how to reward, develop, and motivate their people.

Our 10,000 colleagues serve clients in more than 50 countries. We offer five core solutions:


 * Organizational Strategy
 * Assessment and Succession
 * Talent Acquisition
 * Leadership Development
 * Total Rewards
   
   

Job Description

The Project Coordinator will coordinate all operational aspects of small to medium size client projects and will support Project Managers in executing large global client projects.

Project Coordinators serve as a key resource for keeping project execution on track internally through project planning and monitoring.

Primary Responsibilities


 * Partner with the client team to define project scope and objectives to work out clear and achievable deliverables.
 * Create a clear and detailed project plan (may include resourcing, planning, risk mitigation, quality control and organizational requirements) that can be validated and executed upon.
 * Autonomously manage the execution, withing given scope and supported by senior colleagues (which may include multiple consulting work-streams, multiple stakeholders, and multiple countries)
 * Scheduling, tracking and monitoring of projects and internal & external meetings
 * Coordinate, plan, monitor and drive project activities, manage project risks and resources, and take corrective actions when necessary to guarantee that the project is delivered according to the project plan and expectations.
 * Track project financials, together with the revenue manager, including monitoring the budget, revenue forecasting, billing process, time and expenses, invoicing, and that to keep and maintain a financially healthy project.
 * Communicate and escalate with key stakeholders on the project status regarding forecast, completion rates, variances, billings, and backlog on projects.
 * Serve as primary point of contact for client information, updates, delivery, issue resolution and data tracking.
 * Ensure customer satisfaction and professional client interactions through seamless delivery of Korn Ferry solutions to clients in order to develop and foster a trusted partnership.
 * Develop expertise in Korn Ferry’s solutions to be able to understand the client’s context and needs and how the project needs to be designed and managed.
 * Other duties as assigned.
   
   

Professonial Experience, Other Qualifications & Skills


 * 1-3 years of experience in project or account management with an understanding of business and effective management practices.
 * Experience with global project management preferred.
 * Advanced proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint with the ability to learn challenging internal software programs.
 * Experience with Smartsheet, or other project management tools and/or SAP is a plus. Ideal candidate has experience in working in training or consulting firm whose focus is people performance improvement.
 * High detail orientation with the ability to understand the big picture.
 * Strong critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills.
 * Ability to anticipate problems and identify alternative solutions.
 * Excellent interpersonal skills to build relationships with cross-functional and remote teams, at all levels of the organization, both internally and with clients.
 * Excellent organizational and follow-through skills; able to prioritize and manage many simultaneous tasks and priorities.
 * Willingness to adhere to established processes while keeping an eye for opportunities to improve or develop processes, structures, and systems.
 * Business skills and aptitudes necessary to accurately manage project budget, monitor expenses, and ensure accurate invoicing and collections.
 * Comfort in working with people from diverse backgrounds (e.g., race, gender, orientation, cultural, etc.).
 * Occasional travel is likely.
 * Language requirements: German - native, English - fluent

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.




Could you be the full Site Project Planning Manager (f/m/d) in Hennigsdorf we’re looking for?




Your Future Role

2,100 colleagues from 46 countries, including 800 engineers, shape in Hennigsdorf the future of rail mobility. The locally developed, manufactured, and maintained product range includes high-speed, regional, and local trains, subways, as well as trams and light rail vehicles. Our product line Rolling Stock & Components offers products from the broadest portfolio in the rail industry. Our innovation focus is on green and smart solutions, including emission-free propulsion systems such as batteries and hydrogen. You’ll report to Matthias Müller, the Site Planning Director and work alongside a dedicated and enthusiastic team.






We’ll look for you to :

 * Manage and develop the competencies of the project planning team, allocating work effectively among team members.
 * Contribute to the development and deployment of company-wide planning standards and training initiatives.
 * Oversee the planning portfolio for Hennigsdorf, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.
 * Periodically evaluate and propose enhancements to the company's time management processes and promote a culture of effective time management within the project team.
 * Analyze tender documentation to understand schedule management requirements, set timelines for tender preparation, and ensure adherence to deadlines.
 * Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to define project schedule interfaces and integrate inputs into the overall project schedule.
 * Identify critical paths and risks within the project schedule, suggesting optimization and mitigation actions as necessary.
 * Develop high-quality schedules that meet company procedures, contractual requirements, and stakeholder inputs, while optimizing for on-time delivery and resource utilization.
 * Lead regular project schedule review sessions, challenging stakeholders' assumptions and encouraging collaborative problem-solving.
 * Educate project teams on scheduling issues and provide training and support to other planners to enhance their skills and understanding.




All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

 * Engineering degree
 * Project management and industrial background
 * Knowledge of different scheduling tools (P6, OdyC, MSProject)

 * Rigorous, structured and sense of anticipation
 * English fluent, German a plus

 * Optimise work-life balance with flexible working hours and hybrid working models
 * Explore growth opportunities and steer your career across functions and countries
 * Benefit from excellent training opportunities through our award-winning Alstom University and participate in the company's innovation culture through idea management programmes
 * Thrive in a modern and collaborative workplace featuring mentor and buddy programs, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR activities, and engaging employee event




You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

title: (Senior) Project Delivery Manager (all genders) | ClimateTech
description:
Intro

Carbmee is an enterprise software company headquartered in Berlin and with offices in Berlin and Munich. We offer a cloud solution that enables companies to analyse, manage & reduce their carbon footprint. We measure our success in the greenhouse gas emission reduction of our customers.

Your Role & Mission - We are looking for an experienced (Senior) Project Delivery Manager to join a great team in Berlin and succeed in our mission. You’ll be responsible for overseeing, planning, and ensuring execution of technical projects with our Engineering and Product teams. Are you passionate about managing project planning and development and leading collaboration among different parts of the business? Do you enjoy managing projects, and resources and coordinating teams in alignment with the organization’s objectives?

Then come join us to help shape the way of becoming the industry standard in fighting climate change!

Our Hiring Process - Our Engineering team is growing fast and we are seeking talented Project Managers across different backgrounds and experience levels. We know that each level of experience involves its own set of challenges and expectations, and the hiring process is tailored accordingly to evaluate all candidates effectively. That means each interview step is focused on assessing both technical and soft skills across our engineering competency framework. Chosen candidates will receive an offer package that aligns with their mid-level or senior level of experience, including additional perks and benefits.

Your tasks


 * Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables between Product and Engineering teams in alignment with organizational goals
 * Manage multiple, concurrent projects ensuring quality, on-time and smooth implementation, including API projects
 * Create detailed project plans, communicate their progress, and lead the engineering teams through the planning, execution, monitoring, and closing stages
 * Manage cross-functional teams and delegate tasks and responsibilities, ensuring all parties are aligned and resources are allocated according to project planning
 * Identify opportunities for process improvements in project delivery and execution
 * Always improve and implement best practices, guiding team members, resolving issues and dependencies, and facilitating teamwork throughout the project
 * Identify potential risks, create mitigation plans, and take corrective action when necessary
 * Ensure adherence to compliance and quality standards throughout the project
 * Lead project reporting and documentation best practices, monitor and calculate KPIs and ensure documentation is maintained throughout the project
 * Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders regarding feature development and prepare regular status reports for senior management and internal stakeholders
 * Help fellow team members with your experience and work closely with our Head of Engineering, Head of Product, and Engineering Leads supporting the execution of the product roadmap
 * Join the Carbmee team in Berlin and get the unique opportunity to work with some of the biggest organizations in the world to help them reduce carbon emissions
   
   

Your profile


 * You have at least 4 years of professional experience as a Project Manager or Delivery Manager in a software company
 * Impeccable project management skills and proven expertise in managing technical projects with engineering and product teams
 * A recognized project management certification is a must-have (eg. PMP)
 * Strong understanding of project management methodologies and proficiency in project management software. We use ClickUp.
 * You have hands-on experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and keeping teams on track to meet tight deadlines
 * Strong analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to share your knowledge with the rest of the team
 * You rely on solid communication skills and you speak English at a fluent level
 * You work well across distributed and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment
 * A supportive team player with a strong work ethic, eager to learn and work independently as well as in a team environment
 * You are passionate about business sustainability, carbon emissions management, and climate tech in alignment with Carbmee’s mission and vision
 * You are excited to join our diverse and international team onsite in Berlin and shape the future of carbon management with us
   
   

Don't feel like you meet all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. We'll let you in on a little secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Carbmee is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work on a Monday morning.

Benefits


 * Unique & Powerful Mission - join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
 * Compensation & Rewards - a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package including virtual stock options
 * Health & Wellbeing - Urban Sports Club subscription to stay healthy & fit.1:1 coaching sessions with Nilohealth for your mental well-being.
 * Carbmee Summer Fridays - you get every Friday in August off!
 * Flexibility & Work-Life Balance - a flexible hybrid or fully remote working culture with a lovely accessible office in Berlin-Mitte or in the center of Munich
 * Learning & Development - €1,000 individual learning budget to learn and grow according to your development plans and personal aspirations
 * Team Culture - our Transparency, Humility, and Accountability values create a unique and supportive working environment. Be part of a multinational, motivated team that thinks work should be fun!
 * Connection & Networking - Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events. We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
 * Trust & Transparency - monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals
   
   

About Us

Carbmee GmbH was founded in early 2021 with the goal of helping businesses report, reduce and manage their carbon emissions. The Environmental Intelligence System, carbmee EIS™ is a purpose-built carbon management platform for enterprises with complex supply chains. The platform is compliant with all international standards and is capable of automated and holistic calculation of carbon footprints on a product, company, and supply chain level. Read more about us at https://www.carbmee.com/

title: Project Manager - The World Forum
description:
Position: Project Manager - The World Forum

Location: Berlin, Germany (on site)

Contract period: Unlimited

Remuneration: Competitive, based on experience

Application deadline: Rolling basis, early applications preferred.




The Cinema for Peace Foundation is looking for a Project Manager for the project "The World Forum on the Future of Democracy, Tech, and Humankind" to join the Cinema for Peace team in Berlin.




Since 9/11, 2001 the Cinema for Peace initiative has been aiming to influence through films the perception and resolution of global social, political, and humanitarian challenges of our time - and especially to oppose war and terror. In recent years, Cinema for Peace has supported a number of important causes and films with artists like Angelina Jolie, Brad Pitt, Leonardo DiCaprio, George Clooney, Julia Roberts, Charlize Theron, Nicole Kidman, and personalities such as the Dalai Lama, Muhammad Ali, Bill and Hillary Clinton, Mikhail Gorbachev, and the former Honorary Patron Nelson Mandela.




The World Forum on the Future of Democracy, Tech, and Humankind will be an annual conference held in Berlin, Germany, that unites leaders from politics, civil society, and culture, engaged in the ideas and practices for a better world and fundamental change. The World Forum serves as a platform where the pressing socio-political issues of our time are discussed and tackled; while providing an opportunity for official and unofficial diplomatic encounters, which may pave the way for progress on democracy and peace as well as justice and freedoms. Every suitable panel will be followed by a lawmaking workshop where blueprint legislation will be developed with the goal of being used all over the world.




Responsibilities:

 * Manage and lead the organising of The World Forum and associated events.
 * Develop concept notes and strategies in close cooperation with the team.
 * Liaise with existing and potential partners and donors in building stability of relationships, as well as identify and bring new donors and partners for the project.
 * Prepare and execute invitations to keynote speakers and panel partcipants, including heads of state, nobel laureates, and other influential personalities.
 * Liaise with potential partner organizations, charity organizations, as well as high-ranking individuals from governments and ICSOs to explore possibilities of cooperation and synergy in projects.
 * Support the organizing of high-profile advocacy and fundraising events associated with the project.
 * Organise event logistics.
 * Oversee human resource management and recruitment.




Requirements:

 * Educational Qualifications in the field of Human Rights, International Relations, or other related fields
 * 5+ years of experience managing similar high profile projects or events on an international level.
 * Strong knowledge of global sociopolitical issues.
 * Written and Spoken fluency in English is required. German in a strong asset.
 * Experience managing and drafting concept notes and budgets.




If you are interested, please apply with your CV and a one-page cover letter in one PDF file through Linkedin.




 * We are accepting applications on a rolling basis, therefore early applications are preferred. Due to the high number of applications, we will only respond to shortlisted candidates.

description:

We provide critical services and solutions to European & national agencies and institutions, the scientific community, the commercial sector, as well as to the wider public. The European Space market is dynamic, evolving and rapidly growing. CGI is now looking to further expand our business in this area, building on our more than 40-year successful heritage. We are therefore seeking a Project Manager (m/f/d) to support this growth.

As a Project Manager (m/f/d) you will get insights into our activities within our ground segment services, infrastructure and software business, working directly together with our clients in the Space domain. You will have end-to-end responsibility of one or more of our projects, both towards the client and towards our internal organization. You will be responsible for managing the project’s client, the project team and you will ensure that the project schedule is executed in-line with everybody’s expectations, considering scope, cost, and time. risk, change, supplier and procurement management will be as important as managing the quality within the project. Outstanding communication skills in front of the various stakeholders will be of great importance. Besides the usual controlling activities on your project(s), monitoring and reporting progress towards the client and CGI’s internal management is key for the role.

Aufgaben

As a Project Manager (m/f/d) you:


 * will ensure that the project deliverables are provided in time, in cost and in-line with the quality expectations.
 * develop and manage an integrated project plan with realistic and effective schedules, financial budgets, resources, and risk mitigations, to meet milestones and contractual obligations.
 * will engage with your clients, identifying needs and opportunities and leading change.
 * act as a servant project leader who leads through context, empowerment, and enabling of your project team.
 * will identify and manage project risks and opportunities.
 * will effectively manage stakeholder relationships with our customers and partners.
 * support negotiation of contract changes
 * lead communication and reporting with customers and suppliers.
 * ensure scope, change, and claim management throughout the project lifecycle.
 * are accountable for planning and execution of projects with multi-disciplined teams (engineering, testing, quality, accounting) ranging in size and complexity.
 * document and communicate project progress and status to all stakeholders.
   
   

You will receive extensive support and training to equip you with the CGI tools for project managers.

Qualifikation


 * Proven record of 5+ years having managed end-to-end IT, infrastructure and software projects, ideally in the space domain.
 * Ability to work closely with technical teams to understand and grasp concepts and issues and translate those to schedule and cost impacts with a balanced approach to risk.
 * Proven experience of implementing and managing project contracts.
 * Experience in a variety of project management frameworks including Agile.
 * Project Management Certification through PMI, IPMA or similar.
 * Knowledge of space mission systems engineering (e.g. ECSS) or MBSE is a big plus.
 * Experience in leading and managing diverse multidisciplinary engineering teams.
 * Excellent communication, leadership and negotiation skills.
 * Networked thinking, planning skills, assertiveness, and high resilience as well as a curious and open mindset.
 * Proven ability to deliver solutions under pressure and to tight timescales.
 * Technical affinity is a plus.
 * Fluency in spoken and written German & English.
   
   

What We Offer

CGI offers our employees an exciting and flexible work environment in which to build their careers. This is especially reflected within our Space business which offers a corporate culture built around diverse teams, international collaboration, flat hierarchies and open communication.

CGI’s values emphasise our commitment to work in partnership with our clients by providing objectivity and integrity in all of our undertakings, whilst also delivering quality solutions and services. We also place a strong focus on Corporate Social Responsibility, encouraging and supporting our employees in the continuous improvement of the economic, social and environmental well-being of the communities in which they live and work. This is further reflected in the company’s commitment to be carbon neutral by 2030.

Consistent with our dream of creating an environment in which we enjoy working together, CGI is committed to fostering and maintaining professional workplaces that respect the dignity of all members. CGI is unconditionally inclusive and we are constantly evolving and creating new network that support and promote the richness of our diversity, equity and inclusion across our organization.

In addition to the above, CGI offers the following:


 * At CGI, we view our professionals as company owners. A set percentage of your salary can be invested in CGI shares, and CGI matches your contribution, up to a set maximum.
 * Flexible working hours and conditions to optimise your work/life balance (35h-40h/week), 30 days of holidays, numerous special leave days (e.g. wedding, birth, relocation, etc.)
 * In addition, sabbatical or parental leave is supported.
 * Company car & bicycle leasing schemes
 * JobTicket for public transport throughout Hessen, for both business and personal use
 * Emergency childcare support
 * Corporate benefits providing attractive CGI employee discounts from well-known brands and providers.
 * A strong focus on continued learning and development
 * An exciting, challenging and diverse environment where you can grow your career as part of a great team
 * A great corporate culture built around international collaboration, flat hierarchies and open communication
 * A company committed to be carbon neutral by 2030 with a strong focus on Corporate Social Responsibility – contributing to the communities we live in.
   
   

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten!

Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

TetraScience is catalyzing the Scientific AI revolution by designing and industrializing AI-native scientific data sets, which it brings to life in a growing suite of next generation lab data management products, scientific use cases, and AI-based outcomes. For more information, please visit tetrascience.com.

Our core values are designed to guide our behaviors, actions, and decisions such that we operate as one. We are looking to add individuals to our team that demonstrate the following values:


 * Transparency and Context- We execute on our ambitious mission by starting with radical data transparency and business context. We openly and proactively share all vital data and make it actionable, so our employees and stakeholders can solve any problem presented to them

 * Fearlessness and Resilience- We must be fearless and resilient to fulfill our potential. We proactively run toward challenges of all types, we unblinkingly acknowledge and confront the brutal facts - which all innovative growth companies invariably face - and we embrace uncertainty and take calculated risks
 * Alignment with Customers- We know that our customers' success is our success. We are honored and humbled by their commitment to us, and we are completely committed to ensuring they achieve their mission to unlock the world's most important scientific innovations
 * Commitment to Craft- We take our craft seriously and seek to be best-in-class in all we do, regardless of our functional role, seniority, or tenure. We are members of one team that combines intellectual horsepower and curiosity, humility, and empathy to ensure we are always learning and evolving
 * Equality of Opportunity- We cannot imagine our journey without a workforce which reflects humanity's diversity. We seek out the best of the best who bring with them unique and invaluable perspectives and talents and embody our common values - regardless of gender, ethnicity, race, or age
   
   
   

What You Will Do

The TetraScience Senior Program Manager will report to the Professional Services team and will be responsible for the management of implementations and services of the Tetra Data Platform for new clients. This entails oversight throughout each project to ensure TetraScience meets or exceeds client expectations in a continuous improvement environment.


 * The Senior Program Manager responsibilities will include the following: client/internal project kick-off meetings, client update meetings, resource planning, timeline and deliverables management, oversight to financial aspects of services and project closure

 * Measurable past performance of efficiently managing the delivery and support of multiple simultaneous projects by leveraging project management tools
 * Demonstrated collaborative communication and influencing skills
   
   
   

Ideal If You Have


 * Deep experience in Life Sciences and Pharma workflows, especially surrounding drug design and development, biologics, automation, or new modalities
 * Thrives in an environment with multiple simultaneous efforts across diverse experiences
 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Chemistry, Business, or related field; or equivalent work experience
 * Strong on PM implementation exposure to a cloud environment, specifically AWS is a compelling advantage
 * Proven project/program leadership experience in an agile, customer-facing deployment environment
 * Highly effective verbal and written communication skills; ability to explain technical information in non-technical language to drive progress
 * Ability to distill and present complex information to a wide range of stakeholders
 * Knowledge or understanding of GxP compliance-related activities such as Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) is ideal
   
   
   

Benefits


 * Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company
 * Supportive, team-oriented culture of continuous improvement
 * Generous paid time off (PTO)
 * Flexible working arrangements - Remote work
