title: Senior Product Manager - Fraud Prevention
description:
About Us

Futurae is a Swiss Cybersecurity company enabling users to seamlessly authenticate to online, mobile, and smart home device applications. Security and Usability are at the heart of Futurae customer-centric innovations, and what we do, every day. Join our young, international, and fast-paced team with experienced industry leaders hard at work shaping the future of online authentication and fraud prevention by solving some of its toughest challenges and at the same time creating outstanding user experiences. Futurae operates in financial services and insurances with increasing exposure in other industries. Visit our website at www.futurae.com to learn more about our solutions and team.

Your role

As a Product Manager at Futurae, you'll have a hands-on role in shaping and launching our Anti-fraud platform—a new product line focused on preventing fraud in online interactions. The platform uses data to detect suspicious behavior and contexts, offering tools to help businesses stay a step ahead of fraudsters.

You'll be taking charge of the Anti-fraud platform in its early stages, building on the foundation that's already in place while driving the development of its next key features. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact by shaping the direction of the platform's evolution.

To succeed in this role, you'll need a strong understanding of market needs and business impact, along with the ability to work in a technical space. Since you'll be working closely with our data science and engineering teams, experience in data science or engineering would be a big plus.

Responsibilities:


 * Identify fraud and risk areas not yet covered by our current Anti-fraud platform
 * Collect feedback from customers and internal teams to identify and prioritize opportunities for deeper exploration
 * Create and maintain a roadmap for future enhancements and expansions of the Anti-fraud platform
 * Oversee the development of the solution, getting into details with data scientists and engineers on design decisions and execution prioritization
 * Develop business cases, product requirements, and go-to-market plans
 * Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product performance and drive improvements
   
   
   

Requirements

Mandatory requirement:


 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science or relevant field or equivalent practical experience; Masters, or advanced degree is a plus
 * CEFR C2 english proficiency or native speaker
 * 5+ years of combined work experience as Product Manager, Data Scientist or Software Engineering
 * Basic understanding of cryptography, public/symmetric key crypto in particular
   
   
   

Four or more of these skills:


 * Experience in digital fraud, ideally in the financial industry
 * Knowledge of related regulations and laws (e.g., PSD3)
 * Proven project management, coordination and communication capabilities. You make sure everyone is aligned and working towards a common goal
 * Familiarity with Atlassian product suite, Jira and Confluence above all
 * Experience building SaaS (Software as a Service) products in cybersecurity, fraud, or building complex on-premise B2E products
 * (Highly preferred) You have the ability to read code and engage with developers or Data Scientists about technical topics
 * (Highly preferred) You have experience with GCP cloud environment or equivalent products (Azure, AWS)
   
   
   

Bonus Points:


 * Experience with tools such as Figma, Gitlab, Github, Google Data Studio
 * Experience working in a startup or scaleup
 * Understanding of banking, online payments, identity & access management, digital wallets
   
   
   

Benefits


 * Join a young, international, and fast-paced Cybersecurity company with experienced industry leaders and PHD graduates from top tier world wide universities
 * Work at the forefront of an inspiring, dynamic company in the B2B space in the area of end user authentication and transaction confirmation
 * Be part of our friendly, knowledge-sharing, entrepreneurial culture and flat hierarchy
 * Work in a role that lets you learn and gives you responsibility and independence
 * Books and opportunities to attend conferences

title: Product Manager (d/w/m) - Transaction Log
description:
Paymenttools hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Zahlungslandschaft für Händler in Europa zu verändern. Mit mehr als 4,4 Milliarden Besuchern pro Jahr in unseren mehr als 15.000 REWE Group Märkten und Reisebüros in 21 Ländern wissen wir genau, was Verbraucher und Händler brauchen, wenn es ums Bezahlen geht. Wir glauben fest daran, Zahlungen nahtlos und unsichtbar zu machen und sie mit Vaule Added Services im Rahmen eines zuverlässigen Identitätsdienstes zu verknüpfen. Unser Mantra: #wesolvepayn. Wir verbinden modernste Technologie mit strenger Sicherheit, um sensible Zahlungsdaten zu schützen und gleichzeitig Innovationen in einer Cloud-nativen Technologieumgebung zu fördern.

Als Product Manager (d/w/m) bei Paymenttools hast Du die Möglichkeit, ein Transaction Log von Grund auf neu aufzubauen und dabei unser Legacy System abzulösen. Durch die erfolgreichen Bereitstellung von qualitativ hochwertigen Produkten in der Payment Industrie, stellst Du die Erfüllung unserer Kundenbedürfnisse sicher und trägst dazu bei unseren Geschäftserfolg noch erfolgreicher zu machen. Dein Fachwissen in den Bereichen Produktmanagement, agile Methoden und Führung spielt bei der Leitung deines Entwicklungsteams eine entscheidende Rolle.

Deine Aufgaben


 * Du bist für die Aufbereitung und Bereitstellung von EFT-Transaktionsdaten (Electronic Funds Transfer) für den stationären und eCommerce-Handel verantwortlich.
 * Du erarbeitest und pflegst eine Produkt-Roadmap, priorisierst Features, Add-Ons und Initiativen auf Basis von Kundenbedürfnissen, Geschäftszielen und technischen Rahmenbedingungen.
 * Du wechselst zwischen geschäftlichen zu technischen Kontexten, um dabei eng mit dem Engineering, dem Design und anderen cross-funktionalen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und die erfolgreiche Umsetzung der Produkt-Roadmap sicherzustellen.
 * Du koordinierst und planst den Produkt Release, arbeitest mit den Entwicklungsteams zusammen, um Meilensteine festzulegen, und verwaltest Deine Produkte dafür anhand entsprechender Metriken.
 * Du verfügst über einen Trend- und Innovationsradar und holst Dir Anregungen für neue Produkte aus der Bewertung von Markttrends, Kundenfeedback sowie unserer Wettbewerbslandschaft, um die Produkt-Roadmap zu verfeinern und anzupassen und fundierte Entscheidungen über Produktverbesserungen und -optimierungen zu treffen.
 * Du arbeitest eng mit dem Go-To-Market-Team zusammen, um unsere Kunden mit zeitgemäßen Produkten zu begeistern und Support-Mitarbeitende, Buchhaltende und Fachleuten aus dem operativen Geschäft die Arbeit zu erleichtern, wenngleich nicht sogar erst möglich.
   
   

Deine Erfahrungen


 * Du zeigst ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten zur Teamarbeit und Kollaboration bei der Zusammenarbeit mit den Engineers auf einem hohen technischen Niveau und bist in der Lage, cross-funktionale Software Entwicklungsteams durch Deine positive Einstellung zu motivieren.
 * Du konntest nachweislich Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einem technologiegetriebenen Unternehmen oder SaaS-Startup sammeln.
 * Du bist vertraut mit agilem Arbeiten in einer sich rasch verändernden Branche und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis von agile Methoden.
 * Du bist in der Lage, Produkte von Grund auf zu entwickeln und gleichzeitig mit Benutzern und Kunden umzugehen.
 * Du verfügst über hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Du sprichst Englisch auf allen Ebenen der Organisation in Wort und Schrift fließend.
   
   

Deine Benefits


 * Deutschland-Ticket, subventioniertes Abonnement
 * 1.000 Euro jährliches Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsbudget + interne Schulungs Plattformen
 * Rabatte auf Reisen, Mode, Technik und mehr durch unsere Corporate Benefits
 * REWE Rabattkarte für Preisnachlässe bei Einzelhändlern der REWE-Gruppe
 * JobRad, günstiges Fahrrad Leasing!
 * Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Vorteile, wenn Du mit uns arbeitest

 * Arbeite mit moderner und agiler Software wie Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, Jira, Lattice, Miro und Confluence

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Auch wenn Du das Gefühl hast, dass Du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, die Stelle Dich aber dennoch reizt und Du gerne mit uns zusammenarbeiten würdest, melden Dich bitte! Wir würden uns freuen, von Dir zu hören. Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich Bewerber aus Gruppen, die in der Tech-Branche derzeit unterrepräsentiert sind. Warum genau wir?


 * Du erhältst die Chance, mit hoher Eigenverantwortung den Aufbau eines ambitionierten Medienunternehmens hands-on mitzugestalten.

Was wir bieten

 * The Pioneer befindet sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, die dir zahlreiche Chancen für persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung bietet.
 * Du bekommst die Gelegenheit, regelmäßig an einem der außergewöhnlichsten Orte der Welt zu arbeiten: auf unseren Medienschiffen The Pioneer One, The Pioneer Two und natürlich unserem Medienbus – Klartext Express.
 * Du hast Zugang zu exklusiven Live-Events mit den Entscheidern des Landes – ein einzigartiger Einblick in politische und wirtschaftliche Prozesse.
 * Du lernst von fantastischen Kollegen und Kolleginnen, die in ihrem Bereich zu den besten der Branche gehören, und arbeitest eng mit Gabor Steingart und dem Pioneer Allstar-Team zusammen.
 * Als digitales Medienunternehmen bieten wir dir modernste Technik und eine Arbeitsumgebung, die dich unterstützt, das Beste aus dir herauszuholen.
 * Du wirst unbefristet angestellt und erhältst eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und 30 Tage Urlaub gehören selbstverständlich dazu.
   
   

Über uns

Das Nachrichtenportal The Pioneer bildet seit Mai 2020 die gemeinsame Bühne für alle journalistischen Publikationen des Medienunternehmens Media Pioneer Publishing AG.

Ausgezeichnet als “Startup of the Year” (European Publishing Awards 2020) gelten wir als eines der spannendsten Medienprojekte in Europa.

Unser bekanntestes Format “The Pioneer Briefing” erreicht als Newsletter und Podcast jeden Morgen bis zu 1 Mio. Menschen und ist damit “Deutschlands Morning Briefing No. 1”

Neben Gründer & Herausgeber Gabor Steingart gehören zu unseren Hosts u.a. Ex-Vizekanzler Sigmar Gabriel, Bestsellerautorin Juli Zeh, Tech-Experte Christoph Keese sowie die Journalistinnen Chelsea Spieker und Alev Dogan. Viele weitere Formate sind in Planung.

Als schwimmender Newsroom, Produktionsort und Bühne für Live-Journalismus dient unserer Crew das erste Medienschiff der Welt, The Pioneer 1, das täglich auf der Spree oder in ganz Deutschland unterwegs ist.

Unsere Mission heißt Unabhängigkeit: der Politik- und Wirtschaftsjournalismus von The Pioneer ist 100% werbefrei.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
The Company

Payrails is an innovative technology company with a team that has many years of experience in the payment industry and a real-life understanding of the merchants’ needs. We have seen the complexity firsthand and we have learned from all the challenges we've faced. Now we want to help leading technology companies around the world accept payments and build financial services with minimal upfront investments.

Our vision at Payrails is to reimagine payments. We do this by removing heavy reliance on Engineering efforts using composable building blocks that put the control firmly in the hands of our customers. We exist to help our customers become more productive and flexible, impacting directly on their ability to grow.

We are joined in our mission by top-tier investors Andreessen Horowitz , HV Capital, EQT and General Catalyst alongside a great cast of knowledgeable angel investors to enable us to solve the growing complexity of payments.

At Payrails, we are committed to building a team full of the most talented people. Excellence is part of our values and we understand that in order to achieve this, we need to build an environment where skilled people can work openly, collaboratively, and with the utmost trust in one another. We believe people thrive the most when they are fully aware of what the business is trying to achieve, why it is important to the market, and what challenges lie in the way to reaching our goals. In such an environment we believe people can truly excel, grow and enjoy working together. We try hard to be a company where everyone is inspired and feels a sense of responsibility to do the right thing to help us bring our vision to life. Succeeding with us is about finding solutions to the most pressing problems and executing them effectively.

Your Team

Payrails Is a Dynamic Workplace And Our Product Team Sits At The Core Of This Landscape. Our Mission Is To Drive a Successful Intersection Between User Experience, Technology And Business. We Do This By Focusing On 3 Main Pillars


 * Continuously studying our customers and the problems they are facing
 * Making sure we build a product that is feasible and best-in-class
 * Ensuring our product-market fit is always top of mind
   
   

Our Product team offers you the opportunity to work alongside a group of highly ambitious and knowledgeable Product Managers, while being faced with highly complex problems that affect customers on a global scale.

What You Will Be Doing

You as a Senior Product Manager, Intelligence will drive the product strategy for our Intelligence Product. You will be responsible for the end-to-end definition, scoping and development of the Payrails’ payments platform. You will own the roadmap, prioritization and setting of the technical vision for the team(s).


 * You will work directly with Engineering, Data and Business teams as well as external partners to meet Payrails’ product development targets
 * You will define and track success criteria and metrics to ensure product-market fit as well as constantly look for more efficient enhancing product performance
 * You will lead multiple cross-functional initiatives across the entire product lifecycle, partnering with business stakeholders to fully understand the problems faced by our customers and devise the right solutions to tackle them
 * You will be leading the scoping of initiatives at all levels from small improvements and bug fixes to large changes in the infrastructure and product
 * This role requires a technical person with strong communication skills, who can bridge the information gap between Business and Engineering teams. It will be this person’s responsibility to translate business objectives into clear technical scope for product development
 * You will be knowledgeable about the Payments market and will be actively involved in user, market and competitor research to ensure the best product-market fit
 * You will be responsible for the product-marketing strategy for your new product releases. Adoption of your products and features is a fundamental part of product delivery.
   
   

You'll be great for this role if


 * You have 5-7 years of experience in a technical role, ideally in a complex B2B environment
 * You have experience in working with API-first solutions within agile companies
 * You have UX/UI experience, preferably in Enterprise / B2B Payments or adjacent industries
 * You have experience working with Jira, Postman, GitHub, Figma
 * You have experience in managing technical projects through their whole lifecycle from scoping to go-to-market
 * You have a proven track record of managing complex initiatives with a strong emphasis on data, providing actionable insights, and tracking the success of those initiatives
 * You are able to communicate complex problems in a simple and relevant manner at all levels
 * You have proficiency in facilitating workshops and design sessions taking customer needs and business goals into account at all times
 * You are passionate about new technologies and innovations within Fintech
 * Experience in payments is a must
   
   

Why You should join Payrails


 * You can truly create your own path by taking responsibility and implementing your own ideas
 * We offer visa and relocation support to you and your family where required
 * We offer a hybrid working environment
 * You have 27 annual vacation days + 1 day of paid birthday leave for you to have fun and party without any worries!
 * We get together regularly for team lunches and events
 * You help us shape the future of payments
   
   

At Payrails, we prioritize a culture of inclusivity and diversity, evaluating candidates solely based on their skills and potential, regardless of age, gender, identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and identities. In line with our commitment to fairness, we kindly request applicants to refrain from including personal details such as a picture, age, or marital status in their CVs.

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)

remote - Germany, Spain, Czech Republic, Portugal, Slovakia or Austria

description:

title: Product Manager - Recommendations
description:
About The Opportunity

We are on the lookout for a Product Manager, Recommendations to join our product team at Pandora, which shapes the future of our thriving brands in Southeast Asia and Europe: Foodpanda, Foodora, and Yemeksepeti. In this position, you will drive the strategy, roadmap, and development of our recommendation product and other data science-powered features within Pandora. You will have the chance to leverage machine learning to enhance user experiences and platform outcomes.

You will collaborate with talented data scientists, engineers, UX researchers, analysts, and designers to achieve goals and drive impactful results.

If you geek out over data science topics and are passionate about problem-solving in the food delivery industry, this role is for you!

Join us in creating an engaging and personalised shopping experience for our users. Every feature and improvement you develop will enhance customer choice and app performance, making it easier for users to find and enjoy the products they love. Your work in the Pandora Team will have a lasting impact on customer satisfaction and loyalty across diverse markets.


 * Collaborate with business and product stakeholders to address challenges in browsing and recommendation through data-informed strategies.
 * Define, prioritize, and oversee a backlog of data-centric requirements that support overarching business goals.
 * Work alongside data scientists and machine learning engineers to design optimal solutions that meet product requirements, ensuring technical feasibility and alignment with user needs.
 * Cooperate with cross-functional teams to smoothly execute and deliver joint product solutions.
 * Partner with product analysts to validate product hypotheses through A/B testing and exploratory data analyses, using insights to refine product direction.
 * Create and maintain comprehensive but accessible technical documentation on the product.
   
   

What you need to be successful


 * 3-5 years of product management experience, preferably in AI/ML, as well as in the e-commerce or food delivery industry.
 * Experience in setting up the right hypotheses for your products, validating them with rigorous A/B testing frameworks.
 * Experience working with big data / machine learning technologies, and are comfortable with collaborating with data scientists on how and when to apply these capabilities to solve specific product problems.
 * Written and verbal communication skills, distilling complex technical information into clear messages tailored for diverse audiences.
 * Experience in interpreting and analyzing complex datasets, and are adept at deriving actionable insights from data.
   
   

Who we are

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt.  * Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
 * The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
   
   

Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:

Are you at home in a fast-paced environment where you break down complex problems and work with cross-functional experts? Can you lead product initiatives from conception to launch? Can you cut through the noise to turn customer feedback into customer success stories?

To develop and execute our product strategy, we're looking for a driven, dedicated and highly analytical Product Manager who values moving quickly. You will design, strategize, execute, and prioritize how we successfully evolve the Yatta Platform into a market-leading ecosystem that sets—and raises—the bar on the international stage.

Together with our engineers, designers, and marketers, you’ll bridge the gap between the technical and business worlds, helping design and develop our platform. You will drive the Platform’s growth across web, mobile and API interfaces, ensuring a seamless and engaging experience for our rapidly expanding user base. You should be an ecosystem thinker, someone who can empathize deeply with users, has a keen eye for design, and possesses strong business acumen while being outcome oriented.

You’ll play a crucial role in shaping the future of the Yatta Platform. Your efforts will be key to hyperscale growth and long-term impact while accomplishing our company mission.

Our tech stack

Tech Stack

Our passion for technology drives us to choose frameworks that enable rapid innovation, keeping our customers central to every decision. Below are some of the technologies and frameworks we use:


 * Frontend Technologies: Angular, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, SCSS
 * Backend Technologies: Java, Spring Boot
 * Collaboration Tools: Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Git, Slack, Figma
 * Database Development: PostgreSQL
 * Agile Software Development: SCRUM
   
   

Target Platforms and Applications


 * Cloud Applications: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes
 * Desktop Applications: Windows, MacOS, Linux
   
   

Your Key Responsibilities


 * Excel at eliciting requirements and translating customer feedback into detailed product requirements, narratives, and technical specifications, while maintaining a sharp focus on their needs to drive innovative product strategies.
 * Develop and execute product strategies to grow and enhance the platform, prioritizing high-impact development investments.
 * Oversee the end-to-end product development of the platform, from ideation to launch, including writing PRDs, creating functional specs, and setting clear priorities.
 * Partner closely with cross-functional teams (design, engineering, content, operations) to break down the product vision into well-scoped projects, and ensure smooth execution, delivering outstanding products to our customers.
 * Build user experiences that are valuable, simple and intuitive, rooted in user research and empathy.
 * Drive product roadmaps, prioritize impactful features, and deliver products that solve customer problems while enhancing market competitiveness.
 * Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform product strategies and identify opportunities.
 * Foster a team culture of high-velocity decision-making and learning, maintaining a high excellence bar to ensure products deliver real value to our customers at scale.
   
   

Your Qualifications

Basic education and skills


 * Bachelor‘s degree or higher in a technology, business, or related field.
 * Exceptional critical thinking, conceptual reasoning and analytical skills.
 * Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
 * Fluency in English, both written and spoken; German proficiency is a plus.
   
   

Relevant work experience and track record


 * 5+ years of product management or equivalent experience working in SaaS or web-based technology environments.
 * 3+ years with a proven track record of taking products from concept to successful launch.
 * Extensive experience working in technical environments with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, design, legal, etc.) to define product requirements, coordinate resources, and drive milestone achievement.
 * Relevant experience with analytical, project management and product development tools.
   
   

Personality and way of working


 * Deep understanding of the product craft—and an expert at managing the entire product lifecycle, including gathering diverse stakeholder requirements, conducting competitive research, integrating customer feedback, prioritizing developments, and overseeing pre/post-launch execution.
 * Driven self-starter capable of leading design discussions effectively to create innovative product solutions that drive product goals and go-to-market strategies that keep our customer needs front and center.
 * Adept in product development methodologies, design practices and cross-functional processes.
   
   

Why us?


 * You share our vision. This is a good start to head for the same objectives and mission goals. It is of greatest importance to us to maximize positive impact on the world. In the end, this is the purpose of our company. And this is the reason for our work.
 * You share the same values. We love our culture code! You don’t have to have the same feeling right away. And you don’t have to be like that completely – none of us are. But we believe it’s better to be driven by shared values rather than by rules and titles ????
 * You believe this is the very best (working) environment for you. At least for the foreseeable future. Like Akio Toyoda, we believe the key to making quality products is to develop quality people.
   
   

About Us

Yatta is all about development and evolution. We started in Frankfurt and Kassel, Germany, as a developer tool company, transformed into a software vendor, and now provide streamlined digital services.

title: Lead Product Manager, Traveler
description:
About GetYourGuide

GetYourGuide is the globally leading marketplace for unforgettable travel experiences. Travelers use GetYourGuide to discover the best things to do in a destination. Since its founding in 2009, travelers from over 170 countries have booked more than 80 million tours, activities, and attraction tickets through GetYourGuide. Powered by a global team of over 700 travel experts and technologists, we are headquartered in Berlin and have 17 local offices around the world. Visit our careers website to learn more.

Team mission

Our mission in the Traveler group is to connect travelers with experiences that ignite their passions. We are responsible for the core consumer experience in the marketplace and support multiple company-level initiatives and goals. We take pride in ownership and collaboration in line with our company principles. We start by deeply understanding our customer needs and building towards a vision that helps millions of Travelers around the world find experiences.

Role Overview

As a Lead Product Manager, you will own a significant part of the customer journey, and are responsible for defining a vision and strategy that impacts multiple product areas and teams within GetYourGuide. You will have an executive presence to gain buy-in and influence the company's long-term vision. In this role, you will execute complex projects that require multiple Product, Business, and Sales teams that depend on you to achieve their goals.

Your core mission team consists of a cross-functional group of engineers, product designers, researchers, and analysts passionate about improving how users discover and book unforgettable experiences. As a leader in the company, this role requires a growth mindset and the ambition to dive into complex problems with a positive mindset. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager who can envision GetYourGuide beyond its current state, champion our users' voices, and execute on a global scale.

You Will


 * Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for your product area, set clear, measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Drive sustained customer impact through a long-term (12 months+) roadmap, identifying areas for non-incremental impact.
 * Articulate and connect your product area’s strategy to the company’s mission. Break down the strategy into actionable steps, regularly update stakeholders on progress, and create excitement for your long-term vision. Build alignment within cross-functional teams and with outside stakeholders.
 * Analyze customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to inform decision-making. Prioritize initiatives, re-evaluate the roadmap based on new insights, and ensure the most valuable features are delivered first. Make strategic decisions on sequencing and prioritizing product work to maximize impact and learning.
 * Build trust with multiple stakeholders, internal and external, to set clear expectations and align them with your product area’s roadmap. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and create buy-in across the organization.
 * Plan and execute experiments to test hypotheses, develop A/B tests, and analyze data to derive actionable insights. Leverage experimentation to evaluate your team's investment and inform future product decisions.
 * Represent customer interests at all levels of the organization, advocating for user needs in strategic discussions. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and executive leadership. Provide coaching and mentorship to other team members, helping them grow and develop their skills. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and advocate for user needs in strategic discussions.
   
   

Who You Are


 * 6+ years of professional experience in product management and at least 2+ as a Lead Product Manager in direct customer-facing roles
 * Demonstrated ownership over a multiple product areas in a previous role, including responsibilities for strategy, KPI setup, goal-setting, and execution of roadmap
 * Ability to build alignment with a cross-functional mission team in a collaborative way that is aligned with our Guiding Principles
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
 * Strong data analytics skills with the ability to derive insights from large data sets
 * Demonstrated passion for driving customer and business impact
 * Bonus: Experience working in a marketplace or the travel industry is a plus but not required
 * Bonus: An engineering or analytics background is a plus, but not required
   
   

How We Set You Up For Success


 * Invest in your development with an annual personal growth budget
 * Become a part of our success with virtual stock options
 * Enjoy flexibility with a hybrid work-from-home and telecommuting policy
 * Save on transportation costs with a mobility budget
 * Support your loved ones with generous maternity and paternity leave policies
   
   

And more...

We look forward to hearing from you

Unlock your full potential and join our mission to create unforgettable experiences for millions around the world. If you have the skills and passion for joining our team, we invite you to apply by submitting your CV/resume in English through the form below. Check out how we hire for tips and visibility into our process and check out life at GetYourGuide. If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us via jobs@getyourguide.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with the application.

title: Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Our Mission

At Circus, headquartered in Hamburg with offices in Berlin and Munich, we are pioneering global developments in on-demand autonomous food production. Everything from creation to production and operation – enabled by seamlessly integrated cutting-edge robotics and transformative AI technology.

Our foundation rests in the extensive developments of groundbreaking robotics driven by artificial intelligence, previously the missing link in achieving true autonomous food automation. This is the moment for a new status quo: Just as autonomous driving will disrupt how we build cities, organize our days, and live our lives, so will we shift our whole reality around food.

Our Team is backing a paradigm shift in one of humanity’s most important sectors with the sharpest minds in Robotics, AI, Engineering and Culinary, collaborating closely with industry-leading partners to revolutionize every aspect of the food service experience.

Join us as we forge ahead, crafting a future where the art of cooking and the science of technology converge to create a world that thinks differently about food than it has for thousands of years—a world where food means something new.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced and motivated individual to join our Product team as a Senior Product Manager specializing in the Culinary domain.

In this role, you will lead the development of Product Information Management (PIM) and Menu Management Systems—critical components of our autonomous kitchen ecosystem. These systems manage ingredients, recipes, and menu configurations, enabling scalable, efficient, and delightful culinary experiences.

Reporting to the Head of Product, you will own the full product lifecycle, champion cross-functional collaboration, and develop solutions that enhance culinary workflows, ensure seamless recipe execution, and empower partners to customize menus for diverse contexts.

This is a high-impact role where your contributions will directly shape the software powering the next generation of food service.

Your Daily Business


 * Strategic Roadmapping: Develop and own the roadmap for the Culinary domain, synthesizing data, user feedback, business priorities, and risk assessment to guide decision-making.
 * Automation & Optimization: Lead initiatives to automate and optimize ingredient handling, recipe management, and menu configurations, ensuring accuracy, scalability, and adaptability.
 * Integration Management: Oversee integrations between the PIM system and real-time inventory data to minimize food waste, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure compliance with food safety standards.
 * Stakeholder Collaboration: Align with teams across Culinary, Operations, and Partner Success to translate business and user needs into actionable technical requirements. Partner closely with Tech Leads to deliver solutions.
 * User Experience & Rollout: Design and test user-centric solutions, oversee feature development, and manage successful rollouts. Provide end-user training and enablement for internal teams and external partners.
 * Agile Facilitation: Drive effective collaboration within agile teams by leading standups, backlog refinement, and release planning sessions.
 * Data-Driven KPIs: Define, monitor, and report on performance metrics in collaboration with the Data team to continuously evaluate product impact and guide iteration.
   
   

Base Qualifications


 * Proven Product Management Expertise: Several years of experience in product management for complex systems, preferably in B2B, B2B2C, or industries involving supply chain, food-tech, or internal platforms.
 * Agile & Customer-Centric Skills: Deep understanding of agile methodologies, MVP development, and balancing quick wins with long-term goals while maintaining a focus on customer and stakeholder needs.
 * Leadership & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to align multi-disciplinary teams and drive progress.
 * Technical Acumen: Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and translate technical concepts into business terms (experience with PIM, ERP, or similar systems is a plus).
 * Hands-On & Adaptability: Self-starter with a hands-on approach, thriving in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
 * Problem-Solving: Ability to identify high-value opportunities, address root causes, and deliver scalable solutions.
 * Data-Informed Decision-Making: Familiarity with defining and tracking KPIs and using data to influence product decisions.
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Experience with culinary workflows, recipe standardization, or food-related systems.
 * Familiarity with food safety standards, inventory management, or real-time data integrations.
   
   

Our Offer


 * Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package with offered stock options for full-time employees.
 * Work-Life Balance: Enjoy regular team events, a hybrid work setup, 2 months/year remote work (Worcation), and unlimited vacation days, along with a corporate pension plan.
 * Personal Development: 500€ personal budget for training, in-house trainings, and growth opportunities in a fast-paced environment.
 * Mobility: Benefit from a 50€ monthly budget for mobility or other expenses and a subsidized Dance Mobility Subscription for E-Bike/E-Moped.
 * Well-Being: Get access to discounted Urban Sports Club membership and Wellhub for a variety of well-being offerings.

title: Product Manager
description:
This is us

At straiv, we are an abitious team with diverse backgrounds. Our common goal is to digitize the hotel experience for the guest - from check in to check out and beyond. Our customers include more than 3,000 hotels in over 29 countries. To grow further and become Europe's leading provider in our segment, we are looking for you!




Ambition: We drive innovation with ambition - through our motivation and the demands we place on ourselves, we set new standards for digitalization in the hotel industry.

Consciously different: We think differently and act consciously - our self-financing gives us the independence to make decisions based on our beliefs.

Team: We focus on team spirit - our way of working is similar to the dynamics of a sports team, in which individual performance counts, joint successes are celebrated and personal exchange plays a central role.




As a Product Manager at straiv, you will be responsible for driving the vision and development of one product from our hotel tech platform.




This includes the following tasks:

 * Defining the product vision and strategy, aligning it with the company's objectives and the needs of the hotel tech industry.
 * Leading product discovery efforts to identify strategic initiatives that create long lasting customer impact and high business value for the company.
 * Continuously researching the market and monitoring trends from the industry to further develop our solutions.
 * Leading the end-to-end feature development process, from ideation and planning to release and post-launch evaluation.
 * Coordinating with external partners and customers to constantly improve our solution.
 * Working closely with our Engineering team to define and prioritize business requirements and drive overall product delivery activities.
 * Establishing and maintaining optimal communication with our business stakeholders (Customer Experience, Sales and Marketing teams).




What you bring

 * At least 3 years of professional experience working as a Product Manager, Product Owner or in a comparable position.
 * Prior experience working with a successful consumer facing product with high traffic
 * Familiarity with customer interviews, design thinking, A/B testing, software development processes and agile methodologies.
 * Strong knowledge of consumer behaviors, psychology and product innovation techniques
 * Understanding of the hotel tech industry is a plus.
 * Ability to communicate complex issues clearly and comprehensibly.
 * A critical mindset and the ability to work independently and in a solution-oriented manner.
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; German is a plus.

We value different backgrounds and are happy to receive your application even if the above points do not completely match your profile.




What we offer

 * We embrace a hybrid work model with a minimum 3 days per week in the office, with flexible working hours
 * Regular team events (Summer and Christmas parties, Family & Friends, etc.)
 * A great office with a roof terrace, ergonomic workplace and free drinks
 * Corporate benefits, access to courses

...and last but not least, a cool team and the chance to help build a software champion!




You want to get more information about us?

 * About us
 * Our solution
 * Instagram
 * LinkedIn
 * YouTube




Do you have any questions about the position or the company?

Feel free to contact Vanessa from our People & Culture team at v.mihailescu@straiv.io

title: Senior Product Operations Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Company Description

You'll be joining one of the world’s largest privately owned real estate tech companies and a subsidiary of Axel Springer. Our mission is to unlock everyone’s perfect place! You'll work across some of Europe’s best known digital real estate brands including: 🇫🇷 Meilleurs Agents, 🇫🇷 Groupe SeLoger, 🇧🇪 Immoweb, 🇧🇪 Realo 🇩🇪 Immowelt, 🇩🇪 Neuraum and 🇮🇱 Yad2.

Job Description

WHAT WE DO IN PRODUCT OPERATIONS

In Product Operations, our mission is to enable the product and tech community to deliver value with an effective and recognized product culture, supported by optimised product development processes, best practices, ways of working, tools & training. We envision to become a best-in-class operational powerhouse that drives product excellence, fosters high speed innovation, and enables sustainable growth by defining efficient, scalable, and data-driven products and product iterations. The product operation team is distributed in 3 different countries (Germany, France, Belgium) allowing us to keep the pulse from the team and understand where they need support.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Operations Manager to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in enhancing and streamlining the digital product management delivery process within both B2B and B2C contexts. You will work closely with senior leadership, including Directors and C-Level executives, to drive continuous assessment, improvement, and harmonisation of product management practices across the organisation. This is a strategic role where you will focus on building efficient, scalable, and harmonised ways of working that empower product teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:


 * Process Improvement & Optimization
    * Lead initiatives to improve the efficiency and consistency of the product management delivery guild across B2B and B2C environments.
    * D/Refine, document, and implement standardised product management frameworks and workflows to ensure clear accountability and repeatable success.
    * Continuously assess and enhance processes related to product delivery, decision-making, and stakeholder alignment, ensuring scalability and growth readiness.
    * Own the Product Operations roadmap, ensuring a long-term vision for scaling and improving product management capabilities.

 * Harmonise Ways of Working
    * Lead initiatives to harmonise the ways of working across global product teams, ensuring that all processes are aligned with the company’s overarching strategy.
    * Introduce and refine tools, templates, and best practices to create a unified approach to product management in a multi-environment business model (B2B and B2C).

 * Continuous Assessment & Delivery Improvement
    * Lead efforts in continuous assessment and optimization of product delivery, including metrics, KPIs, and feedback loops that drive performance improvements.
    * Establish a culture of continuous improvement within the product management organisation, leveraging data and analytics to identify areas for optimization and innovation.
    * Ensure efficient discovery data resulting in high-quality initiatives to be prioritised in alignment with the company product roadmap.

 * Cross-Functional Collaboration
    * Engage with Senior Directors and C-level executives to drive product operations strategies that align with company goals and customer expectations.
    * Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, and Operations teams to harmonise and streamline workflows, ensuring alignment on product goals and deliverables.
    * Facilitate cross-functional initiatives to improve roadmap prioritisation, capacity planning, and release management.
    * Act as a trusted advisor to the leadership team on operational excellence in product management, including insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.

 * Data-Driven Decision Making
    * Promote a culture of data-driven decision-making within product teams, empowering and enabling them to incorporate insights and metrics into their processes.
    * Utilise data and analytics to improve decision-making and streamline product operations.
    * Establish and oversee KPIs to track the efficiency and success of product delivery and operations.

 * Training & Mentorship
    * Provide leadership and mentorship to product managers, driving operational excellence and cross-functional collaboration.
      

Create and lead training programs for product management teams, enabling them to excel in their roles and align with operational goals.

Qualifications

Qualifications:


 * Strong experience in Product Operations or a related field or consulting background with a strong background in both B2B and B2C digital environments.
 * Demonstrated success working with senior leadership (Directors and C-level executives) to influence and drive product management and operational improvements.
 * Proven track record of improving product management processes and delivering continuous improvement within fast-paced organisations.
 * Strong experience in product delivery frameworks, including Agile and Lean methodologies.
 * Expertise in cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, and business teams to optimise workflows and align on business goals.
 * Exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with a focus on driving process improvements and harmonising operational practices within the different domains.
 * Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence and mentor product teams at all levels.
 * Data-driven mindset, with the ability to leverage insights to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement.
 * Experience in scaling and/or transforming product operations in a growing organisation, particularly within the context of global or multi-market operations.
   
   

Preferred Skills:


 * Experience working in both B2B and B2C product environments.
 * Strong familiarity with product management tools such as Jira, Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, Productboard, or similar.
 * Ability to navigate complex international organisational structures and drive change across teams with diverse priorities.
   
   

Additional Information

About us

At AVIV, we are an equal opportunities employer and an organisation where everyone is welcomed to be their authentic selves. We strongly encourage individuals with visible and non visible disabilities, all educational backgrounds, people from minority backgrounds, those from the LGBTQIA+ community and parents and carers to apply. If you need reasonable adjustments at any point in the application or interview process, or wish to discuss part time or flexible working requirements, please let us know.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

Our ambition is to be the leading Employer in PropTech across Europe and this is a pivotal time to join us and unlock your perfect job!

title: Product Manager (Passenger Cars, Germany)
description:
About The Job

As the Product Manager (Passenger Cars, Germany), your main responsibility is to lead and facilitate the localization of our passenger car portfolio in the German market. You will actively coordinate with the product, sales, marketing, and R&D teams in Europe and China to provide valuable feedback on market trends, policy changes, competitor tendencies, and expectations from users or partners. Your role will also involve managing product localization programs to ensure a smooth product launch and successful deployment.

The European Product Department focus on market, customer, policy, regulation research, and competitor analysis to develop a comprehensive product strategy that aligns with our vision and goals. We aim at creating an impactful European NEV portfolio that exceeds user and market expectations, while ensuring that all regulatory frameworks and business requirements are met.

As a member of the European Product Department, you will report directly to the BYD Europe Product Manager for Passenger Cars.

Key Responsibilities


 * You will take the lead in product localization projects in the German market. This will involve identifying market requirements and uncovering consumer insights that will help us develop products that meet the needs of our target audience.
 * Manage product demands from various stakeholders, including user groups, dealers, and local authorities or associations. To achieve this, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, sales, business planning, and marketing, to convert the demands into product implementations that align with our product strategy.
 * Manages local product campaigns, such as test-drive events and customer clinics, to help refining our product proposition, and raise awareness of our products and generate interest among potential customers.
 * Provide valuable insights including consumer analysis, and competitor benchmarking that will help us develop effective marketing strategies for our products.
 * Support other local activities, such as validation tests, at the early stage of (pre-) launches of new passenger car models in Europe. By doing so, you will help ensure that our products meet all relevant regulatory frameworks and business requirements.
   
   

Requirements


 * Bachelor's or master’s degree in Sustainable Transition, Automotive Engineering, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
 * 5 years of experience in the product management or related industry, a proficiency in project management is a plus.
 * Oral/written fluency in German and English is mandatory; Proficiency in Chinese or other European languages is a plus.
 * Strong data collection and analytical skills, with the ability to extract and present critical insights.
 * Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across all technical teams and disciplines.
 * Disciplined, fact-based, and rational approach to problem-solving.
 * Ability to prioritize, multitask, and work in a fast-paced environment.
 * Team player with a customer-centric, can-do, live-and-learn mindset.
 * Passion for NEVs and sustainability.

title: (Junior) Product Manager (alle Identitäten)
description:
What To Expect

Caspar Health ist die digitale Rehabilitationsklinik mit der Vision jeder/m Patient*in jederzeit Zugang zu einer effektiven Reha-Behandlung zu ermöglichen. Das ist deine Chance, traditionelle Gesundheitskonzepte in den Bereichen Prävention und Rehabilitation so mitzugestalten, dass Menschen während und nach dem Klinikaufenthalt bestmöglich und ortsunabhängig versorgt werden.

Als (Junior) Product Manager (alle Identitäten) bist du Teil eines cross-funktionalen Teams, dessen Aufgabe es ist, unsere Product Vision voranzutreiben.

Your Challenges


 * Du schaffst ein tiefgreifenden Verständnis für unsere Nutzer*innen (Patient*innen, Medizinisches Fachpersonal, Klinikpersonal) durch regelmäßige Interaktion, um deren Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen zu verstehen und darauf basierende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
 * Du verantwortest den Produkt-Discovery-Prozess in deinem Bereich, um kontinuierlich neue Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Hypothesen durch Beobachtungen, schnelles Experimentieren/Prototyping und Nutzertests zu validieren. Dein Ziel ist es, sicherzustellen, dass wir die richtigen Probleme auf die effektivste Weise lösen.
 * Du erfasst und nutzt Daten und Metriken zur Messung des Erfolgs und zur informierten Entscheidungsfindung. Du definierst klare Erfolgskriterien für jedes Produktfeature und jede Initiative, um sicherzustellen, dass wir unser Produkt kontinuierlich verbessern und auf Kurs bleiben.
 * Du treibst Aufbau und Pflege einer engen Zusammenarbeit in einem cross-funktionalen Team aus Entwickler*innen, Designer*innen und medizinischem Fachpersonal voran. Du hilfst dem Team effektiv, gemeinsam innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln und förderst eine Kultur der Eigenverantwortung und des kontinuierlichen Lernens.
 * Du entwickelst eine strategische Vision und Roadmap für deinen Bereich, die eng mit den Unternehmenszielen abgestimmt ist und langfristigen Unternehmenswert durch die Lösung der richtigen Nutzer-Probleme schafft. Du setzt Prioritäten basierend auf dem Impact für deine Nutzer*innen und das Unternehmen.
   
   

Your profile

Folgendes Solltest Du Mitbringen


 * Erste Produktmanagement Erfahrung innerhalb eines agilen Produktumfelds, mit einem Schwerpunkt auf der Entwicklung nutzerorientierter digitaler Produkte.
 * Starke Nutzerorientierung mit erster Erfahrung mit modernen Produkt-Discovery-Prozessen.
 * Technisches Verständnis für die Architektur von Web/App Anwendungen, sowie die Fähigkeit, einfache, intuitive und moderne Benutzeroberflächen zu konzipieren.
 * Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, um Daten zu interpretieren, Entscheidungen zu treffen und Produktstrategien auf Basis messbarer Ergebnisse anzupassen.
 * Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit in der Arbeit mit cross-funktionalen Teams, um innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die auf User Research und datengetriebenen Entscheidungen basieren.
 * Fähigkeit zur Entwicklung und Kommunikation einer klaren Produktvision für deinen Bereich, zur strategischen Planung und Priorisierung basierend auf Nutzerbedürfnissen und Geschäftszielen.
 * Erste Erfahrung mit Experimenten und Validierungstechniken, einschließlich der Nutzung von A/B-Tests, Prototyping und User Tests, um Hypothesen schnell zu überprüfen.
 * Experimentierfreude und Neugierde auf neue Tools, wie den Einsatz von gängigen KI-Tools oder Automatisierungssoftware.
 * Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (fließend in Wort und Schrift) und Englisch, um effektiv mit allen Stakeholdern innerhalb und außerhalb des Unternehmens zusammenzuarbeiten.
   
   

Im Bestfall Hast Du Auch


 * Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen - das zeigt uns, dass du bereit bist, in einem hoch regulierten und impact orientierten Umfeld zu arbeiten
 * Leidenschaft für Product und die Bereitschaft, Bestehendes in Frage zu stellen und durch innovative Lösungen zu ersetzen, um die Rehabilitation der Zukunft zu bauen
   
   

Why Caspar Health?


 * Du suchst nach Commitment? Perfektes Match! Wir bieten einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag!
 * Du möchtest nicht einfach eine Nummer sein? Verständlich! Bei uns steht jede*r Casparianer*in als Mensch im Vordergrund! An Initiativen zu Diversität und Inklusion kann sich jede*r Casparianer*in beteiligen und so aktiv beitragen und so pro-aktiv an unserer Arbeitskultur mitwirken.
 * Du schätzt Feedback? Das freut uns! Wir fördern eine offene Feedbackkultur, um gemeinsam zu lernen und zu wachsen!
 * Du legst Wert auf eine gute Work-Life-Balance? Wir auch und bieten daher Flexibilität bei den Arbeitszeiten, Mobiles Arbeiten und verschiedene Modelle für Teilzeitarbeit.
 * Du möchtest dich stetig weiter entwickeln? Das unterstützen wir mit spannenden Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für alle Casparianer*innen.
 * Du legst Wert auf deine Gesundheit? Wir auch! Wir bieten wöchentliche, abwechslungsreiche Sporteinheiten, die auch in dein Home Office gestreamt werden. Außerdem kannst du als Casparianer*in unsere App-Angebote im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, Bewegung und Ernährung kostenlos nutzen.
 * Wir bieten natürlich auch frische Früchte und diverse gesunde Snacks und Getränke im Office!
   
   

Diversität und Inklusion:

Bei Caspar Health sind wir bestrebt, für alle Casparianer*innen eine freundliche, sichere und einladende Umgebung zu bieten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Einschränkungen aller Art, körperlicher Erscheinung, sozialer Herkunft, Alter oder Religion (oder deren Nichtvorhandensein).

Bei Deiner Bewerbung stehen für uns Deine Erfahrung und Motivation im Vordergrund. Du entscheidest, welche zusätzlichen Informationen du preisgeben möchtest (Bild, Familienstand, Religion, Geschlecht, Nationalität, etc.). Wir schätzen und behandeln alle Bewerbungen gleich.

Wir freuen uns sehr darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

Your contact

Bitte reiche deine Bewerbung ausschließlich online über unseren Bewerbungslink ein.

Dein Kontakt ist Dana Kussatz, Talent Acquisition Specialist & HR Business Partner

Außerdem sind wir an deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deinen Gehaltsvorstellungen interessiert. Solltest du weitere Fragen haben, wende dich bitte an talent@caspar-health.com. Wir werden uns so schnell wie möglich mit dir in Verbindung setzen.

Unser Produkt CASPAR Health wird im Umfeld von medizinischen Einrichtungen, Patient*innen, Ärzt*innen und Therapeut*innen eingesetzt. Zu unserem beruflichen Alltag gehört es, mit (sensiblen) personenbezogenen Daten (z.B. Gesundheitsdaten) zu arbeiten. Daher fordern wir von unseren Mitarbeiter*innen ein hohes Commitment zum Schutz personenbezogener Daten ein, um die Rechte der Betroffenen bestmöglich zu schützen.

Hinweis Zum Datenschutz

Bitte bewirb Dich ausschließlich über unseren Bewerbungslink, da wir nur so den Schutz Deiner Daten gewährleisten können. Unsere Datenschutzerklärung findest Du hier.

About Us

Caspar Health is a digital rehabilitation clinic with a vision to provide patients with access to the most effective rehabilitation treatment at any time, any place.

Medical facilities use Caspar Health to conduct therapy measures online with their patients during their hospital stay and after discharge. The combination of learning technology with in-depth medical knowledge ensures that the therapy goal is achieved in a sustainable manner.

The services are covered by numerous pension insurance companies in the areas of rehabilitation, prevention and aftercare.

title: Product Manager for DIN/Euro Profile locks

Our mission is to make everyday life easier with a diverse range of safe and sustainable products for individual buildings and large real estate complexes.

ILOQ is dedicated to challenging conventional thinking and pushing the boundaries of innovation. A convenient location for the job is in Central Europe.

What you’ll do

Commercial

 * Contributing to product launches and market introductions with marketing and sales

Financial

 * Supporting financial position of product portfolio through revenue, cost and margin management

Technical

What you’ll bring

We feel the best match for this role will be a candidate with strong experience of locking and digital access management products and their applications. You also have a passion to support sales and customers and motivate people through good leadership and personal commitment. This position also requires excellent communication and organizational capabilities.

We are looking for a Product Manager with following qualifications:


 * Experience of locking and digital access management products and their applications is mandatory requirement
 * Appropriate engineering degree or similar
 * At least 5 years of experience in product portfolio development and management or related function i.e., technical management/support, R&D, operations, marketing, or sales

We believe in people

With us you will have a genuine opportunity to make a real difference in a fast-growing international company and influence the work environment of the entire company. We invest in the training and development of our employees so that we can shake the boundaries of innovation, design new technology and create even better solutions that provide excellent added value for our customers. We will take care of you by providing excellent onboarding experience with friendly, helpful, and passionate colleagues.

Are you the person we are looking for?

If you're passionate about innovation and are ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join ILOQ and be a part of our team pushing the boundaries of technology and security. For more information of the role please contact our HW Product Management Director Trond Wiker (firstname.lastname[AT]iloq.com).

We are expecting your application by December 15th at the latest. Please note, that we will be reviewing candidates and conducting interviews already during the application process.

title: Regional Product Manager EMEA (m/w/d) - Sitz in Deutschland (remote)
description:
Bei TE Connectivity geben wir Ihnen Raum zur beruflichen Entfaltung, und die Möglichkeit über Länder und Kulturen hinweg mit Kollegen zusammenzuarbeiten, mit dem Ziel eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft zu gestalten.

Jobübersicht

Wir suchen eine hochmotivierte und kundenorientierte Person für die Rolle des Regional Product Manager (RPM), um unser Portfolio von EMI-Filtern in der EMEA-Region zu leiten. Als RPM sind Sie verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der regionalen Produktstrategie, das Vorantreiben profitablen Wachstums und die Maximierung des Marktanteils für unsere umfassende Palette an EMI-Filterlösungen, einschließlich der renommierten Corcom- und Schaffner-Produktlinien. In dieser Schlüsselrolle arbeiten Sie eng mit Vertriebsteams zusammen, treten direkt mit Kunden in Kontakt und setzen effektive Preisstrategien um, um die regionalen Ziele zu erreichen.

Schaffner – jetzt Teil von TE Connectivity – ist ein führender Anbieter von Hochleistungsfilterlösungen, die zu sichereren, vernetzteren und nachhaltigeren Industrien beitragen. TE Connectivity Ltd., ein globaler Technologie- und Fertigungsführer mit einem Umsatz von 16 Milliarden US-Dollar, treibt Fortschritte in den Bereichen Transport, industrielle Anwendungen, Medizintechnik, Energie, Datenkommunikation und Smart Home voran.

Mit einer Präsenz in den anspruchsvollsten Umgebungen der Welt stellt TE sicher, dass EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS, unterstützt von 89.000 Mitarbeitern, darunter über 8.000 Ingenieure, die in rund 140 Ländern mit Kunden zusammenarbeiten.

Durch die Integration der Schaffner-Expertise und der renommierten Corcom-Produktlinie bietet das umfassende Portfolio von TE für EMI- und Power-Quality-Lösungen nun eine noch stärkere Fähigkeit, die heutigen und zukünftigen Anforderungen an industrielle Filter zu erfüllen.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben


 * Regionale Produktstrategie & Umsetzung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer umfassenden Produktstrategie für die EMEA-Region, abgestimmt auf die globale Produkt-Roadmap und angepasst an die spezifischen Anforderungen und Dynamiken des EMEA-Markts.
 * Vertriebszusammenarbeit & Kundenbetreuung: Enge Partnerschaft mit den EMEA-Vertriebsteams, um Umsatzwachstum und Marktdurchdringung voranzutreiben. Aufbau starker Kundenbeziehungen, Verständnis ihrer Anforderungen und Bereitstellung technischer Expertise und Unterstützung.
 * Preisstrategie & Optimierung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung wettbewerbsfähiger Preisstrategien für die EMEA-Region unter Berücksichtigung von Marktbedingungen, Wettbewerb und Kundensegmentierung. Optimierung der Preise zur Maximierung von Rentabilität und Marktanteil.
 * Nachfrageplanung & Prognose: Analyse von Markttrends, Kundennachfrage und Verkaufsdaten zur Erstellung präziser Prognosen für EMI-Filterprodukte in der EMEA-Region. Zusammenarbeit mit der Lieferkette zur Sicherstellung der Produktverfügbarkeit und Optimierung der Lagerbestände.
 * Produkteinführung & Markteintritt: Leitung der regionalen Einführung neuer EMI-Filterprodukte, einschließlich der Entwicklung von Markteintrittsstrategien, Koordination von Marketingaktivitäten sowie Bereitstellung von Vertriebstools und Schulungen.
 * Wettbewerbsanalyse & Marktbeobachtung: Kontinuierliche Überwachung der Wettbewerbslandschaft in der EMEA-Region, Analyse von Wettbewerbsprodukten, Preisstrategien und Marktanteilen. Identifikation von Chancen und Risiken zur Unterstützung der Produktstrategie.
 * Voice of the Customer (VoC): Hauptansprechpartner für die Erfassung und Analyse von Kundenfeedback in der EMEA-Region. Übersetzung von Kundenanforderungen in umsetzbare Empfehlungen für die Produktentwicklung und -verbesserung.
 * Zusammenarbeit mit dem globalen Produktmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem globalen Produktmanagement, um regionale Erkenntnisse zur Produkt-Roadmap beizusteuern, unbefriedigte Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren und die Abstimmung zwischen globalen und regionalen Strategien sicherzustellen.
   
   

Ihr Profil


 * Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich; MBA bevorzugt.
 * Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Vertrieb oder Marketing innerhalb der Elektronikindustrie, vorzugsweise mit Fokus auf industrielle Anwendungen und/oder Energielösungen.
 * Technisches Wissen: Verständnis von EMI/EMC-Prinzipien, Filtertechnologien und Anwendungen von EMI-Filtern in verschiedenen Industriesektoren (wünschenswert).
 * EMEA-Marktkenntnisse: Vertrautheit mit der EMEA-Marktlandschaft, einschließlich wichtiger Branchentrends, Kundensegmente und Wettbewerbsdynamiken im Bereich industrielle Automatisierung und Elektrifizierung. Erfahrung im elektronischen Vertrieb ist ein Plus.
 * Preis- & Verkaufsstrategien: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Preisstrategien, in Verhandlungen mit Kunden und im Vorantreiben von Verkaufswachstum.
 * Analytisches Denken & Geschäftssinn: Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeit zur Bewertung von Marktchancen, Finanzleistung und datenbasierten Entscheidungen.
 * Kommunikation & Zusammenarbeit: Hervorragende Kommunikations-, zwischenmenschliche und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und starke Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen.
   
   

#jobsEMEAHL

description:
About Lion Studios

Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses. Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart. Collaborating closely with the senior product managers, analysts, and lead game designer, you will play a key role in driving revenue growth and ensuring the ongoing success of the games.

 * Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment, providing mentorship and guidance to drive creativity and accountability.
   
   

Who You Are//Basic Qualifications:


 * 3+ years of experience in product management on mobile games or equivalent experience
 * Excellent communication skills
 * Deep familiarity with game analytics and mobile game KPIs
 * Understanding of live game operations, sales, and event strategies
   
   

Additional Strengths//Preferred Qualifications:


 * Proficiency in Unity is a huge plus
 * Familiarity with Figma or similar visual collaboration software
 * Experience and general knowledge of working with AI tool
 * Track record of publishing/working on a successful hypercasual, casual, or AAA title.
   
   

Join us if you are passionate about driving revenue growth through live ops strategies in puzzle games and want to be part of an exceptional gaming experience for players worldwide!

Your qualification


 * You have successfully completed your studies in economics or medical technology with a focus on strategic marketing.
 * You have 2 -4 years of relevant professional experience in product management of explainable (medical) products and launching products downstream.
 * You are familiar with business administration (can read and interpret P & L) and you demonstrate independence/ proactive behavior, driving your own business with minimal supervision. Ideally you have experience in selling medical products to hospitals.
 * You have a very good command of English - both written and spoken.

title: Product Manager: Trading
description:
Product Manager: Spot & Futures Market Making

About Keyrock

Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.

Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.

We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.

But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.

At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

Mission statement

We're seeking a dedicated Product Manager to drive the architecture that powers our spot & futures market making system for cryptocurrency markets. This role focuses on navigating cryptocurrency markets, shaping our strategy for building low latency, high performance architecture and identifying opportunities to make our market making engine 100x more scalable across new frontiers.

You'll be working with a cross-sectional squad, our trading & research teams, to define & deliver technology that supports our expansion across 1000s of markets for our clients. Your responsibilities will include developing a comprehensive understanding of our architecture, working with the architecture team to identify key opportunities to improve our scalability & reduce our cost of service, and drive key changes that allow us to make markets more efficiently across our tech stack. This is a crucial role for to drive rapid expansion of our system and products.

Job Description


 * Lead the product discovery and definition process for a cross-functional squad consisting of engineers, data engineers, QA specialists, data intelligence analysts, and tech support personnel.
 * Collaborate closely with stakeholders to identify market opportunities, gather requirements, and prioritize features for development.
 * Drive the development and execution of product deliverables, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
 * Conduct market research and competitive analysis to stay informed about industry trends and identify areas for innovation.
 * Work closely with engineering teams to translate product requirements into actionable user stories, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
 * Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related inquiries, providing guidance and support to internal teams and external partners.
 * Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and user feedback to evaluate product performance and identify areas for improvement.
 * Continuously iterate on the product based on user feedback, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to maintain a competitive edge.
   
   

Background And Experience


 * Lead the product discovery and definition process for a cross-functional squad consisting of engineers, data engineers, QA specialists, data intelligence analysts, and tech support personnel.
 * Have led product development at a trading company or in a similar space. Deep understanding of key financial concepts and some experience with trading is preferable.
 * Deep experience with cryptocurrency markets (personal or professional) & an understanding of core market making concepts is beneficial.
 * Ability to understand, synthesise & communicate technical concepts and product architecture.
 * Collaborate closely with stakeholders to identify market opportunities, gather requirements, and prioritize features for development.
 * Drive the development and execution of product deliverables, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
 * Conduct market research and competitive analysis to stay informed about industry trends and identify areas for innovation.
 * Work closely with engineering teams to translate product requirements into actionable user stories, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
 * Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related inquiries, providing guidance and support to internal teams and external partners.
 * Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and user feedback to evaluate product performance and identify areas for improvement.
 * Continuously iterate on the product based on user feedback, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to maintain a competitive edge.
   
   

Competences and personality


 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or a related field;
 * 3+ years of experience in product management roles, with a proven track record of delivering successful products in the fintech, cryptocurrency, or related sectors.
 * Strong understanding of trading technology, decentralized finance (DeFi), and blockchain concepts.
 * Experience working with cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment.
 * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively at all levels of the organization.
 * Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and metrics to drive decision-making.
 * Proven leadership skills with the ability to motivate teams and foster a collaborative working environment.
 * Familiarity and experience with cryptocurrency trading, market making or similar is necessary for this role
 * Experience in quantitative roles is beneficial
   
   

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness in our recruitment process. We seek people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

Our offer


 * A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on the method of engagement (employee or Contractor).
 * Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
 * The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence
   
   

As an employer we are committed to build an inclusive, diverse and non-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.
