title: Senior Product Manager, Extensions
description:
Grammarly offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Grammarly

Grammarly is the world’s leading AI writing assistance company trusted by over 30 million people and 70,000 teams. From instantly creating a first draft to perfecting every message, Grammarly helps people at 96% of the Fortune 500 and teams at companies like Atlassian, Databricks, and Zoom get their point across—and get results—with best-in-class security practices that keep data private and protected. Founded in 2009, Grammarly is No. 14 on the Forbes Cloud 100, one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies, one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in AI, and one of Inc.’s Best Workplaces.

The opportunity

To achieve our ambitious goals, we’re looking for a Product Manager to join our Browser Extensions team. Our browser extensions are the primary way that Grammarly’s millions of daily users interact with our product. As the product manager for the Browser Extension team, you’ll be responsible for ensuring that Grammarly’s writing assistant integrates seamlessly and delightfully everywhere our users write on the web.

As an experienced product manager, you’ll be responsible for how our users interact with Grammarly’s product on websites they often use—e.g., Gmail, Google Docs, Facebook, and Zendesk. The role will challenge your product, design, and technical skills as you ensure that Grammarly integrates harmoniously into our users’ workflows to support writing tasks as varied as drafting a novel or shooting off a sales email.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


 * Working across Grammarly to define and expand our definition and understanding of client quality, performance, and compatibility.
 * Devise metrics to measure the overall quality of the product experience and then refine Grammarly’s browser extensions to be world-class software—a particular challenge given the goal of integrating the product seamlessly across the entire web.
 * Be the guardian of user experience for our browser extensions. Many teams will contribute to the success of the product, and you will develop standards and processes to ensure a great result.
 * Develop the product roadmap and vision for Grammarly’s product on the web. To do so, you’ll need to combine a deep empathy for what our users go through when writing and develop creative and delightful solutions to their problems.
 * Using quality insights and data to influence roadmaps and drive improvements to our Browser-based experiences.
 * Presenting to engineering, product, and leadership on quality insights and strategic initiatives.
   
   

Qualifications


 * Has several years of experience working with Product Management.
 * Is able to drive learnings, execution, and impact in a product area with ambiguity.
 * Has a background in web, extension, and browser development practices and technologies
 * Has a strong quantitative and analytical mindset that allows them to collaborate deeply with data science while also driving independent analysis.
 * Is able to communicate and influence product and engineering teams from a user-experience and data-driven lens.
 * Embodies our EAGER values—is ethical, adaptable, gritty, empathetic, and remarkable.
 * Is inspired by our MOVE principles: move fast and learn faster; obsess about creating customer value; value impact over activity; and embrace healthy disagreement rooted in trust.
   
   

Support for you, professionally and personally


 * Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.
 * A connected team: Grammarly builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our EAGER (ethical, adaptable, gritty, empathetic, and remarkable) values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Grammarly Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.
 * Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Grammarly offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.
   
   

We encourage you to apply

At Grammarly, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Grammarly is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

For more details about the personal data Grammarly collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Grammarly Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

title: Digital Product Leader (m/f/d) Supply Chain Development
description:
Company Description

You see things a little differently. So do we. We offer positions that will challenge your skills and let you grow. We put togetherness at the heart of everything we do. Come see things a little differently with us.

IKEA is one of the world's leading home furnishing companies. Our vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible will be able to afford them.

IKEA Core Business Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all business areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost.

Supply Chain Development (SCD) is one of the business units in Core Business Supply and we are on an exciting journey! By gathering the end-to-end supply chain development and innovation agenda into one organization, embedding management and development of processes and digital solutions into the business, we will meet the future with the right competences and business capabilities. By this we will also create the preconditions to a world class supply chain that enable IKEA to efficiently respond to the ever-changing customer needs.

Within the SCD Area Intralogistics Development organisation we are responsible to break it down and to establish, lead, support and develop logistics solutions for the various IKEA units that have a logistical and fulfilment component.

Job Description

As part of the SCD Area Intralogistics Development organisation’s assignment we connect internal IT specialists and external Service Partners to develop, operate and maintain need oriented, innovative IT solutions, kept up to date – both from technical and functional perspective. Furthermore, we globally support a huge number of Supply Chain Projects to make IKEA available for the many.

As a Digital Product Leader you are


 * Accountable for managing one or more assigned digital product(s), securing running business, development, support/service performance.
 * Accountable for the digital product vision and roadmap, supporting relevant process and capability goals, including life-cycle management and compliance to frameworks and standards.
 * Accountable for budget, prioritization, clear and transparent goals, and plans for the digital product(s).
 * Responsible to secure that the digital product(s) fulfils well defined business and user needs, including related learning offer.
 * Responsible to define the digital product scope, ways of working, and performance follow-up.
 * Responsible to lead both digital product development and discovery work to explore new opportunities, control cost, manage risks and dependencies, and to maximize business value.
 * Responsible for managing stakeholder engagement, e.g. with suppliers, super users, or user community, depending on digital product(s).
 * Responsible to identify and create measures of success to understand how the product achieves business outcomes.
 * Responsible to secure that the digital product team has access to relevant insights and maintains a deep understanding of both business context and user’s reality.
 * Contribute to adoption of best practice in digital product management and continually benchmark against industry standards.
   
   

Qualifications

You have a strong interest in supply chain and intralogistics as well as in technology, digitalization, and automation. You have a passion for planning and leading in a global assignment and to drive and develop the business and yourself to deliver excellent results. Moreover, you have a desire to collaborate and interact with various stakeholders.

You are a match for IKEA and this role when you:


 * Extensive knowledge in digital product development, agile development practices and ways of working.
 * Extensive knowledge in the relevant business context, IKEA business processes, strategies, and digital landscape.
 * Extensive knowledge in how to develop and lead a high performing autonomous team with a clear digital product vision, and working with relevant disciplines such as discovery, UX, and data driven decision making.
 * Ability to lead value based and develop business and people through IKEA leadership capabilities.
 * Ability to develop and lead a highly effective empowered digital product team focusing on customer/user insights, data-informed decisions, and impactful outcomes/value.
 * Ability to, in an excellent way, communicate, facilitate, listen actively, build networks, and inspire others.
 * Ability to stimulate creative ideas and to identify and act on opportunities for improvement
 * Passionate about creating value and digital products that users love.
 * High motivated by leading business and people together creating optimal preconditions for performance and growth.
 * Motivated by continuous improvement and learning.
 * Motivated to work in an environment of constant change.
 * Always committed to and guided by the IKEA Culture & Values.
 * Proven digital product management background combined with people leadership experience.
 * Experience in setting clear objectives and steering all involved people towards achieving results.
 * Strong and proven skills in communication, stakeholder management, and conflict resolution.
 * 5+ years in software development industry working with agile and DevOps.
 * Experience working in a global retail organization and/or IKEA value chain preferred.
   
   

Degree in computer science, business administration, engineering or similar is preferred

Additional Information

We offer you a position in a fast paced, truly global environment where development and constantly being on the way is in focus! And as the world’s leader at life at home, you have exceptional opportunities to grow together with us in an international network with future oriented projects and technical innovations. At IKEA, we value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are committed to providing coworkers with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We encourage individualism and invite you to come join our team and be yourself with us!

The position is based in Dortmund, Germany and will require some travelling.

Submit your application online and in English via our recruitment system SmartRecruiters (please note that applications sent via e-mail will not be accepted) latest on the 5th of January 2025. If you have any questions about the actual recruitment process, please send a message to our recruiting team via SmartRecruiters and we will come back to you. In case of questions connected to the role, please reach out to hiring manager Udo Hilbk (udo.hilbk@inter.ikea.com).

At IKEA, we continuously look for better ways of working, following our vision to create a better everyday life for the many people. It is in our culture to work together and to be open, straightforward, and inclusive. We welcome all applications. Our culture and values are based on equal opportunities, and we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities.

We are looking forward to hearing from you soon!

title: Product Manager
description:
Making life accessible




Join the smart locking revolution! iLOQ is an international company headquartered in Finland that offers intelligent locking systems and total access management solutions. We guarantee safe access to buildings and facilities. Our mission is to make everyday life easier with a diverse range of safe and sustainable products for individual buildings and large real estate complexes.

ILOQ is dedicated to challenging conventional thinking and pushing the boundaries of innovation. Our products are based on unique battery-free, patented technologies, and we are now seeking an experienced Product Manager to develop and maintain our DIN/Euro Profile product portfolio to meet our ambitious growth targets. A convenient location for the job is in Central Europe.




What you’ll do




As our Product Manager, your responsibility is focused on three main topics:




Commercial

 * Supporting effective sales and marketing development together with sales, marketing & service (i.e., value proposition, events and fairs, brochures, specification, technical documentation, training material, product content, etc.)
 * Contributing to product launches and market introductions with marketing and sales
 * Supporting sales team in executing growth and Go to Market plans within targeted segments through partner engagement, new business opportunities and customer interaction
 * Supporting local sales in business opportunities including customer interaction




Financial

 * Developing target market product pricing and positioning based on business and customer impact
 * Supporting financial position of product portfolio through revenue, cost and margin management
 * Sharing and communicating the product life-cycle journey in respective market areas




Technical

 * Developing and maintain DIN/Euro Profile product portfolio for target segments ensuring time-to-market, product quality and features
 * New product introduction and trainings for sales




What you’ll bring




We feel the best match for this role will be a candidate with strong experience of locking and digital access management products and their applications. You also have a passion to support sales and customers and motivate people through good leadership and personal commitment. This position also requires excellent communication and organizational capabilities.




We are looking for a Product Manager with following qualifications:




 * Appropriate engineering degree or similar
 * At least 5 years of experience in product portfolio development and management or related function i.e., technical management/support, R&D, operations, marketing, or sales
 * Experience of locking and digital access management products and their applications
 * Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English and preferably in German, other language skills are an asset
 * Flexible attitude and ability to perform under pressure. You are also a team player, well organized and proactive




We believe in people




With iLOQ, everyone can make an impact. Our values guide our operations: We change the market, challenge the traditional way of thinking, believe in people, and base our actions on sustainable development, respect and results.




With us you will have a genuine opportunity to make a real difference in a fast-growing international company and influence the work environment of the entire company. We invest in the training and development of our employees so that we can shake the boundaries of innovation, design new technology and create even better solutions that provide excellent added value for our customers. We will take care of you by providing excellent onboarding experience with friendly, helpful, and passionate colleagues.




Are you the person we are looking for?




If you're passionate about innovation and are ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join ILOQ and be a part of our team pushing the boundaries of technology and security. For more information of the role please contact our HW Product Management Director Trond Wiker (firstname.lastname@iloq.com).




We are expecting your application by December 21st at the latest. Please note, that we will be reviewing candidates and conducting interviews already during the application process.

title: (Senior) Product Owner - Payment/Search (all genders)
description:
Your role

We are looking for a strategic Product Owner to lead the development and optimization of Search or Payment functionalities across our platforms. You will drive improvements in search accuracy and relevancy through AI/ML solutions, while also ensuring seamless, secure payment transactions and optimized user flows. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you'll define and prioritize product roadmaps to enhance both user experiences and business outcomes. If you're passionate about shaping user-centric products and driving impactful results, we want to hear from you!

Product Owner - Search


 * Lead the strategy, development, and optimization of search functionality across our platforms.
 * Define and prioritize the product backlog to enhance search accuracy, relevancy, and user satisfaction.
 * Collaborate with engineering, UX, and data teams to implement AI/ML solutions for search personalization.
 * Analyze user behavior and search metrics to identify areas of improvement and opportunities for innovation.
   
   

Product Owner - Payment


 * Oversee the end-to-end management of payment solutions, ensuring seamless and secure transactions.
 * Collaborate with stakeholders to define payment product requirements and roadmap.
 * Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure adherence to regulations.
 * Optimize payment flows to improve user experience and reduce drop-off rates.
   
   

Your profile


 * At least 5 years experience as a (Senior) Product Owner/Manager or similar role in a technology-driven environment.
 * Strong domain knowledge in either search systems (e.g., Elasticsearch, Algolia) or payment systems (e.g., payment gateways, PCI compliance).
 * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 * Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics tools to inform decisions.
 * Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar.
 * Likes to work in a Hybrid work set up, as we value spending time together in the office.
 * This position is on-site in Berlin, we don't offer remote work for this position.
 * English full professional working proficiency, ideally German too.
   
   

What we offer


 * An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients
 * We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year
 * The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket
 * A healthy balance is important to us: we offer a hybrid work model and 'workation'
 * Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia
 * You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas
 * Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world
 * We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day
   
   

Apply for this job

About Us

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: Our entire range is therefore vegetarian, mostly vegan. We also go our own way when it comes to packaging: the majority of our products are packaged in glass and are therefore almost completely recyclable.

We have a diverse team of 220 people and 37 nationalities, still growing but at a sustainable rate. Our aim is to work in a collaborative, supportive and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary colleagues.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Senior Manager of Product Management
description:

Product Management Lead (m/w/d)

title: Technical Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
What we do

Better breast cancer screening should be a universal offering to every woman in the world. Vara’s AI-powered software platform, created with screening radiologists in Germany, mitigates much of the human subjectivity associated with reading mammography results—and reduces the repetitive work screening physicians are routinely subjected to—we’re making breast cancer screening more effective, more measurable, and more accessible for everyone, everywhere. By democratizing access to early screening around the world, we deliver measurable impact backed by clinical evidence. We are partnering globally, to deliver breast cancer screening where it is needed most.

As the first company from Europe’s leading AI venture studio Merantix, Vara has grown since 2018 to become a 50-member international team. Our diverse team consists of highly motivated and ambitious entrepreneurs, healthcare professionals, and technology experts.

Further information can be found on our website: www.vara.ai

Your role

As a Product Manager (m/w/d) You Will Report To Our Head Of Product And Take Over The Day To Day Of Our Radiologist Workflow Solution. Some Of Your Tasks Will Include


 * Conduct product research and exploration with relevant stakeholders.
 * Participate in UI/UX discussions to deliver maximum value to our users.
 * Coordinate feature releases and monitor their post-release adoption and user feedback.
 * Maintain regulatory documentation to ensure continuous compliance of our medical devices.
 * Support quality assurance efforts and proactively search for bugs and product improvements.
 * Participate in and contribute to strategic discussions around the product and its roadmap.
 * Work closely with stakeholders from different teams (Ops, Regulatory, QA, UI/UX, ML, Dev) representing Product and ensuring that we reach our milestones successfully.
   
   

Your profile


 * Higher education degree in computer science, medical technologies, (software) engineering, or business with strong affinity for technology.
 * Initial professional experience (e.g. through internships) at a VC-backed startup, management consultancy or in a similar fast-paced environment.
 * Excellent comprehension and analytical skills, exceptional commitment and communication skills and proven ability as an innovation driver.
 * Strong detail orientation, ability to think outside of the box, and capacity to manage multiple projects in parallel in a highly dynamic and ever changing work environment.
 * Proven ability to coordinate and take ownership within interdisciplinary teams to take key projects over the finish line.
 * Fluency in English and German
 * Professional or academic touchpoints with at least three out of the five following domains:
    * Software development
    * Business development
    * Startup / Innovation / Design Thinking
    * Artificial Intelligence
    * Medical Technologies
      

What we offer

Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben sind Dir wichtig?

title: Amazon Supply Chain Manager (Europe Remote) @ international e-commerce startup
description:
Flummox: Your Opportunity to Shape the Future of E-commerce

At Flummox, we’re on a mission to redefine how brands thrive in the digital marketplace. With a vision to become the leading brand marketer and seller on online marketplaces across Europe and the USA, we’re building a portfolio of beloved consumer brands. Following our recent multi-million alliance with Diethelm Keller Group, we’re building an unstoppable engine for growth fueled by strategic acquisitions, innovative product development, exclusive brand partnerships, best-in-class online distribution and operational excellence.

Your Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and energetic Supply Chain Manager, who will be at the heart of driving operational success by overseeing planning, purchasing, logistics, warehousing and distribution (3PL & FBA), returns and compliance. You will manage end-to-end supply chain operations, ensuring products are always available, inventory moves seamlessly, and costs remain optimised. Your leadership will be instrumental in driving efficiency, scalability, and customer satisfaction in a fast-paced, ever-evolving e-commerce environment.

Tasks

Your responsibilities will include:


 * Forecasting & Planning (S&OP): Lead forecasting and inventory planning for full product lifecycles (launch, scale, run) across multiple online channels and geographies (Europe and USA), leveraging forecasting software, such as Flieber.
 * Strategic Inventory Management: Determine optimal inventory and safety stock levels for full product lifecycles (launch, scale, run) across suppliers, inbound freight, warehouses, and distribution centers (incl. FBA) in China, EU, UK, and USA. Analyze and negotiate costs, terms, and lead times with supply chain partners to ensure product availability while optimizing inventory turnover and costs.
 * Purchasing and Logistics: Manage purchase orders (POs) to meet inventory plans and deadlines. Develop efficient inbound shipping plans, overseeing multi-modal, international, and consolidated shipments to warehouses and distribution centers (3PL and Amazon FBA) in China, the EU, the UK, and the USA. Ensure seamless operations with freight forwarders and customs agents by providing accurate documentation.
 * Warehousing & Distribution (3PL, Amazon FBA): Oversee storage, replenishment, fulfillment, and returns processes across 3PL warehouses and Amazon FBA in EU, UK, USA, and China, driving efficiency and performance.
 * Compliance: Ensure product and packaging compliance with European and USA regulations, as well as adherence to online marketplace requirements, by collaborating closely with suppliers, partners and regulatory bodies.
 * Supply Chain Database & System Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of product, inventory, and partner data as reliable sources for analysis and decision-making. Drive data efficiency through the implementation and maintenance of inventory management or ERP systems.
 * Cost & Performance Analysis: Continuously analyze end-to-end (E2E) supply chain processes to improve reliability, reduce turnaround times, and enhance profitability.
 * Team, Processes and Reporting: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing supply chain team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Implement KPIs, SOPs, and actionable reporting to ensure visibility, scalability, and operational efficiency across departments.
 * New Business Integrations: Oversee the integration of new products, acquired brands, and new brand partnerships into Flummox’s supply chain, ensuring seamless transitions.
 * Supply Chain SWOT: Monitor industry trends and evaluate the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats (SWOT) of Flummox’s supply chain. Collaborate with executives to develop and implement strategic improvements.
   
   
   

Requirements

To succeed in this role you:


 * Have 5+ years of experience in international supply chain management for Amazon FBA and/or e-commerce brands, achieving measurable success; experience in multi-channel e-commerce is a strong advantage.
 * Hold a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (a master’s degree is a plus).
 * Are fluent in English; German proficiency is big plus.
 * Are based in Europe and able to effectively collaborate across global time zones.
 * Excel at data analysis, with advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, and can turn data into actionable insights to drive decisions.
 * Have hands-on experience with Amazon’s ecosystem (FBA, MCF), third-party logistics (3PL) systems, forecasting and inventory management/ERP software.
 * Understand international shipping and can coordinate seamlessly with logistics partners, ensuring accurate documentation for smooth operations.

Job Title: Supply Chain Manager

Location: Eisenach, Germany

Working Hours: Full-time (39 hours/week)

Reports To: Supply Chain Director




Job Purpose

As a Supply Chain Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth functioning of operational purchasing activities, demand planning, and logistics processes. You will lead and inspire the Supply Chain team to achieve key performance indicators (KPIs) while driving continuous improvement in efficiency, quality, and supplier performance.




Key Responsibilities

Operational Purchasing Activities

 * Oversee and ensure the accuracy and timeliness of order processing.
 * Define and implement structure, processes, and data transfer protocols to enhance operational efficiency.
 * Maintain continuous, close monitoring of supplier performance to ensure alignment with quality and delivery requirements.

Master Demand Planning

 * Analyze internal and external sales data, integrating historical trends with future market expectations.
 * Develop robust demand forecasting models to optimize planning accuracy and inventory management.

Logistical Processes

 * Manage inbound logistics, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery of goods.
 * Oversee intercompany logistics to streamline internal supply chain operations.

Team Leadership

 * Lead, inspire, and empower the Supply Chain team to achieve departmental goals.
 * Foster a culture of performance, accountability, and employee development.
 * Ensure effective communication and collaboration across teams and with external partners.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

 * Monitor and ensure achievement of the following:
 * Availability: Maintain optimal stock levels to meet customer demands.
 * Inventory Turnover: Maximize efficiency in inventory movement.
 * Inventory Value: Ensure cost-effective management of stock.
 * Supplier Performance: Maintain high standards of supplier delivery performance.




Skills & Requirements

Education and Knowledge

 * Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field.
 * A minimum of 3 years of leadership experience in Supply Chain Management or Logistics.
 * Strong expertise in data analysis and forecasting tools.
 * Strategic mindset with excellent planning and organizational skills.

title: Senior Production Planner (m/w/d) - Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg
description:
What To Expect
The Senior Production Scheduler will work closely with Demand Planning, Order Admin, Supply Chain Planning and Production Planning to ensure Tesla’s production plans are effectively setup to enable the factory to be successful. The Master scheduler will be responsible for developing the production schedule, communicating it out to the organization and managing all plan changes. The ideal candidate will appreciate an environment where superior work is encouraged, noticed and rewarded.

What You'll Do

Align with Sales & Demand planning on the sales & deliverable build requirements that drive the plan. Align with the Industrial Engineers assigned to each shop to understand shop constraints and incorporate these into the scheduling algorithm. Align with Supply Chain Planning to understand supply constraints (capacity / mix limitations, logistics issues) and, similarly, incorporate these into the scheduling algorithm. Build the plan using Theory of Constraints & Optimization techniques to ensure that the following objectives are achieved: build mix is achieved each week, plan is structured so shops can run as efficiently as possible (e.g. paint is able to batch paint colors), critical supply chain constraints are accounted for (supplier capability issues & logistics costs, i.e. expediting) so that the lowest cost build plan is achieved Lead the cross-functional change management process when issues occur inside the frozen window (0-48 hours). Build the model / run the analysis to identify the most effective solution for the factory (minimizes costs / maximizes revenue opportunity) given the issue (such as): urgent sales change requests (demand re-balancing, delivery schedule changes) Production (equipment breakdown) or supply chain (material shortage) issues Coordinate the introduction of new vehicle variants into the production systemAttend program launch meetings to understand impacts of new variants to the production and ensure that the launch timing solves given other factory priorities Represent operations in the development of the Option code framework Participate in the daily factory operational review to understand and maintain the health of material flow through the factory. Own reporting on factory status & performance (weekly, monthly & quarterly) out to production management & key partners / stakeholders in the organization. Pull data from the ERP & the production management systems (MOS, AMP, SCADA, Andon) to understand status. Use data visualization tools such as Tableau to generate the status reports. Support operational report out to the weekly Executive Sales & Operational Planning meeting. Define the business requirements & generate the use cases to drive software development Utilize the Jira system to communicate these requirements & coordinate with factory software on which sprint a given capability


What You'll Bring

Degree in Engineering or equivalent in experience.2-5 years related experience in materials management, production planning, material scheduling, or purchasing in a manufacturing company is required.Strong analytical capabilities - including data analysis to optimize plans relative to different constraint factors (equipment capacity, staffing plans, material availability) is required. Proficiency in analytical and reporting tools (MS Excel, Tableau) is strongly desired. Experience managing change thru a factory (i.e. New Product Introductions)Able to work well under pressure while managing competing demands and tight deadlines.Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in the English and German languages Organization skills with meticulous attention to detail Strong sense of ownership & Positive attitude


, Tesla

description:
Wir suchen dich!

Dein Profil


 * Du hast ein technisches Studium sehr gut abgeschlossen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung

 * Du bist analytisch stark und besitzt die Fähigkeit Probleme in Lösungen umzuwandeln
 * Du hast fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
 * Idealerweise bringst du erste REFA oder MTM-Erfahrungen mit
 * Du hast Lust, ein aufstrebendes Scale-up mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln
 * Du bist bereit nach Kempten zu ziehen oder regelmäßig ins Allgäu zu pendeln oder wohnst bereits im wunderschönen Allgäu
   
   

Das Bieten Wir Dir An


 * ...beste Konditionen für deinen Start bei Rebike:
    * 30 Tage Urlaub, Überstunden werden monatlich ausbezahlt
    * Geregelte Arbeitszeiten (Montag - Freitag)
    * Keine Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit
    * Fokussiertes Arbeiten ohne Kundenkontakt
    * Arbeit nur mit Premium E-Bikes

 * …die besten Benefits:
    * Ein kostenloses Mitarbeiter E-Bike im Abo
    * Deine persönliche Sachbezugskarte
    * Regelmäßige Events mit dem besten Team
    * Rebike-Arbeitskleidung
    * Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Bikes, Teile & Accessoires
    * Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
    * Bonus für die Empfehlung neuer Rebiker
      

Interessiert?

Teilst du unsere Vision, die Mobilität von morgen zu gestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine ausführliche Bewerbung (Lebenslauf, Anschreiben und/oder Zeugnisse).

Das Rebike Mobility Team freut sich darauf, dich bald kennenzulernen.

Übrigens, hier kannst du einen Blick hinter die Kulissen unseres Refurbishment Centers erhaschen...

Über uns

Das sind wir


 * Wir sind füreinander da: Wir sind ein Team – standort-, abteilungs- und hierarchieübergreifend. Wir achten aufeinander und gehen respektvoll miteinander um. Gemeinsam überwinden wir jedes Hindernis, denn wir helfen uns gegenseitig und stellen uns gemeinsam Herausforderungen.
 * Wir absolvieren einen Marathon: Wir denken langfristig und lösungsorientiert, dabei übernehmen wir Verantwortung für unser Tun. Schritt für Schritt überwinden wir jede Herausforderung und wachsen daran. Wir lernen schnell und feiern gemeisterte Etappen auf dem Weg zu unserem Ziel.
 * Wir gestalten unseren Teamspirit: Wir gestalten und leben unsere Kultur, dabei bringt sich jeder aktiv ein. Wir lieben es unterschiedlich zu sein und fühlen uns durch Verständnis verbunden. Wir begrüßen die Vielfalt des Teams.
 * Wir geben Gas: Wir sind leidenschaftliche Rebiker:innen und lieben was wir tun. Wir packen an und geben Gas - unsere Ziele motivieren uns über uns hinauszuwachsen. Wir stehen für unsere Überzeugungen ein und bleiben dabei offen für andere Ideen.
 * Wir inspirieren Kund:innen: Wir schaffen Vertrauen und sind zuverlässig. Unsere Kunden schätzen uns für erstklassigen Dienstleistungen und Produkte. Qualität, Sicherheit und einzigartiger Service sind unser Anspruch.
   
   

Das ist unsere Vision

Rebike ist eines der wachstumsstärksten E-Mobility-Unternehmen mit Sitz in München. Mit der Vision, die Mobilität von morgen zu gestalten, haben wir uns ein Ziel gesetzt: die beliebteste und erfolgreichste, markenübergreifende Plattform für Premium-E-Bikes in Europa zu werden und unsere Kund:innen zudem mit attraktiven Abo- und Verleih-Angeboten zu überzeugen.

Dabei bieten wir für jeden Bedarf die passende Lösung: gebrauchte, neuwertige und neue Premium-E-Bikes (www.rebike.com) zum günstigen Preis, ein attraktives E-Bike Abo-Modell (www.ebike-abo.de) und E-Bike-Verleihstationen (www.rebike-verleih.de) in beliebten Ferienregionen. Durch die unternehmenseigene Wertschöpfungskette mit eigenem Refurbishment-Center in Kempten kann der Lebenszyklus jedes einzelnen E-Bikes deutlich verlängert werden, wodurch ein wichtiger Beitrag zum Klimaschutz geleistet wird.

title: Logistics Manager (80-100%)
description:
At neustark, we’re all in for one mission: permanently removing one million tons of CO2 in 2030, and even more every year beyond that. Why? It’s a no-brainer: we want to enable a bright future for all future generations on our planet. And for that, we need to reduce and remove CO2, now.

Sound exciting? Well, there’s more! We’re a closely knitted team of around 60 neustarkers, working flexibly, internationally and full of passion and ambition. We’re scaling up our solution and impact every day, currently in full-fledge expansion mode. Speed and pragmatism drive our day-to-day, as do growing together and having tons of fun together!




Do you want to help us grow our impact? Then join our carbon removal mission today 🚀




This is what YOUR future team does:

In Supply Chain at neustark, we source all over the world, we identify, quality and select the best partners for a large range of products and services, including CO2. We contract or order all the needed material, equipment or service at the best cost with the best quality and service level. We ensure supplier capacity to enable company growth and set up a effective and sustainable logistics process. We are accountable for the end to end supply chain, from sourcing to purchasing, order fulfilment and planning.




YOUR mission at neustark:

 * Operate the transport and logistics execution according to customer demand and align suppliers and partners.
 * Define and implement the processes and procedures to operate the warehouse and inventory management, including cost monitoring.
 * Ensure compliance with transportation, customs regulations and safety standards.
 * Design and optimize the logistics network including transport, warehouse and sites considering the best quality, service level and cost, ensuring a mid & long term company scaleup.
 * Develop and maintain strong relationships with logistics partners , suppliers stakeholders, and regulatory bodies.




This is what we offer YOU:

 * We’re building our future! And you can join us on our journey of shaping the rapidly evolving market of carbon removal – for the good of all generations on our planet.
 * Be an integral part of an enthusiastic and driven team. We are agile and resourceful in how we work, with an open feedback culture and flat hierarchies.
 * As a scale-up with strong growth and a solid financial foundation, we offer attractive remuneration and amenities including possible company participation.
 * What else can we say… Working at neustark is high-pace, high-excitement, high-impact, high-fun! Want to put this theory to test? Apply today!




This is YOU:

 * You have completed a Bachelor’s degree or higher in supply chain or logistics and since then gained 3-5 years of work experience. A master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)) is a plus.
 * You have a strong organizational and planning skills.
 * You have a data-driven mindset with excellent analytical capabilities.
 * You have a proven experience in managing logistics and transport operations.
 * Excellent communication and relationship-building skills to collaborate effectively with internal teams, external partners, and regulatory authorities.
 * Your outstanding communication and teamwork skills paired with your Logistics background make it easy for you to work with diverse teams as well as non-technical stakeholders.
 * You are proficient in English; German is a strong plus.
 * You are hungry to generate climate impact and grow with us.

To help you reconcile work and leisure time with their conflicting demands, we have adopted contemporary flexible working time models. We offer you flex-working time and mobile working. Our employees also benefit from generous arrangements for annual leave.

Ongoing training: Your personal and professional development is the key to success for us. To foster this, we conduct regular development discussions and facilitate a wide range of management and specialist training courses, soft skills courses, e-learning courses, language courses and coaching sessions.

title: Junior Specialist - Supply Chain Management
description:
Who You'll Work With

You will be based in one of our European offices as part of our Operations Practice.

Our Operations Practice assists our clients in solving complex operational challenges. Blending strategic thinking with hands-on practicality, our teams of consultants and experts work to develop and implement operational strategies that solve our clients’ most critical problems.

McKinsey’s Supply Chain Management service line is part of our Operations Practice and helps leading companies in all industries develop and implement future-oriented logistics strategies. We do this by making significant improvements in customer service while reducing invested capital and cost by transforming and optimizing their supply chains from end to end.

When you join McKinsey as a Junior Consultant, you join a firm that will challenge you and invest heavily in your professional development. You will have the opportunity to work in teams and help the best organizations in the world solve some of their most difficult problems.

What You'll Do

You will play an active role in problem solving for clients including identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing, and conducting analyses, and synthesizing conclusions into recommendations.

As part of our two-year Operations Excellence Program (OEP), you will work on client engagements in the same way as any other McKinsey consultant. You will gain leading edge operations and consultancy skills, primarily through on-the-job coaching, which will be complemented by the OEP’s structured capability-building program.

We view the OEP position as the start of a rewarding, challenging and highly flexible career with McKinsey and the Operations practice. During your first few years with the firm, you will serve as a junior practice specialist on multiple client engagements and work with a number of colleagues and clients in a range of industry and operations service lines. You will acquire the necessary knowledge and expertise to help companies achieve excellence in their operations.

Along with other members of the OEP community, you will dedicate many days to functional training and knowledge development under the leadership of our operations experts. You will follow a curriculum based on operations excellence themes and will receive advanced training in one of six specific areas of operations manufacturing, product development, purchasing, service operations, supply chain management, or capital excellence.

Upon completion of the program, successful consultants will join our global group of leading experts in operational excellence. We already have OEP graduates working at all levels of the firm from associate to partner.

Your application should be in English and include your CV and your transcripts (high school, university, etc.), indicating all relevant grades.

OPS2024

Qualifications


 * Master’s degree and exceptional academics required
 * Initial experience in supply chain management (e.g., design and implementation of logistics strategy, network design and optimization, transportation, warehouse design and optimization, supply chain planning and management processes, supply chain modeling and optimization)
 * Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities
 * Mobility and enthusiasm for taking on European assignments during the work week
 * Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
 * Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, in English and local office language

title: Supply Chain Manager EMEA
description:
Essential Duties & Responsibilities



 * Ensure the implementation and sustainment of Supply Chain best practices in accordance with ASCM standards across all EMEA markets
 * Lead EMEA Supply Chain network optimization assessments and execution
 * Ensure correct transportation vendor selection so that the appropriate levels of service and cost are met for each shipment: to and from vendors, AVI-SPL warehouses, 3PL facilities, and job sites
 * Assess inefficiencies across multiple warehouse operations and oversee implementation of countermeasures to address them
 * Oversee and support the creation and optimization of SOPs and policy statements/updates pertaining to Logistics, Warehousing, and Inventory
 * Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and performance metrics to assess the effectiveness and efficiency of warehouse operations
 * Facilitate AVI-SPL’s ability to leverage scale in new/existing relationships with the company’s Logistics and Warehousing vendors
 * Diversify the company’s carrier portfolio including TL and LTL carriers, brokers, White Glove Final Mile Agents, Freight forwarders, Third Party Logistics (3PL’s), drayage providers, air freight carriers and independent contractors:
 * Analyze and interpretate shipping data from multiple carriers
 * Perform national bid process or lane negotiations with brokers and asset-based carriers for long haul shipments.
 * Onboard Agents to implement outsourced final mile optimization from local offices as appropriate
 * Implement standardized operating agreements and service level agreements (SLA’s) including ISO based Risk Assessment. Re Qualify existing vendors and deactivate from the network if needed while continuously adding new capacity with qualified vendors.
 * Track and maintain acceptable levels DIFOT of (Delivered In Full On Time) and internal customer service metrics
 * Support the VP, Global Supply Chain with any process changes relating to EMEA Supply Chain
 * Advise Warehouse Management in all levels of the organization on packaging and outbound shipping standards/protocols
 * Collaborate with Procurement to optimize inbound shipments from vendors and negotiate price breaks on equipment due to optimized shipments
 * Assist Sales team with accurate estimates for projects involving complex supply chain challenges
 * Track compliance with countermeasures and best practices and follow up to ensure compliance
 * Recommend and document changes and follow up with appropriate areas to ensure required changes are implemented.
 * Create and provide reports as needed.



Skills & Abilities



 * Ability to pivot efficiently between strategic initiatives and tactical execution as business needs require

title: Junior Specialist - Supply Chain Management
description:
Who You'll Work With

You will be based in one of our European offices as part of our Operations Practice.

Our Operations Practice assists our clients in solving complex operational challenges. Blending strategic thinking with hands-on practicality, our teams of consultants and experts work to develop and implement operational strategies that solve our clients’ most critical problems.

McKinsey’s Supply Chain Management service line is part of our Operations Practice and helps leading companies in all industries develop and implement future-oriented logistics strategies. When you join McKinsey as a Junior Consultant, you join a firm that will challenge you and invest heavily in your professional development. You will have the opportunity to work in teams and help the best organizations in the world solve some of their most difficult problems.

What You'll Do

You will play an active role in problem solving for clients including identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing, and conducting analyses, and synthesizing conclusions into recommendations.

As part of our two-year Operations Excellence Program (OEP), you will work on client engagements in the same way as any other McKinsey consultant. You will gain leading edge operations and consultancy skills, primarily through on-the-job coaching, which will be complemented by the OEP’s structured capability-building program.

We view the OEP position as the start of a rewarding, challenging and highly flexible career with McKinsey and the Operations practice. During your first few years with the firm, you will serve as a junior practice specialist on multiple client engagements and work with a number of colleagues and clients in a range of industry and operations service lines. Along with other members of the OEP community, you will dedicate many days to functional training and knowledge development under the leadership of our operations experts. Upon completion of the program, successful consultants will join our global group of leading experts in operational excellence. We already have OEP graduates working at all levels of the firm from associate to partner.

Ongoing training : Your personal and professional development is the key to success for us. To foster this, we conduct regular development discussions and facilitate a wide range of management and specialist training courses, soft skills courses, e-learning courses, language courses and coaching sessions.

Find out more about our benefits at https://careers.merz-aesthetics.com .

description:

tesa ist einer der weltweit führenden Hersteller von Klebebandlösungen mit einem Sortiment von mehr als 7.000 verschiedenen Produkten. Mit Leidenschaft für Technologie treiben wir Innovation, Zuverlässigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit voran, um die Zukunft jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen.

Unsere Lösungen bereichern die Arbeit, Produkte und das Leben in einer Vielzahl von Branchen, zum Beispiel der Automobil- oder Elektronikindustrie, aber auch bei Ihnen Zuhause. Damit sprechen wir ein breites Industriesegment, aber auch Sie ganz persönlich an.

Sie werden sicher überrascht sein, wo unsere innovativen Klebebandlösungen überall zu finden sind. Von der Batterie in Elektroautos, über das Display Ihres Mobiltelefons bis hin zum Aufzug in Ihrem Gebäude, tesa hält die Welt zusammen. Und das seit mehr als 125 Jahren.

title: Demand and Supply Planner (m/w/d) - 100% / München
description:
INTRO

Unterstütze uns als Demand and Supply Planner (m/w/d) in unserem Team in München.

Du bist ein Organisationstalent, hast ein Auge für Details und liebst es zu netzwerken, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du wünschst dir ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld? Eine Unternehmenskultur, welche von gemeinsam gelebten Werten geprägt ist und ein Team, auf das du dich immer verlassen kannst? – Willkommen bei VIU!

DEINE AUFGABEN


 * Du bist verantwortlich für die monatliche, vierteljährliche und jährliche Prognose der Nachfrage nach unseren verschiedenen Produkten
 * Du organisierst und unterstützt Prozesse entlang der gesamten Lieferkette und stehst in regelmäßigem Kontakt mit unseren wichtigsten Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Operations, Retail & Finance
 * Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von zweiwöchentlichen Berichten für unsere Stores in der DACH-Region
 * Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Tech Team zusammen, um Reports zu automatisieren und die Bedarfsplanung Schritt für Schritt in unser BI-Tool zu integrieren
 * Du übernimmst wichtige Projekte zur Steigerung der Prozesseffizienz & Verfügbarkeit unserer Produkte
   
   

DEIN PROFIL


 * Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Supply Chain Management, Mathematik/Statistik, Data Science
 * Deine Berufserfahrung von mehr als 2 Jahren im Bereich Supply Chain Management / Demand Planning bringst du mit
 * Eine selbstständige und transparente Arbeitsweise mit hoher Kommunikationsfähigkeit zeichnet dich aus

 * Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Bedarfsplanung und BI-Tools - das wäre klasse
 * Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch und Englisch - fließend in Wort und Schrift
   
   

DAS BIETEN WIR


 * Dein Arbeitsumfeld: Duz-Kultur, flache Hierarchien - wir legen Wert auf unternehmerische Freiheiten und Nachhaltigkeit
 * Deine Arbeitszeit: Arbeitszeit- und Arbeitsortflexibilität - für dein Gleichgewicht
 * Deine Einarbeitung: Individuell auf deine Bedürfnisse angepasst, mit regelmäßigem Feedback
 * Mental Health: Unterstützung für deine psychische Gesundheit
 * Deine Vorsorge: 20% Arbeitgeberzuschuss für deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge
 * Dein Urlaub: 28 Tage und mehr je länger du dabei bist - Sabbatical/ unbezahlter Urlaub - mehr Zeit für deine Träume
 * VIU frames: Brillen, Sonnenbrillen für dich, deine Familie und Freund*innen
 * Deine Perspektive: Wir ermöglichen individuelle Weiterentwicklung durch unsere VIUcademy
 * Unser Teamevent: Wir feiern kleine und große Erfolge gemeinsam
 * Deine VIU Aktie: Du hast die Möglichkeit VIU Anteile zu erwerben

Über uns

VIU ist ein Unternehmen vielfältiger Charaktere. Ein Ort, an dem du lernen, dich voll entfalten und über dich hinauswachsen kannst. Wir leben Vielfalt und Offenheit und möchten gemeinsam die Zukunft des Brillenmarkts gestalten.

Wir sind 400 VIUans, verbunden durch starke Werte, die unseren Kund*innen sowohl online als auch in unseren 50 Stores in Europa ein einzigartiges Erlebnis bieten. Bist du bereit, deine Ideen in einem ambitionierten Team einzubringen? Dann freuen wir uns dich kennenzulernen.

Hast du noch Fragen zu VIU, der Stelle oder willst erstmal mit uns in Kontakt treten?

Als globaler Bauproduktehersteller mit 42.500 Mitarbeitenden in 90 Ländern bieten wir ambitionierten Talenten vielfältige Möglichkeiten. Jeder Beitrag wird geschätzt und wir fördern ein sicheres und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld mit dem Ziel, nachhaltige Lösungen für eine bessere Zukunft zu entwickeln.

Knauf Industries Deutschland GmbH ist stolz, Teil der Knauf-Gruppe zu sein. Mit einer langjährigen Tradition und einer wachsenden internationalen Präsenz suchen wir engagierte Persönlichkeiten, um unsere ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen. Teile unsere Werte und werde Teil des Teams.

Erkennst du dich wieder?


 * Stellst du stets den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt deines Handelns?
 * Denkst du bei deinem Handeln an die Zukunft und kommende Generationen?
 * Kannst du auf nachweisbare Erfolge in deiner beruflichen Laufbahn zurückblicken?
 * Strebst du kontinuierlich nach persönlichem und beruflichem Wachstum?
   
   

Das erwartet dich


 * Als Produktionsplaner (m/w/d) erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche und spannende Aufgaben an der Schnittstelle von Vertrieb, Produktion und Logistik
 * In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Vertrieb und unserer Produktion terminierst du Produktionsaufträge, optimierst die Abläufe und erkennst Engpässe, außerdem bist du der erste Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) für unsere Kunden, wenn es um Fragen zu Logistik oder Terminen geht
 * Mit Abrufen von Produktionsmaterialien, der Erstellung von Unterlagen und weiteren organisatorischen Aufgaben ermöglichst du jeden Tag einen reibungslosen Ablauf der Produktion
 * Du arbeitest mit modernen Softwaretools, um Daten zu erfassen, Auswertungen zu erstellen und Kennzahlen zu erheben, zudem stimmst du Lieferungen mit unserem Logistikteam, den externen Logistikpartnern und unseren Kunden ab
 * Deine gewinnbringende Art und Serviceorientierung stellt die Gewinnung und langfristige Bindung unserer Kunden sicher
   
   

Das bringst du mit


 * Du hast eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und konntest bereits einschlägige Erfahrung sammeln
 * Kommunikation in deutscher und englischer Sprache zählt zu deinen absoluten Stärken – Du kannst dich in jede Kundensituation hineinversetzen und auf die unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse mit deiner „Can–Do“ Mentalität reagieren
 * Du begeisterst dich für die Produktion und willst für unsere Kunden immer das Beste erreichen und hast ein technisches Verständnis sowie Interesse an unseren Produkten
 * Du begeisterst dich für die Produktion und willst für unsere Kunden immer das Beste erreichen und hast ein technisches Verständnis sowie Interesse an unseren Produkten
 * Im Arbeitsalltag zeigst du ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative und handelst dabei stets kundenorientiert
   
   

Darum lohnt es sich

Wir alle gestalten unser Leben individuell. Als Arbeitgeber nehmen wir eine bedeutende Rolle im Alltag ein und möchten unsere Mitarbeitenden daher mit verschiedenen Angeboten unterstützen. Das umfasst unter anderem:


 * Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in einem stabilen, erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen mit attraktiver Vergütung
 * Fitness und Gesundheit: Angebote der aktiven Gesundheitsförderung, des Betriebsarztes, Arbeitsschutzes, betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, Jobradleasing u.w.
 * Flexibilität: 30 Tage Urlaub
 * Tägliche Zeitersparnis: Ausreichend Parkplätze und direkten Zugang über das Werksgelände zum ÖPNV (Zug, Bus)
 * Zukunftsplanung: Angebote zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
 * Eigene Karriere- und Laufbahnentwicklung: Individuelle Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen und Schulungen, langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
 * E-Bike-Leasing: Nutzung steuerlicher Vorteile bei gleichzeitiger Förderung der eigenen Gesundheit
 * Benefits und Voucher: Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken sowie rabattierter Mitarbeitereinkauf
 * E-Bike-Leasing: Nutzung steuerlicher Vorteile bei gleichzeitiger Förderung der eigenen Gesundheit
   
   

Knauf als Arbeitgeber

Die Knauf Industries Group ist ein europaweit führender Hersteller von komplexen Formteilen. Unsere Kunden in Automobil-, Klima- und Sport & Freizeitindustrie schätzen uns als langjährig etablierten, kompetenten und innovativen Partner. Dabei liegt unser Fokus auf nachhaltigen und mehrwegfähigen Produkten sowie innovativen, CO2-reduzierenden Verfahren. Unsere eigene Werkzeugfertigung im additiven 3D-Druckverfahren ermöglicht es uns, unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten innovativen Lösungen zu begeistern.

Die Knauf Gruppe ist stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit zu sein. Wir setzen uns für ein vielfältiges und integratives Arbeitsumfeld ein und treffen daher alle Entscheidungen bei der Personalauswahl in allen Bereichen unseres Unternehmens auf der Grundlage von Erfahrung, Fähigkeiten und Integrität. Wir ermutigen Bewerber aus allen Lebensbereichen, sich auf unsere Stellen zu bewerben, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Religion usw.

Sei ein Teil von Knauf und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft!

Der Hauptsitz der Knauf Unternehmensgruppe befindet sich im unterfränkischen Iphofen. Von dort aus werden globale Strategien entwickelt und angestoßen.

Weltweit ist Knauf einer der führenden Hersteller von modernen Dämmstoffen, Trockenbausystemen, Putzen und Zubehör, Wärmedämmverbundsystemen, Farben, Estrichen, Fußbodensystemen sowie Baugeräten und Werkzeugen. Mit mehr als 300 Produktionsstätten und Vertriebsorganisationen in über 90 Ländern gehört die Knauf Gruppe zweifelsohne zu den Big Playern auf dem Weltmarkt.

Lesen Sie hier mehr über unsere Geschichte.

title: Junior Logistik Manager (m/w/d) - Emsbüren
description:
Description

Als Bereichs-/Schichtleiter:in bei Amazon führst Du ein großes, diverses Team und sorgst dafür, dass Dein Geschäftsbereich stets mit der Nachfrage Schritt hält. In dieser praktischen Rolle machst Du Dich mit den komplexen Betriebsabläufen eines globalen Unternehmens vertraut und lernst, was erforderlich ist, damit alles reibungslos abläuft. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg:innen arbeitest Du daran, die Produktivität zu steigern und Herausforderungen zu begegnen. Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen.

Key job responsibilities

Förderung einer Kultur der Sicherheit und des Wohlbefindens

Analyse und Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen, um beständig hohe Qualität und Produktivität sowie das schichtübergreifende Einhalten aller Unternehmensziele sicherzustellen

Unterstützung und Führung eines Teams sowie Erledigung administrativer Aufgaben; Aufbau und Unterstützung einer starken Teamkultur

Analyse der Leistung sowie Vorschläge für Prozessverbesserungen, um die Arbeitsabläufe und den Kundenservice zu optimieren

Kollaboration mit anderen Manager:innen zur Standardisierung von Schichtprozessen

A day in the life

Du arbeitest in unterschiedlichen Schichten an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Dabei konzentrierst Du Dich vorwiegend auf das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards durch Dein Team und an Deinem gesamten Standort. Außerdem überwachst Du die Prozesseffizienz. Prioritäten in Deinem Arbeitsalltag sind unter anderem das routinemäßige Teammanagement und tägliche Betriebsaktivitäten. Neben anderen Aufgaben wie Eskalationen in Einzelfällen, Prozessverbesserungen sowie die übergreifende betriebliche Notfallplanung.

Als wichtiges Mitglied des Betriebsteams arbeitest Du mit Kolleg:innen aus anderen Teams sowie externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Das beinhaltet die Analyse von Daten und Leistungskennzahlen gemeinsam mit Führungskräften in Deinem Geschäftsbereich ebenso wie die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit dem technischen Team.

About The Team

Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.

Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.

Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic Qualifications


 * Bachelor-Abschluss oder kurz vor Abschluss eines Bachelor-Studiengangs
 * Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 * Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
 * Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
 * Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: (Senior) Supply Chain & Operations Manager
description:
About The Role

You will play a pivotal role in supporting our expansion team by ensuring equipment readiness for our seamless and timely launches of new BEAT studios. Additionally, you will oversee the operational excellence of our active gyms by ensuring all equipment and facilities are maintained to the highest standard, maximizing uptime and customer satisfaction.

This role demands exceptional organizational and analytical skills and a solutions-oriented mindset. Elevate BEAT81 by creating, standardizing, and maintaining procurement, inventory, and maintenance processes cross-functionally, driven by KPIs.

Your Responsibilities


 * Procurement: Ensure timely and cost efficient procurement and delivery of BEAT branded fitness equipment, both internationally and nationally, to meet quantity and delivery timelines required for our upcoming launches - set the standard for seamless and scalable supply chain processes!
 * Inventory Management: Develop and implement an automated inventory dashboard to monitor stock, streamline reorders, and enhance demand forecasting, collaborating with our expansion and city operations teams to align inventory with operational needs – master precision planning!
 * Maintenance and Lifecycle Management: Develop and oversee maintenance schedules for our bikes and cardio machines in the gyms by minimizing downtime through preventative maintenance and efficient repair workflows with internal stakeholders and external partners - keep our gyms running at full speed!
 * Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for your area of responsibility and take over full accountability. Produce reports and dashboards to evaluate supply chain performance and drive continuous improvement – turn insights into action!
   
   

Who You Are

Your Profile


 * Relevant Experience: You already have work experience in a Supply Chain or Operations Management role in a company with physical operations or hardware components.
 * Start-up Background: You have some hands-on experience working in a start-up environment, adapting quickly to dynamic, fast-paced settings, not shying away from big challenges.
 * Language Proficiency: You have C1-level or higher proficiency in English and German, enabling clear communication with diverse stakeholders.
   
   

Your Competencies


 * Project Management: Advanced project management skills to plan, align, execute and oversee supply chain initiatives while ensuring alignment with timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
 * Process Optimization: Expertise in process optimization to enhance efficiency and scalability while maintaining a strong focus on execution and getting things done, ensuring that strategies translate into tangible, impactful results.
 * Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to foster collaboration and coordinate effectively across departments to drive alignment and achieve business objectives in a dynamic environment.
 * Strategic Procurement and Inventory Management: Expertise in sourcing, negotiation, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and cost management to ensure timely and cost-effective procurement while maintaining optimal stock levels to support operational efficiency and organizational goals.
 * Data-Driven Performance Management: Proficiency in analytics, KPI tracking, and reporting tools to evaluate supply chain performance, drive continuous improvement, and communicate insights effectively.
   
   

Your Benefits


 * Unlimited BEAT81 Workouts for you and one family member/friend: we guarantee that you will get fit working here!
 * Fresh fruit and healthy snacks on tap at the office to fuel your workout regime!
 * Regular sports and social team events
 * Join our journey to build the largest fitness company that is delivering lasting wellbeing in the world
 * Become part of a highly motivated and international team of Europe’s fastest growing fitness technology startup backed by Europe’s best VCs and a unique team of fitness experts
 * A working environment that is built on care for one another, trust, openness, having a growth mindset and relentless focus on doing the right thing
   
   

About Beat81

BEAT81 is a fitness technology startup revolutionizing the way people get fit. By merging the very best of HIIT group training, heart rate technology and expert coaching we are empowering people around Europe, and soon the world, to Sweat Smarter Together!

Our workouts led by fitness experts offer real-time, personalized heart rate monitoring, gamification and analytics - transforming the traditional group fitness experience. We think big. We think rebellious. And we're building a world-class team to make BEAT81 the global leader in fitness and technology.

BEAT81 is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Apply Today

If you’re ready for a career-defining challenge and a chance to make a real impact in the pharmaceutical industry, we want to hear from you.

Take the lead. Drive change. Transform healthcare.

title: Junior Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen

Junior Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d)

Kappeln - Vollzeit

ab sofort

Junior Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) in 24376 Kappeln

Du bist ein wahres Organisationstalent und hast den Kunden stets im Fokus? Du liebst die Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Menschen in einem internationalen Umfeld und sprichst gerne Englisch? Dann bring deine Fähigkeiten bei uns ein.

Wir, die Mau & Mittelmann GmbH, sind ein international tätiges, mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit Sitz in Kappeln an der Schlei. Unsere Kernkompetenzen liegen in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Komposit-Materialbausätzen (Kits) für Leichtbauanwendungen. Dein zukünftiges Aufgabengebiet


 * Du erfasst Kundenaufträge und koordinierst die Abwicklung von der Bestellung bis zur Auslieferung.
 * Du steuerst die Koordination von Lieferterminen und Abholungen und agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, Lieferanten und der Produktion.
 * Du bist erster Ansprechpartner für operative Fragen unserer internationalen Kunden (z.B. aus Italien, Frankreich, Finnland, Portugal, Türkei).
 * Du planst und überwachst eigenständig die Transportabwicklung und bereitest Zolldokumente vor.
 * Du koordinierst den Einkauf und Lieferantenabsprachen von Verbrauchs- und Produktionsartikeln.
   
   

Dein Profil


 * Du verfügst über einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in BWL, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Supply Chain Management oder Logistik – alternativ verfügst du über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation oder einschlägige Erfahrung in diesem Bereich.

 * Du kommunizierst gerne und sicher am Telefon und per Mail. Englisch stellt dabei keine Hürde dar. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber nicht Voraussetzung.
 * Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise gehört zu deinen Stärken.
 * Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel und Outlook.
 * Deine Deutschkenntnisse sind auf Niveau C1 (verhandlungssicher).
   
   

Hä? Passt doch gar nicht!

Du möchtest eigentlich gerne etwas anderes tun, aber auch Deine Berufserfahrung nutzen?

Wir suchen Quereinsteiger mit Deinen Kenntnissen. Alles, was Du dafür wissen musst, lernst Du bei uns.

Das ist uns sehr wichtig

Du hast vielseitige Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Hilf uns, unsere Prozesse und Abläufe gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln. Nicht für alles gibt es bereits eine Lösung. Das ist Chance und Erwartung zugleich. Eine entsprechende Bereitschaft zur Pionierarbeit wünschen wir uns von dir.

Wir bieten Dir


 * Die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen – deine Ideen können unser Unternehmen voranbringen.
 * Mit der Einführung von LEAN Management und Kaizen optimieren wir kontinuierlich unsere Prozesse in Produktion und Verwaltung – Sei ein aktiver Teil dieser Veränderung.
 * Wir setzen auf deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Neben regelmäßigen internen Weiterbildungsangeboten bieten wir auch externe Schulungen zu Themen wie Kommunikation, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung, Lean/Kaizen sowie fachspezifische Trainings.
 * Ein fundiertes und strukturiertes Onboarding, damit du dich schnell in deinem neuen Arbeitsumfeld zurechtfindest.
 * Modern ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und guter technischer Ausstattung (Laptop, Bildschirme etc.)
 * Kostenlose Getränke wie Tee und Kaffee für deine tägliche Energie.
 * Als mittelständisches Familienunternehmen pflegen wir einen persönlichen Umgang – gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in einem internationalen Umfeld mit spannenden Kunden.
 * Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit kostenloser Tickets für Spiele der SG Handewitt.
 * Gewinne Einblicke in die Zukunftsbranche Windkraft.
 * Nachhaltigkeit ist uns wichtig – Als Ecovadis zertifiziert setzen wir auf verantwortungsbewusstes Handeln.
 * Regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier fördern ein starkes Miteinander.
   
   

So geht es weiter

Bewirb dich bitte direkt online, indem Du auf den Jetzt-online-bewerben-Button klickst.

Nutze bei Fragen vorab die Kontaktdaten Deines Ansprechpartners.

Du Fehlst Uns

Falls Du Dich in einem ungekündigten Arbeitsverhältnis befindest, sichern wir Dir natürlich höchste Vertraulichkeit Deiner Bewerbung zu.

title: Operations Manager (m/f/x)
description:
The company:




AEG Power Solutions is a worldwide leader in power supply and power conversion technologies for industrial and renewables applications. We design and provide our solutions to blue chip customers on large projects for power generation, infrastructures, nuclear, renewable energy and oil & gas processes. Our 800 employees operate in 15 countries with a strong European and Asian footprint.




Our company is considering fantastic opportunities to grow both organically and through acquisitions. We are looking for an Operations Manager of our main factory in Warstein Belecke, Germany.







The position:







The Head of Operations Germany is responsible to lead the German production center (120 people, 60 mio T/O) and ensure business objectives are achieved in line with the annual growth- and profitability targets. You will plan, direct and coordinate all plant operations activities (manufacturing, supply chain, material management) and develop and execute improvement strategies to ensure that systems/products are manufactured and delivered efficiently and in line with commitments to customers.




This role reports directly to the Global VP Operations and will work in close collaboration with functional Vice Presidents. This role is located at the company’s premises in Warstein-Belecke, Germany and is an integral part of the management team.




This position requires a week days relocations to Belecke-Warstein at least.







Main Responsibilities:




 * Responsible for the full P&L and monthly output of the German production center with a clear focus on Operations and Project Management.
 * Set production planning, processes, resources, capabilities for operations to improve steadily on all KPI’s: productivity, on-time delivery, throughput, inventories.
 * Implement production strategy (make or buy) in line with group overall strategy.
 * Redesign core processes to reduce project lead time and drive inventories down per groupwide initiatives and plans; develop and implement cost effective alternatives and improvement to production processes.
 * Coordinate with Project execution teams to optimize production planning considering customer requirements and operating efficiency.
 * Establish standardization, best practises and consistency across all operations teams
 * Ensure quality control in production processes and appropriate use fo methods and precautions to minimize health- and safety risks.
 * Develop teams and optimize supporting functions/departments; attract and retain key operational personnel leaders.







Qualifications and Requirements:




 * Degree in Electrical Engineering, ideally complemented with an MBA.
 * Expert knowledge of SAP.
 * 5+ years progressive experience managing manufacturing/assembly function with a clear focus on engineering-to-order processes, ideally in international environment (<100m€).
 * Background in Industrial Operations, Supply Chain Management and Project Management.
 * Fluent in German and English.
 * Decisive and results-driven personality.
 * Strong leader; setting direction, formulating action plans and driving them consistently.
 * Ability to drive and motivate others.
 * Strong analytical skills.







What we offer:




We offer an excellent opportunity for professional development in a historic company, with an extraordinary brand recognition, market leadership and global presence. The location of the factory also provides a privileged working environment, as well as stable, flexible and highly competitive labor conditions.
